words.en: If you describe something as romantic, you mean that it is connected with love or with a feeling of excitement and mystery associated with love.

words.ex: They wrote a love letter every day, and it became their romance.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天写一封情书，这成为了他们的浪漫史。
words.en: Romance refers to the feelings and behaviors characteristic of love, especially in its early stages, or a story, movie, or other work dealing with love in a sentimental or idealized way.

words.ex: The pencil is 15 centimeters long.
words.ex_cn: 这支铅笔有15厘米长。
words.en: A centimeter is a unit of length in the metric system equal to one hundredth of a meter.

words.ex: The pencil is 15 centimetres long.
words.ex_cn: 这支铅笔长15厘米。
words.en: A centimetre is a unit of length in the metric system equal to one hundredth of a metre.

words.ex: The baby is asleep in the crib.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿在婴儿床里睡着了。
words.en: If someone is asleep, they are sleeping.

words.ex: He bought new clothing for the winter.
words.ex_cn: 他为冬天买了新衣服。
words.en: Clothing refers to items worn on the body. Clothing is typically made of fabrics or textiles but over time has included garments made from animal skin or other thin sheets of materials put together.

words.ex: He barely slept last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚几乎没睡觉。
words.en: You use barely to say that something is only just true or only just the case.

words.ex: He paid with cash for the bread.
words.ex_cn: 他用现金买了面包。
words.en: Money in the form of coins or banknotes, especially that which is immediately available.

words.ex: He is chewing gum loudly.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大声地嚼口香糖。
words.en: To chew means to bite and grind food in your mouth so it becomes soft enough to swallow.

words.tr: adj. 糟糕的；坏的；严重的；
words.ex: The weather today is bad.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气很糟糕。
words.en: If you describe something as bad, you mean that it is of a low or unacceptable standard or quality.

words.ex: He called his friend a comrade.
words.ex_cn: 他称他的朋友为同志。
words.en: A comrade is a companion who shares one's activities or is a fellow member of an organization.

words.tr: n. 公告；布告；公报；新闻简报；
words.ex: The school posted a bulletin about the holiday schedule.
words.ex_cn: 学校张贴了一份关于假期安排的公告。
words.en: A bulletin is a short news report on the radio or television. A bulletin is also a short printed newspaper or leaflet that gives information about a particular group or organization.

words.tr: n. 性格；人物角色；特点；
words.ex: His character is kind and patient.
words.ex_cn: 他的性格善良且有耐心。
words.en: The combination of qualities or features that distinguishes one person, group, or thing from another.

words.tr:
n. 特点；特性；
adj. 典型的；特有的；
words.ex: Honesty is a key characteristic of a good friend.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是一个好朋友的关键特点。
words.en: A characteristic is a quality or feature that is typical of someone or something.

words.ex: His behavior at the party was very polite.
words.ex_cn: 他在派对上的举止非常礼貌。
words.en: The way in which one acts or conducts oneself, especially towards others.

words.ex: His behaviour at school is very good.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校的行为很好。
words.en: The way in which one acts or conducts oneself, especially towards others.

words.ex: We went to the cinema last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚去看了电影。
words.en: A cinema is a place where people go to watch films. It can also refer to the art and industry of making films.

words.ex: Leaves fall in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 树叶在秋季落下。
words.en: Autumn is the season between summer and winter when leaves change color and the weather becomes cooler.

words.tr:
n. 熊；
v. 承受；忍受；带有；生（孩子）；
words.ex: A bear walked near the campsite.
words.ex_cn: 一只熊在露营地附近走动。
words.en: If you bear something, you accept it and are able to deal with it, even though it is unpleasant or painful. A bear is a large, strong wild animal with thick fur and sharp claws.

words.tr: adj. 可以忍受的；可以承受的
words.ex: The pain was just bearable.
words.ex_cn: 疼痛尚在可忍受的范围内。
words.en: If something is bearable, it is not too unpleasant or painful to deal with.

words.tr:
n. 妥协；
v. 危及；
words.ex: They reached a compromise after hours of talk.
words.ex_cn: 经过数小时的讨论，他们达成了妥协。
words.en: A compromise is an agreement between two people or groups in which each side gives up some of the things they want so that both sides are happy at the end.

words.ex: The magic show amazed the children.
words.ex_cn: 魔术表演让孩子们感到惊奇。
words.en: To amaze someone means to surprise them very much.

words.tr: adj. 令人惊异的；令人惊叹的； v. “amaze”的现在分词；
words.ex: The view from the mountain is amazing.
words.ex_cn: 从山上看到的景色令人惊异。
words.en: If something is amazing, it is very surprising and makes you feel pleasure or admiration.

words.ex: He stared in amazement at the magic trick.
words.ex_cn: 他惊讶地盯着那个魔术。
words.en: Amazement is the feeling you have when something surprises you very much.

words.ex: He exaggerates his achievements to impress others.
words.ex_cn: 他夸张自己的成就来给别人留下印象。
words.en: If you exaggerate, you indicate that something is, for example, worse or more important than it really is.

words.tr: adj. 夸张的；夸大的；言过其实的； v. 夸张；夸大；“exaggerate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: His story was exaggerated and not true.
words.ex_cn: 他的故事是夸张的，不真实的。
words.en: If you describe something as exaggerated, you mean that it is described as being worse or better than it really is.

words.ex: His story was an exaggeration of the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他的故事是对事实的夸张。
words.en: An exaggeration is a statement that represents something as better or worse than it really is.

words.ex: His collection of old coins is very rare.
words.ex_cn: 他收集的旧硬币非常稀有。
words.en: A collection is a group of things, often of the same type, that have been gathered together over a period of time.

words.tr: adj. 典范的；可做模范的；惩戒性的
words.ex: He is an exemplary student who always finishes his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名模范学生，总是完成作业。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as exemplary, you think they are extremely good and suitable to be copied by other people.

words.tr:
n. 市中心区；商业区；
adv. 在市区；往市区；
words.ex: We went downtown to buy some clothes.
words.ex_cn: 我们去市中心买了一些衣服。
words.en: Downtown refers to the central part or main business and commercial area of a city or town.

words.ex: The children are eager to open their presents.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们渴望打开他们的礼物。
words.en: If you are eager to do or have something, you want to do or have it very much.

words.tr:
n. 节目；程序；
v. 编程；
words.ex: We watched a funny program on TV last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚在电视上看了一个有趣的节目。
words.en: A program is a set of instructions that a computer follows in order to perform a particular task.

words.ex: He gave the rope a twist to tie it tight.
words.ex_cn: 他把绳子拧了一下以便系紧。
words.en: To twist something means to turn it in a different direction or to change its shape by turning it.

words.ex: He gave a simple explanation for his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的错误给出了一个简单的解释。
words.en: An explanation is a statement or account that makes something clear or provides a reason for something.

words.tr:
v. 打呵欠
n. 呵欠
words.ex: He yawned during the boring lecture.
words.ex_cn: 他在无聊的讲座上打哈欠。
words.en: If you yawn, you open your mouth very wide and breathe in more air than usual, often because you are tired or bored.

words.tr:
n. 西南；
adj. 位于西南的；
adv. 向西南；
words.ex: The storm came from the southwest.
words.ex_cn: 风暴来自西南方向。
words.en: The southwest is the direction which is halfway between south and west.

words.tr:
n. 新闻界；出版社；
v. 按；压；
words.ex: The press reported the news quickly.
words.ex_cn: 新闻界迅速报道了这则新闻。
words.en: To press something is to push it firmly, often with your fingers or hand, in order to operate a device or machine, or to make something flat or smooth. It can also mean to urge someone to do something or to make a strong demand for something.

words.tr: adj. 紧迫的； v. 按；“press”的现在分词；
words.ex: The pressing issue is finding clean water.
words.ex_cn: 紧迫的问题是找到干净的水。
words.en: If something is pressing, it needs to be dealt with immediately because it is important or urgent.

words.tr:
n. 压力；压强；
v. 对…施加压力；
words.ex: He feels pressure from his parents to get good grades.
words.ex_cn: 他感受到来自父母要取得好成绩的压力。
words.en: Pressure is the force that you produce when you press hard on something, or the force that is produced by a particular amount of gas or liquid in a confined space.

words.tr: n. 工作场所；工作地点；
words.ex: The new safety rules apply to the workplace.
words.ex_cn: 新的安全规则适用于工作场所。
words.en: A workplace is a place where people work, such as an office or factory.

words.ex: Somebody left their umbrella here.
words.ex_cn: 某人把伞落在这里了。
words.en: Somebody refers to a person who is not known or not specifically named.

words.ex: He can identify the bird by its song.
words.ex_cn: 他能通过鸟的叫声识别它。
words.en: If you can identify someone or something, you are able to recognize them or distinguish them from others.

words.tr:
n. 速度；速率；
v. 加速；加快；
words.ex: The car's speed was too high on the wet road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在湿滑路面上的速度太快了。
words.en: Speed is the rate at which something moves or happens.

words.ex: His income is enough to pay for rent and food.
words.ex_cn: 他的收入足以支付房租和食物。
words.en: Income is the money that a person or a company earns regularly, for example from investment or work.

words.tr:
n. 地点；场所；斑点；
v. 发现；识别；
words.ex: This is the spot where we met for the first time.
words.ex_cn: 这是我们第一次见面的地方。
words.en: A spot is a particular place or point. It can also refer to a small mark or stain, or a small amount of something. As a verb, it means to see, notice, or recognize someone or something.

words.tr:
n. 影响力；冲击（力）；
v. 对…产生影响；
words.ex: The new law had a big impact on education.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律对教育产生了重大影响。
words.en: The effect or influence of one person, thing, or action, on another.

words.tr:
v. 举起；提起；抬起；
n. 电梯；搭便车；
words.ex: He lift the box with both hands.
words.ex_cn: 他用双手举起箱子。
words.en: To lift something means to move it to a higher position. A lift is a device that carries people or goods up and down inside buildings.

words.ex: From the clues, he made a logical inference.
words.ex_cn: 从线索中，他做出了一个合理的推论。
words.en: An inference is a conclusion that you draw about something by using information that you already have about it.

words.ex: The police discovered a scheme to steal money.
words.ex_cn: 警方发现了一个偷钱的阴谋。
words.en: A scheme is a plan or arrangement, especially one produced by a government or other organization, or a secret plan to do something, especially something illegal or dishonest.

words.ex: He insured his car against accidents.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的车投保了意外险。
words.en: If you insure yourself or your property, you pay money to an insurance company so that if you become ill or if your property is damaged or stolen, the company will pay you a sum of money.

words.ex: He found a seashell on the beach.
words.ex_cn: 他在海滩上发现了一个贝壳。
words.en: A seashell is the empty shell of a small sea creature, often found on beaches.

words.ex: The police opened an inquiry into the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警方对这起事故展开了调查。
words.en: An inquiry is a question which you ask in order to get some information.

words.ex: The police opened an enquiry into the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警方对这起事故展开了调查。
words.en: An enquiry is a question you ask in order to get some information.

words.ex: He is inquiring about the train schedule.
words.ex_cn: 他正在询问火车时刻表。
words.en: If someone has an inquiring mind, they are interested in learning about many different things.

words.ex: He learned to love his self.
words.ex_cn: 他学会了爱自己。
words.en: Your self is your basic personality or nature, especially considered in terms of what you are really like as a person.

words.ex: He interprets the poem as a love story.
words.ex_cn: 他把这首诗解释为一个爱情故事。
words.en: If you interpret something in a particular way, you decide that this is its meaning or significance.

words.tr:
v. 设置；使固定；放置；
n. 一组；一套；
adj. 固定的；位于…的；安排好的；
words.ex: He set the alarm for 6 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 他把闹钟设在早上六点。
words.en: To put something in a specified place or position; to adjust or arrange something; a group of things that belong together or are used together; fixed or established.

words.ex: Farmers irrigate their fields with water from the river.
words.ex_cn: 农民用河里的水灌溉他们的田地。
words.en: To supply land or crops with water by means of channels or pipes.

words.ex: She is reading a book.
words.ex_cn: 她正在读书。
words.en: used to refer to a woman, girl, or female animal previously mentioned or easily identified.

words.ex: He reads the bible every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上读《圣经》。
words.en: The Bible is the holy book of Christianity, consisting of the Old Testament and the New Testament.

words.ex: The significance of this discovery changed science.
words.ex_cn: 这一发现的重要性改变了科学。
words.en: The quality of being worthy of attention; importance.

words.ex: The students are sitting in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 学生们正坐在教室里。
words.en: A room in a school where lessons take place.

words.tr:
n. 幻灯片；滑梯；
v. （使）滑动；下滑；
words.ex: He showed a slide of his vacation photos.
words.ex_cn: 他展示了一张他度假照片的幻灯片。
words.en: To move smoothly along a surface while maintaining continuous contact with it; to pass or move quietly or smoothly; a structure with a smooth sloping surface for children to slide down; a decline from a higher to a lower level or status.

words.ex: The boy is playing soccer in the park.
words.ex_cn: 那个男孩正在公园里踢足球。
words.en: A boy is a male child or a young male person.

words.ex: He wears shorts to the beach.
words.ex_cn: 他穿短裤去海滩。
words.en: Shorts are a piece of clothing that you wear on the lower part of your body, which do not cover your legs completely.

words.tr:
n. 攻击；袭击；
v. 攻击；袭击；
words.ex: The attack happened at night.
words.ex_cn: 这次攻击发生在夜晚。
words.en: To attack means to try to hurt or defeat someone or something by using force or violence.

words.ex: The sailors slept in the cabin during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 水手们在风暴期间睡在船舱里。
words.en: A cabin is a small room or compartment, especially one on a ship or an aircraft.

words.ex: He washes his hands with soap.
words.ex_cn: 他用肥皂洗手。
words.en: A substance used with water for washing and cleaning, made of a compound of natural oils or fats with sodium hydroxide or another strong alkali, and typically also perfume and coloring.

words.ex: She blends flour and water to make dough.
words.ex_cn: 她把面粉和水混合在一起做面团。
words.en: To mix substances together so that they combine into a single substance.

words.ex: The site of the old church is now a park.
words.ex_cn: 旧教堂的位置现在是一个公园。
words.en: A site is a piece of ground that is used for a particular purpose or where a particular thing happens.

words.ex: The fish is still alive in the water.
words.ex_cn: 这条鱼还在水里活着。
words.en: If people or animals are alive, they are not dead.

words.ex: The dog buried a bone in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 狗把一根骨头埋在了花园里。
words.en: The hard, rigid form of connective tissue constituting most of the skeleton of vertebrates, composed chiefly of calcium salts.

words.ex: Two companies compete for the same customers.
words.ex_cn: 两家公司为争夺相同的客户而竞争。
words.en: If you compete with someone for something, you try to get it for yourself and stop the other person getting it. You can also say that two people compete for something that they both want.

words.ex: The teacher chose an arbitrary number to start the game.
words.ex_cn: 老师随意选了一个数字来开始游戏。
words.en: If you describe an action, rule, or decision as arbitrary, you think that it is not based on any principle, plan, or system. It often seems unfair because of this.

words.tr: adj. 卓越的；极好的；明亮的；灿烂的；
words.ex: He gave a brilliant answer to the math question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这道数学题给出了卓越的回答。
words.en: A brilliant person, idea, or performance is extremely clever or skilful.

words.tr:
v. 等待；等候；
n. 等待；等候；
words.ex: I wait for the bus every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上等公交车。
words.en: to stay in one place or not do something until something else happens, someone arrives, etc.

words.ex: He speaks Chinese as his mother tongue.
words.ex_cn: 他把汉语作为母语。
words.en: The tongue is the flexible muscular organ in the mouth that is used for tasting, licking, swallowing, and (in humans) articulating speech.

words.ex: His hard work received much praise from the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他的努力工作得到了老师的许多赞美。
words.en: If you praise someone or something, you express approval for their achievements or qualities.

words.ex: He felt uneasy when he heard the strange noise.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到奇怪的声音时，他感到不安。
words.en: If you are uneasy, you feel anxious, afraid, or embarrassed, because you think that something is wrong or that there is danger.

words.ex: The tree grows in a vertical line.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树垂直生长。
words.en: Something that is vertical stands or points straight up.

words.ex: This math problem is difficult.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学题很难。
words.en: Something that is difficult is not easy to do, understand, or deal with.

words.ex: He felt envious when his friend got a new bike.
words.ex_cn: 当他的朋友得到一辆新自行车时，他感到嫉妒。
words.en: If you are envious of someone, you want something that they have.

words.tr: adj. 令人失望的；令人扫兴的； v. “disappoint”的现在分词；
words.ex: The movie was disappointing.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影令人失望。
words.en: If something is disappointing, it is not as good as you hoped it would be.

words.ex: His eyesight is getting worse with age.
words.ex_cn: 他的视力随着年龄增长而变差。
words.en: Your eyesight is your ability to see.

words.ex: The delivery of the package took three days.
words.ex_cn: 这个包裹的交付花了三天时间。
words.en: The act of delivering letters, parcels, or goods.

words.ex: She will organize a meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 她明天将安排一次会议。
words.en: To organize something means to arrange it in a systematic way, especially on a large scale.

words.tr: adj. 有组织的； v. 组织；“organize”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: She is an organized student who keeps her books in order.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个有条理的学生，把书整理得井井有条。
words.en: If something is organized, it is arranged in an orderly, efficient way.

words.ex: The organization helps poor children.
words.ex_cn: 这个组织帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: An organization is a group of people who work together in a structured way for a shared purpose.

words.ex: A mosquito bit my arm last night.
words.ex_cn: 一只蚊子昨晚咬了我的胳膊。
words.en: A mosquito is a small flying insect that bites people and animals in order to feed on their blood. Some mosquitoes can transmit diseases.

words.ex: I think it is a good idea.
words.ex_cn: 我认为这是个好主意。
words.en: To have a particular opinion, belief, or idea about someone or something.

words.tr:
n. 刻板印象；陈规老套
v. 对…存有成见；把…模式化
words.ex: He broke the stereotype that boys cannot cry.
words.ex_cn: 他打破了男孩不能哭的刻板印象。
words.en: A stereotype is a fixed general image or set of characteristics that a lot of people believe represent a particular type of person or thing.

words.ex: This is the book I bought.
words.ex_cn: 这是我自己买的那本书。
words.en: used to refer to a specific person or thing that has already been mentioned or is known about

words.tr:
n. 学习；研究；书房；
v. 学习；研究；
words.ex: His study of biology took five years.
words.ex_cn: 他对生物学的学习持续了五年。
words.en: The activity of learning or gaining knowledge, especially from books, or a detailed investigation and analysis of a subject or situation.

words.ex: He picked a wild mushroom in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 他在森林里摘了一朵野生蘑菇。
words.en: A mushroom is a fungus that grows in damp, dark places and has a stem with a rounded top.

words.ex: The children play in the sunshine.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在阳光下玩耍。
words.en: Sunshine is the light and heat that comes from the sun.

words.ex: He remained passive during the argument.
words.ex_cn: 他在争论中保持被动。
words.en: Accepting or allowing what happens or what others do, without active response or resistance.

words.ex: He fastened the strap around his wrist.
words.ex_cn: 他把带子系在手腕上。
words.en: A strap is a narrow piece of leather, cloth, or other material that is used to fasten, secure, or carry something, or to hold onto something.

words.tr:
n. 同辈；同等的人；
v. 凝视；
words.ex: He feels comfortable talking to his peers.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得和同辈交谈很自在。
words.en: A peer is someone who is equal to another in abilities, qualifications, age, background, or social status. As a verb, to peer means to look keenly or with difficulty at someone or something.

words.ex: Suddenly, the light went out.
words.ex_cn: 突然，灯灭了。
words.en: If something happens suddenly, it happens quickly and unexpectedly.

words.ex: He asked for permission to leave early.
words.ex_cn: 他请求允许早点离开。
words.en: If someone who has authority over you gives you permission to do something, they say that they will allow you to do it.

words.ex: He won the spelling contest.
words.ex_cn: 他赢得了拼写比赛。
words.en: A contest is a competition or a struggle for victory between individuals or groups.

words.ex: He held a pistol in his hand.
words.ex_cn: 他手里拿着一把手枪。
words.en: A pistol is a small gun.

words.ex: The conflict between the two countries lasted for years.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家之间的冲突持续了多年。
words.en: A conflict is a serious disagreement or argument, typically a protracted one.

words.ex: He likes to study physics in school.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在学校学习物理。
words.en: Physics is the scientific study of matter, energy, force, and motion, and how they relate to each other.

words.ex: He gave careful consideration to his decision.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的决定进行了仔细考虑。
words.en: Consideration is the process of giving careful thought to something before making a decision or taking action. It also refers to the quality of being thoughtful towards the needs and feelings of others.

words.ex: He has possession of the keys.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有这些钥匙。
words.en: The state of having, owning, or controlling something.

words.ex: He conveyed his thanks with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着表达了谢意。
words.en: If you convey information or a message, you communicate it to someone, often in a way that is not direct.

words.tr:
n. 情节；小块用地；
v. 绘图；
words.ex: The plot of the movie was very exciting.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的情节非常精彩。
words.en: A plot is a secret plan by a group of people to do something that is illegal or wrong, especially against a person or a government. It can also refer to the main events of a play, novel, movie, or similar work, devised and presented by the writer as an interrelated sequence. Additionally, a plot can be a small piece of land that is used or intended for a specific purpose.

words.tr: adj. 相应的； v. 符合；“correspond”的现在分词；
words.ex: Each input has a corresponding output.
words.ex_cn: 每个输入都有一个相应的输出。
words.en: If two things are corresponding, they are similar or equivalent in some way, often because they are connected or related in a particular context.

words.tr: adj. 杰出的；尚未处理的；
words.ex: He is an outstanding student who always gets top grades.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名杰出的学生，总是取得最高分。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as outstanding, you think that they are very remarkable and impressive.

words.ex: He is interested in politics.
words.ex_cn: 他对政治感兴趣。
words.en: Politics are the actions or activities concerned with achieving and using power in a country or society. The verb that follows politics may be either singular or plural.

words.tr:
n. 中间；
adj. 中间的；
words.ex: The ball stopped in the middle of the field.
words.ex_cn: 球停在了场地的中间。
words.en: The middle of something is the part of it that is equally distant from its edges or outer limits.

words.ex: The country has a budget deficit this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年这个国家的预算不足额。
words.en: A deficit is the amount by which something, especially a sum of money, is too small.

words.tr:
v. 点头；打盹
n. 点头
words.ex: He nodded when I asked if he was tired.
words.ex_cn: 当我问他是否累了时，他点了点头。
words.en: If you nod, you move your head downwards and upwards to show that you are answering 'yes' to a question, or to show agreement, understanding, or approval.

words.ex: The children are playing in their natural surroundings.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在他们的自然环境中玩耍。
words.en: The things and conditions around a person, place, or thing.

words.ex: The officer gave a clear order to the soldiers.
words.ex_cn: 军官向士兵下达了明确的命令。
words.en: An officer is a person in a position of authority in the armed forces, the police, or a government organization.

words.ex: She was sympathetic to his problems.
words.ex_cn: 她对他的问题很同情。
words.en: If you are sympathetic to someone who is in a bad situation, you are kind to them and show that you understand their feelings.

words.tr:
n. 分钟；一会儿；
adj. 微小的；极小的；
words.ex: I waited for five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 我等了五分钟。
words.en: A minute is a unit of time equal to sixty seconds or a sixtieth of an hour.

words.tr:
n. 味觉；味道；品味；喜好；
v. 品尝；有…味道；
words.ex: My taste can detect sweet and sour flavors.
words.ex_cn: 我的味觉能分辨甜味和酸味。
words.en: The sensation of flavor perceived in the mouth and throat on contact with a substance.

words.ex: The teacher put emphasis on reading every day.
words.ex_cn: 老师强调每天都要阅读。
words.en: Special importance, value, or prominence given to something.

words.ex: The heavy rain drowned the small village.
words.ex_cn: 大雨淹没了这个小村庄。
words.en: To die by being underwater too long and unable to breathe, or to kill someone in this way.

words.ex: He fixed the electrical wire with tape.
words.ex_cn: 他用胶带修好了电线。
words.en: Relating to electricity or things that use electricity.

words.ex: We derive the answer from the formula.
words.ex_cn: 我们从公式中得到答案。
words.en: If you derive something such as pleasure or benefit from a person or from something, you get it from them.

words.tr: abbr. 脱氧核糖核酸；“deoxyribonucleic acid”的缩写；
words.ex: DNA carries the genetic information in humans.
words.ex_cn: DNA携带人类的遗传信息。
words.en: DNA is a molecule that carries the genetic instructions used in the growth, development, functioning, and reproduction of all known living organisms and many viruses.

words.ex: Whoever wants to join can sign up.
words.ex_cn: 任何想加入的人都可以报名。
words.en: used to refer to any person or people, when it does not matter who

words.ex: The engagement between the teacher and students improved learning.
words.ex_cn: 老师与学生之间的密切关系提高了学习效果。
words.en: An engagement is a formal agreement to get married, or a period of time when two people are planning to get married.

words.ex: The president signed the new contract.
words.ex_cn: 总裁签署了新合同。
words.en: The president is the elected head of a republic or the head of a company or organization.

words.ex: He wears blue trousers to work.
words.ex_cn: 他上班穿蓝色的裤子。
words.en: Trousers are a piece of clothing that you wear over your body from the waist downwards, and that cover each leg separately.

words.ex: He gave a quick answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对问题给出了一个快速的回答。
words.en: Moving fast or doing something in a short time.

words.ex: He eats eggs for protein.
words.ex_cn: 他吃鸡蛋来获取蛋白质。
words.en: Proteins are large, complex molecules that play many critical roles in the body. They are necessary for the structure, function, and regulation of the body's tissues and organs.

words.ex: His answer was vague and hard to understand.
words.ex_cn: 他的回答不明确，难以理解。
words.en: If something written or spoken is vague, it does not explain or express things clearly.

words.ex: He is a wealthy man who owns many houses.
words.ex_cn: 他是个富有的人，拥有许多房子。
words.en: A wealthy person, organization, or country has a lot of money, resources, or assets.

words.tr:
n. 热度；热；
v. 加热；
words.ex: The heat of the sun made the road hot.
words.ex_cn: 太阳的热度让路面变得很热。
words.en: Heat is a form of energy that is transferred by a difference in temperature. It can also refer to the level of excitement or intensity in a situation.

words.ex: It is rational to save money for the future.
words.ex_cn: 为未来存钱是合理的。
words.en: Based on or in accordance with reason or logic.

words.ex: The church is a holy place.
words.ex_cn: 教堂是一个神圣的地方。
words.en: If you describe something as holy, you mean that it is considered to be special because it is connected with God or a particular religion.

words.ex: He sent the document by fax.
words.ex_cn: 他通过传真发送了文件。
words.en: A fax is a machine that sends and receives documents electronically along a telephone line, or a document that is sent or received using such a machine.

words.tr:
v. 猜测；猜想；
n. 猜测；猜想；
words.ex: I guess it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我猜明天会下雨。
words.en: If you guess something, you give an answer or provide an opinion which may not be true because you do not have definite knowledge about the matter concerned.

words.tr:
v. 回忆起；召回；
n. 记忆力；
words.ex: I recall my first day at school.
words.ex_cn: 我想起了我上学的第一天。
words.en: If you recall something, you remember it and tell others about it.

words.tr:
n. 领域；田地；场地；运动场；
v. 处理，应付（问题、电话等）；
words.ex: He works in the field of computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他在计算机科学领域工作。
words.en: A field is an area of land that is used for a particular purpose, such as growing crops or playing sports.

words.tr:
n. 手；
v. 交；递；给；
words.ex: He waved his hand to say hello.
words.ex_cn: 他挥挥手打招呼。
words.en: The part of the body at the end of the arm that is used for holding, moving, touching, and feeling things.

words.ex: The company's revenue increased last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司的收入去年增加了。
words.en: Revenue is the income that a company, organization, or government receives regularly.

words.ex: He went to his grandfather's funeral.
words.ex_cn: 他去参加了他祖父的葬礼。
words.en: A funeral is a ceremony that is held because someone has died.

words.ex: The reduction in cost helped the company save money.
words.ex_cn: 成本的减少帮助公司节省了资金。
words.en: The act of making something smaller in size, amount, degree, importance, etc., or the result of this.

words.ex: People gather in the square for the festival.
words.ex_cn: 人们在广场上聚集庆祝节日。
words.en: If people gather somewhere, or if someone gathers people somewhere, they come together in a group.

words.tr: v. 有关；把…联系起来；认同；叙述；理解；
words.ex: This story relates to your childhood.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事与你的童年有关。
words.en: If you relate a story, you tell it. If two things relate, they are connected in some way.

words.tr:
adj. 相对的；相关联的；
n. 亲戚；
words.ex: His success is relative to his hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他的成功是相对于他的努力而言的。
words.en: A relative is someone who is part of your family. Parents, siblings, uncles, aunts, grandparents, cousins, nieces and nephews — they're all relatives.

words.ex: There is a clear relation between exercise and health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼与健康之间有明显的关联。
words.en: A relation between two things is a connection or link between them.

words.tr: adj. 相关的；有联系的； v. 关联；“relate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: This book is related to science.
words.ex_cn: 这本书与科学相关。
words.en: If two or more things are related, there is a connection between them.

words.ex: Einstein developed the theory of relativity.
words.ex_cn: 爱因斯坦提出了相对论。
words.en: The theory of relativity, developed by Albert Einstein, fundamentally altered our understanding of space, time, and gravity.

words.tr: adj. 新鲜的；新的；刚发生的；
words.ex: She bought fresh apples from the market.
words.ex_cn: 她从市场买了新鲜的苹果。
words.en: Fresh food has been picked or produced recently, and has not been preserved, for example by being frozen or put in a tin.

words.tr:
n. 请求；要求的事；
v. 要求；请求；
words.ex: He made a request for help.
words.ex_cn: 他提出了一个帮助的请求。
words.en: If you request something, you ask for it politely or formally.

words.tr:
adj. 巨大的；伟大的；
n. 巨人；伟人；
words.ex: The giant elephant stood near the tree.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的大象站在树旁。
words.en: A giant is an imaginary person who is very big and strong, especially one mentioned in old stories. In everyday language, a giant can also refer to a very large and successful company or organization.

words.tr:
n. 匆忙；
v. 赶快；
words.ex: He left in a hurry without saying goodbye.
words.ex_cn: 他匆忙离开，连再见都没说。
words.en: If you hurry somewhere, you go there quickly. If you hurry to do something, you start doing it quickly or do it more quickly than usual.

words.ex: The old song is reminiscent of my childhood.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌让人想起我的童年。
words.en: If you say that one thing is reminiscent of another, you mean that it reminds you of it.

words.tr:
n. 运输；
v. 运输；
words.ex: He uses public transport to go to work.
words.ex_cn: 他乘坐公共交通去上班。
words.en: To transport something or someone is to move them from one place to another, especially over long distances.

words.tr:
n. 西方；
adj. 西方的；
adv. 在西方；
words.ex: The address is 1071 West Street.
words.ex_cn: 地址是西街1071号。
words.en: The direction towards the point of the horizon where the sun sets at the equinoxes, on the left-hand side of a person facing north, or the part of the horizon lying in this direction.

words.ex: He is virtually always on time.
words.ex_cn: 他几乎总是准时。
words.en: In effect though not formally recognized; practically.

words.tr:
n. 痕迹；轨迹；微量；
v. 追踪；追溯；仔细查找；
words.ex: There was no trace of blood on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 地板上没有血迹。
words.en: If you trace something such as a pattern or a shape, you draw it carefully over a piece of thin paper. You can also trace someone or something that is missing or has disappeared, by following their movements or actions.

words.ex: He was sent to prison for stealing.
words.ex_cn: 他因偷窃被送进了监狱。
words.en: A prison is a building where criminals are kept as punishment or where people accused of a crime are kept before their trial.

words.ex: He uses a wireless mouse to work on his laptop.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个无线鼠标在笔记本电脑上工作。
words.en: Using radio, microwaves, etc. (as opposed to wires or cables) to transmit signals.

chapters.name: 一般要求词汇 Word List 9

words.tr:
n. 光；灯；光线；
adj. 轻的；浅的；少量的；明亮的；
v. 点燃；照亮；
words.ex: The light from the window brightened the room.
words.ex_cn: 窗户透进来的光让房间变亮了。
words.en: Light is the natural agent that stimulates sight and makes things visible. It is also used to describe something that is not heavy or a source of illumination.

words.ex: Madam, can you help me with this question?
words.ex_cn: 夫人，您能帮我回答这个问题吗？
words.en: A polite form of address for a woman, especially one who is married or of higher social status.

words.ex: He loves reading English literature.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢阅读英语文学。
words.en: Literature consists of written works, especially those considered to have artistic or intellectual value.

words.ex: He wrote a short paragraph about his vacation.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一段关于他假期的短文。
words.en: A paragraph is a section of a piece of writing, usually consisting of several sentences dealing with a single subject. The first sentence of a paragraph typically starts on a new line.

words.tr: n. 勋爵；主；上帝；统治者；
words.ex: The lord lived in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 这位勋爵住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: A lord is a man who has a high rank in the nobility, especially in Britain, or a man who has authority or control over others.

words.ex: The farmer walks his ox to the field.
words.ex_cn: 农夫牵着他的牛去田里。
words.en: An ox is a large animal with four legs, which is often used for pulling farm equipment or carrying heavy loads.

words.ex: He showed his passport at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 他在机场出示了他的护照。
words.en: A passport is an official document that identifies you as a citizen of a particular country and gives you the right to travel to and from that country.

words.ex: He must confront his fears.
words.ex_cn: 他必须面对自己的恐惧。
words.en: If you confront a difficult situation or issue, you accept the fact that it exists and try to deal with it.

words.ex: The confrontation between the two teams was intense.
words.ex_cn: 两队之间的对抗非常激烈。
words.en: A confrontation is a situation in which there is a lot of disagreement or argument about something important.

words.ex: He writes with a black pen.
words.ex_cn: 他用一支黑色钢笔写字。
words.en: A pen is a tool used for writing or drawing with ink.

words.tr:
v. 定罪；宣判有罪
n. 罪犯；囚犯
words.ex: The court convicted him of theft.
words.ex_cn: 法院判定他犯有盗窃罪。
words.en: If someone is convicted of a crime, they are found guilty of that crime in a court of law.

words.tr:
n. 许可证；
v. 允许；准许；
words.ex: He showed his fishing permit to the officer.
words.ex_cn: 他向官员出示了他的钓鱼许可证。
words.en: If someone permits something, they allow it to happen. If they permit you to do something, they allow you to do it.

words.tr: adj. 放任的；纵容的；许可的
words.ex: Her parents are permissive and let her stay out late.
words.ex_cn: 她的父母很宽容，让她很晚才回家。
words.en: A permissive person, society, or system allows people a lot of freedom to do what they want.

words.ex: He asked for permission to leave early.
words.ex_cn: 他请求允许早点离开。
words.en: If someone who has authority over you gives you permission to do something, they say that they will allow you to do it.

words.tr: adj. 徒劳的；空虚的；自负的；爱慕虚荣的
words.ex: It's vain to try to fix what can't be fixed.
words.ex_cn: 试图修复无法修复的东西是徒劳的。
words.en: If you describe someone as vain, you are critical of their extreme pride in their own beauty, intelligence, or other good qualities.

words.tr: n. 钢琴家；钢琴弹奏者；
words.ex: The pianist played a beautiful song at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 这位钢琴家在音乐会上演奏了一首美妙的曲子。
words.en: A pianist is a person who plays the piano, especially professionally.

words.tr: v. 考虑；“consider”的现在分词； prep. 考虑到；就…而言；鉴于；
words.ex: I am considering going to the park.
words.ex_cn: 我正在考虑去公园。
words.en: Taking into account; in view of.

words.ex: The dog fell into a deep pit.
words.ex_cn: 狗掉进了一个深坑。
words.en: A pit is a large hole in the ground, either natural or as a result of digging. It can also refer to a hollow or indentation in a surface, or a place where something is extracted, such as a mine. As a verb, to pit means to set someone or something in competition or to make a hollow or indentation in a surface.

words.tr:
adv. 在今晚；
n. 今晚；
words.ex: We will have dinner together tonight.
words.ex_cn: 我们今晚一起吃晚饭。
words.en: Tonight refers to the evening or night of the current day.

words.tr:
n. 犁；犁形器具
v. 犁；耕；艰苦前进
words.ex: The farmer uses a plow to turn the soil.
words.ex_cn: 农夫用犁翻土。
words.en: A plow is a farm tool with one or more heavy blades that breaks the soil and cuts a furrow for sowing seeds.

words.ex: He found a weapon in the old box.
words.ex_cn: 他在旧箱子里发现了一件武器。
words.en: A weapon is an object that can be used to harm or kill someone, or to damage or destroy something.

words.ex: The poll showed that most people support the new law.
words.ex_cn: 这项民意调查表明，大多数人支持这项新法律。
words.en: A poll is a survey in which people are asked their opinions about something, usually in order to find out how popular something is or what people intend to do in the future.

words.ex: He faced difficulty in solving the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决这道数学题时遇到了困难。
words.en: A difficulty is a problem or issue that is hard to deal with or understand.

words.ex: There is a possibility of rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天有可能下雨。
words.en: A possibility is a situation that might happen or something that might be true.

words.ex: The contestant won the singing competition.
words.ex_cn: 这位竞争者赢得了歌唱比赛。
words.en: A contestant is someone who takes part in a competition or contest.

words.ex: Honesty is a great virtue.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是一种伟大的美德。
words.en: A virtue is a good quality or way of behaving.

words.tr: adj. 品行端正的；品德高的；
words.ex: He is a virtuous man who always tells the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个品行端正的人，总是说真话。
words.en: Having or showing high moral standards.

words.ex: The boy walked down the long corridor.
words.ex_cn: 男孩走过了长长的走廊。
words.en: A corridor is a long passage in a building, with doors and rooms on one or both sides.

words.ex: The prisoner walked in the yard every day.
words.ex_cn: 这名囚犯每天在院子里散步。
words.en: A prisoner is a person who is kept in a prison as a punishment for a crime they have committed or while awaiting trial.

words.ex: He passed the exam with high marks.
words.ex_cn: 他以高分通过了考试。
words.en: An exam is a formal test that you take to show your knowledge or ability in a particular subject, or to obtain a qualification.

words.ex: The doctor did an examination of his arm.
words.ex_cn: 医生对他手臂进行了检查。
words.en: An examination is a formal test that you take to show your knowledge or ability in a particular subject, or to obtain a qualification.

words.tr: n. 进展；进步；缓慢前进；稳步前进；
words.ex: The project shows slow progress.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目进展缓慢。
words.en: Progress is the process of gradually improving or getting nearer to achieving or completing something.

words.ex: This school uses a progressive teaching method.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校使用一种先进的教学方法。
words.en: A progressive person or idea is one that is modern and new, and is interested in change and improvement.

words.ex: There has been slow progression in his math skills.
words.ex_cn: 他的数学技能有了缓慢的进展。
words.en: The process of developing or moving gradually towards a more advanced state.

words.tr:
adv. 向下地；
adj. 向下的；
words.ex: The leaves fell downward slowly.
words.ex_cn: 树叶慢慢向下飘落。
words.en: Moving or leading towards a lower place or level

words.ex: The eagle flies high above the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 鹰在山上面高飞。
words.en: A large bird of prey with a massive hooked bill and long broad wings, known for its keen sight and powerful soaring flight.

words.ex: The festival celebrates ethnic music and dance.
words.ex_cn: 这个节日庆祝民族音乐和舞蹈。
words.en: Ethnic relates to a group of people who have a common national or cultural tradition.

words.ex: Many people face unemployment during the economic crisis.
words.ex_cn: 在经济危机期间，许多人面临失业。
words.en: Unemployment refers to the state of being without a job, especially when one is actively seeking employment.

words.ex: We attended a workshop on writing skills.
words.ex_cn: 我们参加了一个关于写作技巧的研讨会。
words.en: A workshop is a room or building where things are made or repaired using tools or machinery. It can also refer to a meeting at which a group of people engage in intensive discussion and activity on a particular subject or project.

words.ex: Blood circulates in the body.
words.ex_cn: 血液在体内循环。
words.en: To move or cause to move continuously or freely through a closed system or area.

words.ex: The child is quiet during nap time.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在午睡时很安静。
words.en: Making little or no noise; free from disturbance or tumult; tranquil; calm.

words.ex: The truck carried boxes to the store.
words.ex_cn: 卡车把箱子运到了商店。
words.en: A truck is a large vehicle that is used to transport goods by road.

words.tr: adj. 最新的；最近的；新式的
words.ex: He keeps his knowledge up-to-date by reading news every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天读新闻来保持知识的更新。
words.en: Someone or something that is up-to-date has the most recent information or uses the newest methods or equipment.

words.tr:
adj. 全部的；整体的；
n. 整个；全部；
words.ex: He ate the whole cake by himself.
words.ex_cn: 他一个人吃掉了整个蛋糕。
words.en: The whole of something is all of it.

words.tr:
n. 压力；压强；
v. 对…施加压力；
words.ex: He feels pressure from his parents to get good grades.
words.ex_cn: 他感受到来自父母要取得好成绩的压力。
words.en: Pressure is the force that you produce when you press hard on something, or the force that is produced by a particular amount of gas or liquid in a confined space.

words.tr: n. 运输；运输系统；交通工具；
words.ex: The city improved its transportation system.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市改善了它的运输系统。
words.en: Transportation refers to the movement of people, animals, and goods from one place to another.

words.ex: He stared at the moon all night.
words.ex_cn: 他整晚凝视着月亮。
words.en: To look fixedly or intently at someone or something.

words.ex: The farmer milks the cow every morning.
words.ex_cn: 农夫每天早上给母牛挤奶。
words.en: A cow is a large female animal that is kept on farms for its milk.

words.ex: He defeated his opponent in the chess game.
words.ex_cn: 他在国际象棋比赛中击败了对手。
words.en: An opponent is someone who is competing against you in a contest, game, or argument, or someone who is opposed to an idea or plan.

words.tr:
adv. 最；
pron. 大部分；
adj. 最多的；大多数的；
words.ex: He is most tired after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后最累。
words.en: You use most to refer to the majority of a group of things or people or the largest part of something.

words.ex: Mother's milk nourishes the baby.
words.ex_cn: 母乳滋养婴儿。
words.en: To nourish someone or something means to provide them with the food and other substances they need in order to live, grow, and be healthy.

words.tr:
n. 舞蹈；
v. 跳舞；
words.ex: She loves to watch the traditional dance.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢观看传统舞蹈。
words.en: To move your body rhythmically to music, typically following a set sequence of steps.

words.tr:
n. 治疗；疗法；
v. 治愈；治疗；
words.ex: The new medicine is a cure for the disease.
words.ex_cn: 这种新药是这种疾病的治疗方法。
words.en: If doctors or medical treatments cure an illness or injury, they cause it to end or disappear. If a person or animal is cured of an illness or injury, they become well again.

words.tr:
n. 官员；高级职员；
adj. 官方的；正式的；
words.ex: The official announced new rules for the festival.
words.ex_cn: 这位官员宣布了节日的新规定。
words.en: An official is a person who holds a position of authority in a government or organization, or something that is authorized or formally recognized.

words.ex: They placed a memorial at the site of the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他们在事故地点放置了一座纪念物。
words.en: A memorial is a structure or event established to remind people of a person or event.

words.ex: The soup is tasty and hot.
words.ex_cn: 这汤美味又热。
words.en: If you describe food as tasty, you mean that it has a pleasant and attractive flavour.

words.ex: He received criticism for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他因为迟到而受到批评。
words.en: Criticism is the act of expressing disapproval of someone or something and of the faults they have or the mistakes they have made.

words.tr:
n. 调查；勘测；
v. 调查；勘测；
words.ex: The school did a survey about student lunch preferences.
words.ex_cn: 学校做了一项关于学生午餐偏好的调查。
words.en: A survey is a detailed study or inspection, especially as a means of collecting information about people's opinions or behavior.

words.ex: We watched a play at the theatre last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚在剧场看了一场戏。
words.en: A theatre is a building with a stage in it, on which plays, shows, and other performances take place.

words.ex: Maybe it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 也许明天会下雨。
words.en: used to show that something is possible or that something might be true

words.tr:
n. 暴躁脾气；情绪；心情；性情
v. 使…缓和；冲淡
words.ex: He loses his temper when he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 当他累了的时候，他会发脾气。
words.en: If you refer to someone's temper or say that they have a temper, you mean that they become angry very easily.

words.tr: adj. 脾气……的，性情……的；有气质的；温和的，不暴力的; v. 使……温和；使（金属）回火；调...
words.ex: He is a tempered man who never gets angry easily.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个脾气温和的人，从不轻易发怒。
words.en: Having a specified temper or disposition; moderated or balanced.

words.ex: His calm temperament helps him stay peaceful in stress.
words.ex_cn: 他平静的性情让他在压力下保持平和。
words.en: Your temperament is your basic nature, especially as it is shown in the way that you react to situations or to other people.

words.ex: He got malaria from a mosquito bite.
words.ex_cn: 他被蚊子叮咬后得了疟疾。
words.en: Malaria is a disease caused by a parasite that is transmitted to humans through the bites of infected mosquitoes.

words.ex: She ate a slice of toast for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 她早餐吃了一片烤面包。
words.en: Toast is bread which has been cut into slices and made brown and crisp by cooking at a high temperature. Toast is also a drink in which you wish someone happiness or success.

words.ex: His nature is kind and patient.
words.ex_cn: 他的本性是善良且有耐心的。
words.en: Nature refers to the physical world and everything in it that is not made by people, including plants, animals, mountains, oceans, stars, etc. It can also refer to the basic or inherent features, character, or qualities of something.

words.tr:
n. 腐烂；衰落；
v. 腐烂；
words.ex: The fruit began to show signs of decay.
words.ex_cn: 这水果开始出现腐烂的迹象。
words.en: To decay means to be slowly destroyed by a natural process or to become gradually worse in quality, condition, or strength.

words.tr: adj. 现代化的; v. 使现代化（modernize 的过去分词）
words.ex: The city has modernized its public transport system.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市已经使其公共交通系统现代化。
words.en: To modernize something means to make it more modern or up to date, often by introducing new methods, ideas, or technology.

words.ex: They want to modernise the old factory.
words.ex_cn: 他们想现代化这个旧工厂。
words.en: To modernise something means to make it more modern, usually by using the most recent technology or ideas.

words.ex: He suffered from a bad cold last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周患了重感冒。
words.en: To experience something unpleasant, such as injury, pain, or loss.

words.ex: He loves listening to music every night.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢每天晚上听音乐。
words.en: Music is the pattern of sounds produced by people singing or playing instruments.

words.ex: The outward force pushed the door open.
words.ex_cn: 向外的力把门推开了。
words.en: An outward movement or position is one that is directed towards the outside or away from the centre.

words.ex: He ate a super big pizza.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一块超大的披萨。
words.en: If you describe something as super, you mean that it is very good indeed.

words.ex: The origin of this tradition is unknown.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统的起源不明。
words.en: The origin of something is the point or place where it begins, or the cause from which it arises.

words.tr:
n. 市场；行情；商场；销路；
v. 营销；
words.ex: The market sells fresh vegetables every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这个市场每天早上卖新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: A market is a place where goods are bought and sold, or an area or country where there is a demand for particular goods or services.

words.ex: He made a strategic decision to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他做出了一个有战略性的决定来省钱。
words.en: Relating to the identification of long-term or overall aims and interests and the means of achieving them.

words.ex: One aspect of learning English is practicing speaking.
words.ex_cn: 学习英语的一个方面是练习口语。
words.en: An aspect of something is one of the parts of its character or nature.

words.tr:
n. 东西；原料；
v. 塞；填充；
words.ex: I need to clean up all this stuff.
words.ex_cn: 我需要清理这些东西。
words.en: If you stuff something somewhere, you push it there quickly and roughly. If you stuff a container or space with something, you fill it completely with that thing.

words.tr:
n. 帽子；
v. 覆盖…的顶部；
words.ex: He wore a blue cap to the park.
words.ex_cn: 他戴着一顶蓝色的帽子去公园。
words.en: A cap is a soft, flat hat with a peak at the front. Caps are usually worn by men and boys. A cap is also a protective lid or cover for a bottle, jar, or other container.

words.tr:
adv. 向前；前进；
v. 促进；转交；
adj. 向前的；前进的；
words.ex: He walked forward to meet the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他向前走去见老师。
words.en: If you move or look forward, you move or look in a direction that is in front of you. In British English, you can also say that you are looking forward to something that is going to happen.

words.ex: He kept the dishes in the cabinet.
words.ex_cn: 他把盘子放在储藏柜里。
words.en: A cabinet is a piece of furniture with doors and shelves or drawers, used for storing or showing things. In politics, a cabinet is a group of people who are chosen by a head of state to give advice and to help set government policy.

words.ex: He wears a badge on his shirt.
words.ex_cn: 他衬衫上戴着一枚徽章。
words.en: A badge is a small piece of metal, plastic, or cloth which you wear in order to show people that you have a particular rank, job, or belong to a particular group.

words.tr:
n. 出纳员，收银员
v. 革除（军职）
words.ex: The cashier counted the money at the end of the day.
words.ex_cn: 收银员在一天结束时清点了钱。
words.en: A cashier is a person whose job is to receive and pay out money in a shop, bank, or business.

words.tr:
adj. 辅助的；附属的
n. 辅助物；附属物；助动词
words.ex: He used an auxiliary verb to form the past tense.
words.ex_cn: 他使用了一个助动词来构成过去时。
words.en: An auxiliary is a person or thing that provides additional help or support.

words.ex: The central park is in the middle of the city.
words.ex_cn: 中央公园位于城市中心。
words.en: Something that is central is of key or fundamental importance.

words.tr:
adj. 偏远的；久远的；
n. 遥控器；
words.ex: The village is in a remote area far from the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄位于远离城市的偏远地区。
words.en: Remote areas are far away from cities and places where most people live, and are therefore difficult to get to.

words.ex: I ate chicken for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我晚餐吃了鸡肉。
words.en: A chicken is a bird that is kept on a farm for its eggs and meat.

words.ex: I will go to the park on Friday.
words.ex_cn: 我将在星期五去公园。
words.en: Friday is the day of the week between Thursday and Saturday.

words.ex: The cloud floats high in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 云朵在天空中飘浮。
words.en: A cloud is a visible mass of condensed water vapor floating in the atmosphere, typically high above the ground.

words.tr: adj. 相关的；有联系的； v. 关联；“relate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: This book is related to science.
words.ex_cn: 这本书与科学相关。
words.en: If two or more things are related, there is a connection between them.

words.tr:
adj. 集体的；
n. 集体；
words.ex: The collective decision was made by all members.
words.ex_cn: 这个集体决定是由所有成员做出的。
words.en: done or shared by all members of a group of people

words.ex: He didn't refer to the book during the talk.
words.ex_cn: 他在演讲中没有提到那本书。
words.en: If you refer to a particular subject or person, you talk about them or mention them. If you refer to someone or something as a particular thing, you use a particular word, expression, or name to mention or describe them.

words.tr: n. 参考；提及；介绍信；引用；
words.ex: Please use this book for reference.
words.ex_cn: 请使用这本书作为参考。
words.en: A reference is a mention of something or someone, or a letter or statement about someone's character or abilities.

words.ex: He hurt his leg while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤了腿。
words.en: If you hurt someone, you cause them to feel pain. If you hurt a part of your body, you feel pain there. If someone is hurt, they are injured.

words.tr:
adj. 同性恋的；愉快的
n. 同性恋者
words.ex: He is a gay teacher who loves his students.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位同性恋老师，深爱他的学生。
words.en: Someone who is gay is homosexual.

words.ex: We stayed at a small hotel near the beach.
words.ex_cn: 我们住在海边一家小旅馆里。
words.en: A hotel is a building where people stay, for example on holiday, paying for their rooms and meals.

words.ex: This job requires patience.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作需要耐心。
words.en: If you require something, you need it or want it.

words.tr: n. 需求；要求；必要条件；
words.ex: The job has a requirement of two years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作的要求是两年经验。
words.en: A requirement is something that is necessary or that must be done.

words.ex: She gave him a gift for his birthday.
words.ex_cn: 她送了他一份生日礼物。
words.en: A gift is something that you give someone as a present. It can also refer to a natural ability or talent.

words.ex: He responded to the question quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快回答了问题。
words.en: If you respond to something that is done or said, you react to it by doing or saying something yourself.

words.tr:
n. 需求；要求；
v. 要求；需求；
words.ex: The demand for clean water is increasing.
words.ex_cn: 对清洁水的需求正在增加。
words.en: If you demand something, you ask for it very forcefully, often because you think you have a right to do so.

words.tr:
n. 社论；
adj. 编辑的；
words.ex: The newspaper published an editorial about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 报纸发表了一篇关于气候变化的社论。
words.en: An editorial is an article in a newspaper which gives the opinion of the editor or publisher on a topic or item of news.

words.tr: v. 不赞成；反对；不同意
words.ex: My parents disapprove of my choice.
words.ex_cn: 我的父母不赞成我的选择。
words.en: If you disapprove of something, you have a negative opinion of it, often because you think it is wrong or not suitable.

words.tr:
adj. 不赞成的；表示反对的
v. 不赞成；反对；不同意；“disapprove”的现在分词
words.ex: She gave me a disapproving look.
words.ex_cn: 她不满地看了我一眼。
words.en: Showing or feeling disapproval.

words.ex: He showed his disapproval by staying silent.
words.ex_cn: 他通过保持沉默表示反对。
words.en: Disapproval is the feeling that someone or something is bad, wrong, or unacceptable.

words.ex: He emphasizes the importance of homework.
words.ex_cn: 他强调作业的重要性。
words.en: To give special importance or prominence to (something) in speaking or writing.

words.ex: The teacher put emphasis on reading every day.
words.ex_cn: 老师强调每天都要阅读。
words.en: Special importance, value, or prominence given to something.

words.tr: adj. 强调的；明确表示的；加强语气的
words.ex: He gave an emphatic no to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了坚决的否定。
words.en: An emphatic statement or response is expressed in a very forceful and clear way.

words.ex: The doctor prescribed a drug for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他开了一种治疗头痛的药物。
words.en: A drug is a substance which is used to treat an illness, relieve a symptom, or modify a chemical process in the body for a specific purpose.

words.ex: He gave an explicit answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了明确的答案。
words.en: Something that is explicit is expressed or shown clearly and openly, without any attempt to hide anything.

words.ex: The teacher will determine the winner of the contest.
words.ex_cn: 老师将确定比赛的获胜者。
words.en: If you determine something, you decide it or settle it.

words.tr: v. 决心；决定；“determine”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 坚决的；坚定的；有决心的；
words.ex: He is determined to finish the race.
words.ex_cn: 他决心完成比赛。
words.en: If you are determined to do something, you have made a firm decision to do it and will not let anything stop you.

words.ex: The car has a strong engine.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有一个强劲的发动机。
words.en: An engine is a machine that converts energy into mechanical force and motion.

words.ex: The factory makes cars.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂生产汽车。
words.en: A factory is a large building where machines are used to make goods in large quantities.

words.tr: adj. 未加工处理过的；生的；
words.ex: He eats raw vegetables every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃未加工的蔬菜。
words.en: Raw refers to something that is in its natural state and not processed or cooked.

words.ex: He plays golf every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都打高尔夫。
words.en: Golf is a game in which you use long sticks called clubs to hit a small hard ball into holes that are spread out over a large area of grassy land.

words.tr:
n. 家；家庭；
adv. 在家；
adj. 家的；家庭的；
words.ex: I love to go home after work.
words.ex_cn: 我下班后喜欢回家。
words.en: The place where one lives permanently, especially as a member of a family or household.

words.tr:
adv. 远；极；
adj. 较远的；遥远的；
words.ex: He ran far from the house.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得离房子很远。
words.en: At, to, or by a great distance (used to indicate the extent to which one thing is distant from another).

words.ex: He made a mistake in haste.
words.ex_cn: 他匆忙中犯了一个错误。
words.en: Haste is the quality of doing something quickly, sometimes too quickly so that you are careless and make mistakes.

words.tr: adj. 匆忙的；草率的；急躁的
words.ex: He made a hasty decision and regretted it.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个仓促的决定，后来后悔了。
words.en: If you describe a person or their behavior as hasty, you mean that they are acting too quickly, without thinking carefully, often with unwanted results.

words.ex: He kept the receipt for his new shoes.
words.ex_cn: 他保留了新鞋的收据。
words.en: A receipt is a piece of paper that you get from someone as proof that they have received money or goods from you.

words.tr: adj. 引起兴趣的； v. 吸引；“appeal”的现在分词；
words.ex: The book has an appealing story.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有一个引人入胜的故事。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as appealing, you mean that you like them or they make you want to have or do something.

words.tr: n. 奖金；红利；额外津贴；
words.ex: He received a bonus for working overtime.
words.ex_cn: 他因加班获得了奖金。
words.en: A bonus is an extra amount of money that is added to someone's pay, usually because they have worked very hard.

words.tr: adj. 攻击性的；有进取心的；侵略性的；
words.ex: The dog showed aggressive behavior toward strangers.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗对陌生人表现出攻击性行为。
words.en: An aggressive person or animal has a quality of anger and determination that makes them ready to attack others.

words.ex: The aggression of the army caused many deaths.
words.ex_cn: 军队的侵略导致了许多人死亡。
words.en: Aggression is a violent or hostile behavior towards another person or country.

words.tr: n. 进攻性；侵略性；积极进取
words.ex: His aggressiveness scared the other players.
words.ex_cn: 他的攻击性吓到了其他球员。
words.en: Aggressiveness is the quality of being aggressive, characterized by or tending toward unprovoked offensives, attacks, invasions, or the like; militantly forward or menacing.

words.ex: He brings his lunch to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天带午饭去上班。
words.en: To bring something means to carry or convey it to the place where you are or to the place you are talking about.

words.ex: He speaks slowly, using an adverb to describe how he talks.
words.ex_cn: 他说话很慢，用一个副词来描述他说话的方式。
words.en: An adverb is a word that modifies a verb, an adjective, another adverb, or a whole sentence, often answering questions such as how?, when?, where?, or to what extent?.

words.tr:
v. 举起；投掷；起伏；喘息；呕吐
n. 举；投；掷；起伏
words.ex: He heave the box onto the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把箱子举到了桌子上。
words.en: To lift or haul something heavy with great effort; to throw something forcefully; to rise and fall rhythmically or with effort.

words.tr:
prep. 关于；大约；大概；涉及；
adv. 大约；到处；
words.ex: The book is about animals.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是关于动物的。
words.en: If you talk about something, you are discussing it or mentioning it. If you do something about a problem, you take action to solve it.

words.ex: The children play on the grass after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在草地上玩耍。
words.en: Grass is a very common plant consisting of large numbers of thin, spiky, green leaves that cover the surface of the ground.

words.tr:
n. 账户；叙述；账目；
v. 占…；说明；
words.ex: I opened a bank account last week.
words.ex_cn: 我上周开了一家银行账户。
words.en: An account is a detailed report or description of an event or situation.

words.tr: adj. 负有责任的；应作解释的
words.ex: He is accountable for his mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 他要为自己的错误负责。
words.en: If you are accountable to someone for something that you do, you are responsible for it and must be prepared to justify your actions to that person.

words.tr: v. 解释说明；“account”的现在分词； n. 会计；会计学；
words.ex: He is accounting for his absence.
words.ex_cn: 他正在解释他的缺席。
words.en: Accounting is the process of keeping financial accounts.

words.ex: He works as an accountant in a small company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小公司当会计师。
words.en: An accountant is a person whose job is to keep, inspect, and analyze financial accounts.

words.tr:
adj. 高的；
adv. 在高处；
words.ex: The mountain is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这座山很高。
words.en: If something is high, it is a long way above the ground, above sea level, or above a particular point.

words.ex: The actress sings in the movie.
words.ex_cn: 这位女演员在电影中唱歌。
words.en: An actress is a woman whose profession is acting on the stage, in films, or on television.

words.tr:
n. 害怕；惧怕；
v. 害怕；惧怕；
words.ex: He felt a deep fear when he saw the snake.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到蛇时，感到深深的害怕。
words.en: An unpleasant emotion caused by the threat of danger, pain, or harm.

words.tr:
n. 反面；
v. 使倒转；（使）倒车；撤销；
words.ex: The reverse of the coin has a picture of a tree.
words.ex_cn: 硬币的反面有一棵树的图案。
words.en: If you reverse the order of a set of things, you arrange them in the opposite order, so that the first thing comes last.

words.ex: The guest arrived at the party early.
words.ex_cn: 客人早早到了派对。
words.en: A guest is someone who is visiting a place or attending an event by invitation, without having a permanent role there.

words.ex: The fierce lion chased the deer.
words.ex_cn: 那只凶猛的狮子追赶着鹿。
words.en: A fierce animal or person is very aggressive or angry.

words.ex: She carries a red handbag to work.
words.ex_cn: 她带着一个红色的手提包去上班。
words.en: A handbag is a small bag used by women to carry personal items.

words.tr:
adv. 非常；很；
adj. 恰好是；正是；
words.ex: He is very happy today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天非常开心。
words.en: Used to emphasize the degree or extent of something.

words.ex: I have two apples.
words.ex_cn: 我有两个苹果。
words.en: The number equivalent to the sum of one and one; one less than three.

words.ex: The pupil writes with a pencil in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个小学生在课堂上用铅笔写字。
words.en: A pupil is a child or young person who is being taught in a school or by a private tutor.

words.ex: The waiter brought us water and menus.
words.ex_cn: 服务员给我们端来了水和菜单。
words.en: A waiter is a man who works in a restaurant, serving people with food and drink.

words.ex: He was born in the year 2000.
words.ex_cn: 他出生于2000年。
words.en: A year is a period of time that is approximately equal to the time it takes for the Earth to make one complete orbit around the Sun.

words.ex: He prays every morning before breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃早餐前祈祷。
words.en: To pray means to speak to God in order to give thanks or to ask for something.

words.ex: The scholar published a book about ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 这位学者出版了一本关于古代历史的书。
words.en: A scholar is a person who studies an academic subject and knows a lot about it.

words.ex: He won a scholarship to study at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了一项去哈佛学习的奖学金。
words.en: A scholarship is a grant or payment made to support a student's education, awarded on the basis of academic or other achievement.

words.tr: adj. 令人惊异的；令人惊叹的； v. “amaze”的现在分词；
words.ex: The view from the mountain is amazing.
words.ex_cn: 从山上看到的景色令人惊异。
words.en: If something is amazing, it is very surprising and makes you feel pleasure or admiration.

words.ex: We walked along the seaside at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 我们在日落时沿着海边散步。
words.en: The area by the sea, especially a beach area where people go for holidays.

words.ex: He grew a thick beard last winter.
words.ex_cn: 去年冬天他留了一脸浓密的胡须。
words.en: The hair that grows on a man's chin and cheeks.

words.ex: He is selfish and never shares his toys.
words.ex_cn: 他很自私，从不分享他的玩具。
words.en: If you say that someone is selfish, you mean that they only care about their own interests and do not consider the needs or feelings of other people.

words.ex: He is a competent teacher who helps students easily.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有能力的老师，能轻松帮助学生。
words.en: If you are competent to do something, you have the skills, abilities, or experience necessary to do it well.

words.ex: His competence in math helped him solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学方面的能力帮助他解决了这个问题。
words.en: Competence is the ability to do something well or efficiently.

words.tr: adj. 无能力的；不称职的；不能胜任的；
words.ex: He is incompetent at managing simple tasks.
words.ex_cn: 他无法胜任简单的任务。
words.en: If you describe someone as incompetent, you are criticizing them because they are unable to do their job or a task properly.

words.ex: His incompetence caused the project to fail.
words.ex_cn: 他的无能力导致项目失败。
words.en: If you refer to someone's incompetence, you are criticizing them because they are unable to do their job or a task properly.

words.tr: v. 设置；放；“set”的现在分词； n. 环境；背景；
words.ex: He is setting the alarm for 6 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 他正在把闹钟设置为早上6点。
words.en: The context and environment in which something is set or takes place.

words.tr: adj. 刻板的；坚硬的；严格的；
words.ex: He has a rigid attitude toward rules.
words.ex_cn: 他对规则的态度很刻板。
words.en: not able to be changed or adapted; not able to be bent or moved; stiff

words.tr:
v. 使脱落；去除；
n. 棚屋；
words.ex: The tree sheds its leaves in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树在秋天落叶。
words.en: A shed is a small building, usually made of wood, used for storing things such as garden tools. When something sheds, it loses its covering, such as leaves or hair, or it gets rid of something it no longer needs.

words.tr:
n. 圆；圈；
v. 圈出；环绕；
words.ex: The child drew a circle with a pen.
words.ex_cn: 孩子用笔画了一个圆。
words.en: A circle is a shape consisting of a curved line completely surrounding an area. Every part of the line is the same distance from the centre of the area.

words.ex: He wants a short-term job before going to university.
words.ex_cn: 他在上大学之前想找一份短期工作。
words.en: relating to a period of time that is not long, especially a few weeks or months

words.tr: adj. 滑稽的；好笑的；有趣的；
words.ex: The funny clown made everyone laugh.
words.ex_cn: 那个滑稽的小丑让所有人都笑了。
words.en: Something that is funny is amusing and likely to make you laugh.

words.tr: adj. 重大的；重要的；影响明显的；
words.ex: This discovery is a significant step forward.
words.ex_cn: 这一发现是一个重大的进步。
words.en: Something that is significant is important or large enough to be noticed or to have an effect.

words.ex: He wiped sweat from his forehead.
words.ex_cn: 他擦去了额头上的汗水。
words.en: The part of the face above the eyebrows and below the hairline.

words.ex: The situation is very serious.
words.ex_cn: 这种情况非常严重。
words.en: A situation is all the circumstances and things that are happening at a particular time and in a particular place.

words.ex: The law obliges drivers to wear seat belts.
words.ex_cn: 法律迫使司机系安全带。
words.en: If you are obliged to do something, you have to do it because the situation, the law, a duty, etc., makes it necessary.

words.ex: He felt an obligation to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他感到有义务帮助他的朋友。
words.en: An obligation is something that you must do because you have promised, because of a law, etc.

words.ex: He has a slight cold.
words.ex_cn: 他有点轻微的感冒。
words.en: A slight change, difference, or action is not very great or important.

words.ex: The noise from the street kept me awake.
words.ex_cn: 街道上的噪声让我睡不着。
words.en: Noise is a sound, especially one that is loud, unpleasant, or disturbing.

words.ex: The price of oil soared last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月石油价格骤升。
words.en: To rise or increase dramatically in amount or level.

words.ex: The rocket's thrust lifted it into the sky.
words.ex_cn: 火箭的推力将它送上了天空。
words.en: To thrust something somewhere means to push it there quickly and forcefully. A thrust is also a powerful push or movement.

words.tr: adv. 以某种方式；不知何故；
words.ex: Somehow, he finished the race despite the injury.
words.ex_cn: 不知怎么的，他尽管受伤了还是完成了比赛。
words.en: You use somehow to say that you do not know or cannot say how something was done or will be done.

words.ex: He tried to conceal the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他试图隐藏真相。
words.en: If you conceal something, you prevent it from being seen or known about.

words.ex: He sows seeds in the garden every spring.
words.ex_cn: 他每年春天都在花园里播种。
words.en: To sow means to plant seeds in the ground so that they will grow into plants.

words.ex: He worked hard to attain his goals.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以达到他的目标。
words.en: If you attain something, you gain it or achieve it, often after a lot of effort.

words.tr:
v. 拼写；意味着；
n. 一段时间；
words.ex: Can you spell your name?
words.ex_cn: 你能拼出你的名字吗？
words.en: If you spell a word, you write or speak each letter in the correct order.

words.ex: I found a great bargain at the market.
words.ex_cn: 我在市场上找到了一件便宜货。
words.en: A bargain is an agreement between two people or groups in which each promises to do something in exchange for something else. It can also refer to something bought or offered for sale much more cheaply than is usual or expected.

words.tr:
n. 委员会；佣金；
v. 委托；
words.ex: The commission met to discuss the new law.
words.ex_cn: 委员会开会讨论新法律。
words.en: A commission is a group of people who have been appointed to find out about something or to control something, or the act of doing this. It can also refer to a sum of money that is paid to someone for selling something, which is usually a percentage of the value of the goods sold.

words.tr:
n. 公司；商行；
adj. 坚固的；结实的；
words.ex: He works for a small firm in London.
words.ex_cn: 他在伦敦一家小公司工作。
words.en: If something is firm, it does not change much in shape when it is pressed but is not completely hard. A firm is an organization which sells or produces something or which provides a service which people pay for.

words.ex: The cat sat on the roof.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在屋顶上。
words.en: The roof of a building is the covering on top of it that protects the people and things inside from the weather.

words.ex: She adds flour to make bread.
words.ex_cn: 她加面粉来做面包。
words.en: Flour is a powder made by grinding raw grains, roots, beans, nuts, or seeds. It is used to make many different foods.

words.tr:
v. 经营；跑步；
n. 运转；跑；
words.ex: He runs a small coffee shop.
words.ex_cn: 他经营一家小咖啡馆。
words.en: To move quickly on foot so that both feet leave the ground during each stride.

words.ex: The satellite sends pictures from space.
words.ex_cn: 卫星从太空发送图片。
words.en: A satellite is an object which has been sent into space in order to collect information or to be part of a communications system. Satellites move continually round the earth or around another planet.

words.tr: adj. 紧张不安的；神经系统的；
words.ex: He felt nervous before the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前感到紧张不安。
words.en: If someone is nervous, they are frightened or worried about something that is happening or might happen, and show this in their behavior.

words.tr: v. 想；认为；“think”的现在分词； n. 思想；想法；
words.ex: I am thinking about my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我正在想我的作业。
words.en: The process of using your mind to consider something carefully.

words.ex: The teacher define the word 'love' in simple terms.
words.ex_cn: 老师用简单的词给‘爱’下定义。
words.en: If you define something, you show, describe, or state clearly what it is and what its limits are, or what it is like.

words.ex: Her family is middle-class and lives in a small house.
words.ex_cn: 她的家庭是中产阶级，住在一所小房子里。
words.en: The middle class is the social group that is between the upper class and the working class, typically including professionals, business people, and their families.

words.ex: I sympathize with people who are hungry.
words.ex_cn: 我同情那些挨饿的人。
words.en: If you sympathize with someone who is in a bad situation, you feel sorry for them.

words.tr:
v. 粘附；（随意）放置；忍受；
n. 棍枝；条状物；球棍；
words.ex: The glue makes the paper stick to the table.
words.ex_cn: 胶水使纸粘在桌子上。
words.en: A stick is a thin branch which has fallen off a tree. If you stick something somewhere, you put it there in a rather casual way.

words.ex: He bought a gift for his spouse.
words.ex_cn: 他给他的配偶买了一份礼物。
words.en: A spouse is a person's partner in marriage.

words.ex: He showed his identity card to enter the building.
words.ex_cn: 他出示了身份证以进入大楼。
words.en: Your identity is who you are, or the qualities of a person or group that make them different from others.

words.ex: He reads a science journal every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周读一本科学期刊。
words.en: A journal is a newspaper or magazine that deals with a particular subject or professional activity.

words.ex: He is impatient when he waits for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他等公交车时很不耐烦。
words.en: If you are impatient, you are easily annoyed by delays or by people making mistakes.

words.ex: He is an architect who designs houses.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位设计房屋的建筑师。
words.en: An architect is a person who designs buildings and advises in their construction.

words.tr: adj. 不完全的；不完整的；
words.ex: The puzzle is incomplete without the last piece.
words.ex_cn: 没有最后一块，这个拼图是不完全的。
words.en: If something is incomplete, it is not yet finished, or it does not have all the parts that it should have.

words.ex: He kick the ball into the goal.
words.ex_cn: 他把球踢进了球门。
words.en: To strike or propel with the foot; a blow or thrust delivered by the foot.

words.ex: This product is inferior to the other one.
words.ex_cn: 这个产品比另一个差。
words.en: If one person or thing is inferior to another, they are not as good, important, or valuable as the other person or thing.

words.tr:
n. 跳跃；
v. 跳跃；
words.ex: The cat made a big leap over the fence.
words.ex_cn: 猫跳过了篱笆。
words.en: To leap means to jump high or a long way, or to move quickly and with a lot of energy.

words.tr: adj. 疯狂的；精神失常的；精神错乱的
words.ex: He thinks it's insane to drive without a license.
words.ex_cn: 他认为无证驾驶是疯狂的。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as insane, you mean that they are very foolish or crazy.

words.tr:
n. 标签；
v. 用标签标明；
words.ex: The bottle has a label with the name of the drink.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子上有一个写着饮料名称的标签。
words.en: A label is a piece of paper, polymer, cloth, metal, or other material affixed to a container or article, on which is written or printed information or symbols about the product or item.

words.ex: The vase remained intact after the fall.
words.ex_cn: 花瓶从高处摔下后依然完整无缺。
words.en: Something that is intact is complete and has not been damaged or changed.

words.ex: The town lost electricity during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴期间，这个城镇停电了。
words.en: A form of energy resulting from the existence of charged particles (such as electrons or protons), either statically as an accumulation of charge or dynamically as a current.

words.ex: The teacher gave a simple interpretation of the poem.
words.ex_cn: 老师对这首诗做了一个简单的解释。
words.en: An interpretation of something is an explanation or understanding of it.

words.ex: Let me help you with your homework.
words.ex_cn: 让我帮你做作业。
words.en: To allow or permit something to happen or someone to do something.

words.ex: The disposal of waste is important for the environment.
words.ex_cn: 废物的处理对环境很重要。
words.en: The act or process of getting rid of something, especially by throwing it away or selling it.

words.ex: Farmers use irrigation to water their crops.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用灌溉来浇灌庄稼。
words.en: Irrigation is the process of supplying water to land or crops to help growth, typically by means of channels.

words.ex: I haven't seen him lately.
words.ex_cn: 我最近没见到他。
words.en: If you say that something has happened lately, you mean that it has happened recently.

words.ex: The sun descends behind the hills.
words.ex_cn: 太阳在山后落下。
words.en: If you descend or if you descend a staircase, you move downwards from a higher to a lower level.

words.ex: He is a descendant of the first king.
words.ex_cn: 他是第一位国王的后裔。
words.en: A person, plant, or animal that is descended from a particular ancestor.

words.tr: v. 举例说明；例证；例示
words.ex: This example exemplifies the rule clearly.
words.ex_cn: 这个例子清楚地说明了这条规则。
words.en: To exemplify means to be a typical example of something or to give an example of something.

words.tr:
n. 特点；特性；
adj. 典型的；特有的；
words.ex: Honesty is a key characteristic of a good friend.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是一个好朋友的关键特点。
words.en: A characteristic is a quality or feature that is typical of someone or something.

words.ex: The blind man walks with a white cane.
words.ex_cn: 这位失明的男人用白色手杖走路。
words.en: Unable to see; lacking the sense of sight.

words.ex: The sentence has a clause that explains why he left.
words.ex_cn: 这个句子有一个解释他为什么离开的从句。
words.en: A clause is a particular section of a legal document such as a contract, will, or treaty, that contains a condition or stipulation.

words.tr:
v. 撞；碰上；颠簸行进；
n. 碰撞；猛击；肿块；凸块；
words.ex: He bumped the table and spilled his drink.
words.ex_cn: 他撞到了桌子，打翻了饮料。
words.en: If you bump into something or someone, you accidentally hit them while you are moving.

words.ex: He protects the environment by recycling.
words.ex_cn: 他通过回收利用来保护环境。
words.en: The environment is the natural world in which people, animals, and plants live.

words.tr:
prep. 在…后面；
adv. 在后面；
words.ex: The cat is behind the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 猫在沙发后面。
words.en: If something is behind a thing or person, it is on the far side of them as they face you, or is in a back part of them.

words.tr:
adj. 全部的；
adv. 全部地；
n. 全部；
words.ex: All the students passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 所有学生都通过了考试。
words.en: All is used to indicate that every part of something or every one of a group is included or involved.

words.ex: The brain controls our thoughts and movements.
words.ex_cn: 大脑控制我们的思想和行动。
words.en: The brain is the organ inside your head that controls your body's activities and enables you to think and to feel things such as heat and pain.

words.ex: The teacher will announce the results tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 老师明天将宣布结果。
words.en: To announce something means to make it known publicly or officially.

words.tr:
n. 努力争取；出价；投标；
v. 出价；投标；
words.ex: His bid for the championship inspired everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他为冠军所做的努力鼓舞了所有人。
words.en: To bid means to offer a particular amount of money for something that is being sold, especially at an auction, or to offer to do work or provide services for a particular price.

words.ex: I do my homework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我每天晚上做作业。
words.en: To perform or accomplish something

words.tr: adj. 西方的；西洋的；西部的；
words.ex: He likes western music and movies.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢西方的音乐和电影。
words.en: Western means relating to the countries of the West, especially Europe and America.

words.tr:
n. 踪迹；轨道；小路；跑道；
v. 追踪；跟踪；
words.ex: The dog followed the track of the rabbit.
words.ex_cn: 狗跟着兔子的踪迹。
words.en: A track is a path or route along which something moves or travels. It can also refer to marks left by something that has passed, or the act of following such marks to find someone or something.

words.ex: His wisdom helped the team solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他的智慧帮助团队解决了问题。
words.en: Wisdom is the ability to use your knowledge and experience to make good decisions and judgments.

words.tr:
v. 抗议；
n. 抗议活动；
words.ex: The students protest against the new school rules.
