n. 划分；分歧；
words.ex: The tree split in the storm.
words.ex_cn: 那棵树在风暴中裂开了。
words.en: If something splits or if you split it, it is divided into two or more parts.

words.ex: He retains his old photos in a box.
words.ex_cn: 他把旧照片保存在一个盒子里。
words.en: If you retain something, you keep it or continue to have it.

words.ex: The navy launched a large fleet to protect the coast.
words.ex_cn: 海军派出了一支大型舰队来保护海岸。
words.en: A fleet is a group of ships or vehicles that are controlled by one company or organization and are used for a particular purpose.

words.tr:
n. 烤肉；烘烤；
adj. 烤的；焙的；
v. 烤；烘烤；
words.ex: We had roast for dinner last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚我们吃了烤肉。
words.en: To cook food, such as meat, in an oven or over a fire.

words.tr: adj. 惯常的；习惯性的；经常的；
words.ex: He is a habitual smoker.
words.ex_cn: 他是个惯常的吸烟者。
words.en: A habitual action, state, or way of behaving is one that someone usually does or has, especially one that is considered to be typical or characteristic of them.

words.ex: She is fond of chocolate.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢巧克力。
words.en: If you are fond of someone or something, you feel affection for them or like them very much.

words.ex: The royal family lives in a big palace.
words.ex_cn: 皇室住在一座大宫殿里。
words.en: Royal is used to describe something that is connected with a king, queen, or emperor, or with their family. It can also describe something that is splendid or magnificent, befitting a king or queen.

words.ex: I ate a fresh salad for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 我午餐吃了一份新鲜的色拉。
words.en: A salad is a mixture of raw vegetables such as lettuce, cucumber, and tomatoes, often served with a dressing.

words.ex: The teacher gave us important information about the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们关于考试的重要信息。
words.en: Information is facts or details about a subject, event, or situation.

words.tr:
n. 哭泣；落泪
v. 流泪；流出
words.ex: Her weep lasted for hours after the news.
words.ex_cn: 听到消息后，她的哭泣持续了数小时。
words.en: To shed tears, especially as an expression of distress or pain.

words.ex: He plays volleyball every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他每个星期六打排球。
words.en: A game played by two teams of six players in which a large ball is hit by hand over a high net, the aim being to score points by making the ball reach the ground on the opponent's side of the court.

words.ex: He wants to publish a book next year.
words.ex_cn: 他想明年出版一本书。
words.en: To produce and issue printed material for public distribution or sale; to make information or work available to the public.

words.ex: You should believe in yourself.
words.ex_cn: 你应该相信自己。
words.en: Used to refer to the person being addressed as the object of a verb or preposition when they are also the subject of the clause.

words.ex: She usually walks to school.
words.ex_cn: 她通常走路去学校。
words.en: Under normal conditions; generally.

words.ex: The factory increases its production every year.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂每年都在增加生产。
words.en: Production refers to the process of manufacturing or growing something in large quantities, or the amount of something that is manufactured or grown.

words.tr: adj. 愿意的；乐意的； v. “will”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is willing to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他愿意帮助他的朋友。
words.en: If someone is willing to do something, they are happy to do it if it is needed.

words.ex: The bank recorded the transaction quickly.
words.ex_cn: 银行迅速记录了这笔交易。
words.en: A transaction is an instance of buying or selling something; a business deal.

words.ex: The team reached a consensus on the project plan.
words.ex_cn: 团队就项目计划达成了共识。
words.en: A consensus is general agreement among a group of people.

words.ex: The consumer buys food at the store.
words.ex_cn: 消费者在商店购买食物。
words.en: A consumer is a person who buys goods or uses services.

words.ex: The movie is controversial because it shows violence.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影因为展示暴力而有争议。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as controversial, you mean that they are the subject of intense public argument, disagreement, or disapproval.

words.tr:
n. 核；核心；重点；
adj. 核心的；
words.ex: The core of the apple is not edible.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的核心不能吃。
words.en: The central or most important part of something.

words.ex: He writes in his diary every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都写日记。
words.en: A diary is a book in which you write down your personal experiences and thoughts each day.

words.ex: The desert seems endless.
words.ex_cn: 这片沙漠看起来无穷无尽。
words.en: If you say that something is endless, you mean that it is very large or lasts for a very long time, and it seems as if it will never stop.

words.ex: The cat sat on the side of the bed.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在床的旁边。
words.en: One of the two or more parts or areas into which something is divided, or one of the two surfaces of something flat and thin, such as paper.

words.ex: He lives in the dormitory with three roommates.
words.ex_cn: 他和三个室友住在宿舍里。
words.en: A dormitory is a large bedroom where many people sleep, especially in a school or college.

words.ex: He believed his fate was to become a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他相信自己的命运是成为一名教师。
words.en: Fate is a power that is believed to control what happens in the future.

words.ex: The cow has two long horns.
words.ex_cn: 这头牛有两只长角。
words.en: A horn is a pointed projection on the head of various animals, consisting of a core of bone surrounded by a sheath of keratin, or a device for making a loud warning noise.

words.ex: He gave a sincere apology.
words.ex_cn: 他真诚地道歉了。
words.en: If you say that someone is sincere, you approve of them because they really mean the things they say.

words.tr:
n. 一系列；（变化）范围；山脉；
v. （在某范围内）变化；包括（各种不同的人或物）；
words.ex: The store offers a range of colors.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店提供一系列颜色。
words.en: A range of things is a number of different things of the same general kind.

words.ex: I shall go to the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天要去公园。
words.en: used to indicate future action or intention, or to express obligation or necessity

words.tr: adj. 温和的；文雅的；温柔的；
words.ex: The mother gave a gentle hug to her child.
words.ex_cn: 母亲给了孩子一个温和的拥抱。
words.en: Someone who is gentle is kind and calm, and does not behave in a violent or harsh way.

words.ex: He became famous for his music and gained great fame.
words.ex_cn: 他因音乐而闻名，获得了巨大的名声。
words.en: the state of being known or talked about by many people, especially on account of notable achievements

words.ex: The headmistress speaks to the students every morning.
words.ex_cn: 女校长每天早上对学生讲话。
words.en: A headmistress is a woman who is the head teacher in a school.

words.ex: He ordered a steak for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐点了一份牛排。
words.en: A steak is a slice of meat, especially beef, that is cooked by grilling or frying.

words.ex: He is tired, and indeed he fell asleep quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很累，的确很快就睡着了。
words.en: You use indeed to confirm or agree with something that has just been said.

words.ex: The puppy is cute.
words.ex_cn: 这只小狗很可爱。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as cute, you mean that they are attractive, often in a childlike or youthful way.

words.ex: The body has a mechanism to fight viruses.
words.ex_cn: 人体有一种对抗病毒的机制。
words.en: A mechanism is a part of a machine that does a particular task, or a system that is intended to achieve something or deal with a problem.

words.tr:
adj. 死的；
n. 死人；
adv. 完全地；
words.ex: The dead bird lay on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 那只死鸟躺在地上。
words.en: No longer alive; deprived of life.

words.ex: The barn is used for storage of grain.
words.ex_cn: 这个谷仓用于粮食的贮存。
words.en: The act of storing something or the space where things are stored.

words.ex: The creature lived in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这个生物生活在森林里。
words.en: A creature is a living thing, especially an animal.

words.ex: The stars are bright at night.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚星星很亮。
words.en: The period of darkness in each twenty-four hours; the time from sunset to sunrise.

words.ex: She tied the box with a thin string.
words.ex_cn: 她用一根细线把盒子绑了起来。
words.en: A string is a thin piece of rope or cord, or a series of things connected together.

words.tr:
n. 混合；结合；
v. 混合；掺入；合成；交往；
words.ex: The recipe calls for a mix of flour and sugar.
words.ex_cn: 这个食谱需要一种面粉和糖的混合物。
words.en: To combine two or more substances so that they become a single substance, or to be combined in this way.

words.tr:
n. 叙述；叙事；
adj. 叙述性的；
words.ex: He told a simple narrative about his childhood.
words.ex_cn: 他讲了一个关于他童年的简单故事。
words.en: A narrative is a story or an account of a series of events.

words.tr:
n. 回声；
v. 回响；
words.ex: The echo came back from the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 回声从山上反弹回来。
words.en: An echo is a sound which is caused by a noise being reflected off a surface such as a wall.

words.ex: This district has many parks and schools.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区有许多公园和学校。
words.en: A district is a part of a city, country, or other area that has been officially designated for a particular purpose, such as administration or business.

words.ex: He is eighty years old.
words.ex_cn: 他八十岁了。
words.en: The number 80.

words.tr:
n. 化合物；
adj. 复合的；混合的；
words.ex: Water is a compound of hydrogen and oxygen.
words.ex_cn: 水是由氢和氧组成的化合物。
words.en: A compound is a substance that consists of two or more elements chemically combined in fixed proportions.

words.tr: adv. 到处；处处；各个地方；所有地方；
words.ex: She looked everywhere for her keys.
words.ex_cn: 她到处找她的钥匙。
words.en: in or to all places

words.ex: The baby is sleeping in the crib.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿正在婴儿床里睡觉。
words.en: A baby is a very young child, especially one that cannot yet walk or talk.

words.ex: This chair is very comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子非常舒适。
words.en: If a piece of furniture or an item of clothing is comfortable, it makes you feel physically relaxed when you use it or wear it, for example because it is soft.

words.ex: I like apples, and I also like oranges.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢苹果，我也喜欢橙子。
words.en: You use also to give more information about something or to add another relevant fact.

words.tr: n. 代码；编码；行为准则；密码；法典；
words.ex: He wrote a simple code to solve the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一段简单的代码来解决这个数学问题。
words.en: A code is a system of words, letters, figures, or other symbols substituted for other words, letters, etc., especially for the purposes of secrecy. As a verb, it means to convert (a message or other information) into a code.

words.ex: A bat flew out of the cave at night.
words.ex_cn: 一只蝙蝠在晚上从洞穴里飞了出来。
words.en: A bat is a piece of wood used to hit the ball in games such as cricket, baseball, and table tennis. It can also refer to a small animal that flies at night.

words.tr:
v. 鼓掌；拍手
n. 鼓掌；拍手
words.ex: The crowd will clap after the song.
words.ex_cn: 歌曲结束后，观众会鼓掌。
words.en: To clap means to strike the palms of your hands together to show appreciation or to make a noise.

words.ex: The police arrested the thief last night.
words.ex_cn: 警察昨晚逮捕了那个小偷。
words.en: If the police arrest you, they take charge of you and take you to a police station, because they believe you may have committed a crime.

words.ex: He chooses coffee every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都选择喝咖啡。
words.en: To choose means to select someone or something from a group of possibilities.

words.ex: The airline lost my luggage.
words.ex_cn: 这家航空公司弄丢了我的行李。
words.en: An airline is a company that provides regular flights to take passengers and goods to different places.

words.ex: His expectation was to pass the test.
words.ex_cn: 他的期待是通过考试。
words.en: An expectation is a belief about what might happen in the future, especially about something that you think is likely or that you hope will happen.

words.ex: It was disgraceful to lie to your teacher.
words.ex_cn: 对老师撒谎是可耻的。
words.en: If you say that something is disgraceful, you are emphasizing that it is very bad or wrong, and that you find it completely unacceptable.

words.tr: adj. 广大的；广阔的；广泛的；大量的；
words.ex: He has extensive knowledge of history.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有广博的历史知识。
words.en: Something that is extensive covers a wide area or includes a lot of things.

words.ex: The worker wore a mask to avoid breathing in dust.
words.ex_cn: 这位工人戴上口罩以避免吸入粉尘。
words.en: Dust is a layer of fine, dry particles on the surface of something, or the fine, dry particles themselves.

words.ex: He went to the embassy to get a visa.
words.ex_cn: 他去大使馆办理签证。
words.en: An embassy is a group of officials who represent their country in a foreign country, or the building where they work.

words.ex: The carpenter made a wooden table.
words.ex_cn: 木匠做了一张木桌子。
words.en: A carpenter is a person whose job is making and repairing wooden objects and structures.

words.ex: This small enterprise makes handmade toys.
words.ex_cn: 这家小企业生产手工玩具。
words.en: An enterprise is a company or business, often a large one, or a difficult or important project, especially one that involves a lot of planning and organization.

words.tr: adj. 可比较的；比得上的；类似的；
words.ex: The prices of these two phones are comparable.
words.ex_cn: 这两部手机的价格是可比较的。
words.en: Something that is comparable to something else is similar in size, amount, or quality.

words.ex: My ancestor came from China a hundred years ago.
words.ex_cn: 我的祖先一百年前来自中国。
words.en: An ancestor is a person from whom one is descended, typically more remote than a grandparent.

words.ex: He walks to class on campus every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上步行到校园上课。
words.en: The grounds and buildings of a university or college.

words.tr:
n. 绷带
v. 用绷带包扎
words.ex: He put a bandage on his cut finger.
words.ex_cn: 他在他割伤的手指上贴了绷带。
words.en: A bandage is a piece of material used to cover a wound or to support an injured part of the body.

words.ex: The rain ceased after an hour.
words.ex_cn: 一小时后，雨停了。
words.en: If something ceases, it stops happening or existing.

words.ex: He was born in August.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在八月。
words.en: August is the eighth month of the Gregorian calendar, following July and preceding September.

words.ex: The trees bud in spring.
words.ex_cn: 树木在春天发芽。
words.en: A bud is a small pointed lump that appears on a tree or plant and develops into a leaf or flower.

words.ex: He grew up in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 他是在农村长大的。
words.en: The countryside refers to the land and scenery of a rural area, often characterized by farms, fields, and small villages, away from urban centers.

words.tr:
v. 移动；搬家；
n. 行动；移动；
words.ex: Please move the chair.
words.ex_cn: 请移动椅子。
words.en: To change position or to cause something or someone to change position, especially in a particular direction or to a particular place.

words.ex: He touched his cheek gently.
words.ex_cn: 他轻轻摸了摸脸颊。
words.en: The soft part of a person's face below the eye and between the nose and ear.

words.ex: They drank champagne at the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 他们在婚礼上喝了香槟。
words.en: Champagne is an expensive French white wine with bubbles in. It is often drunk to celebrate something.

words.ex: We had an outdoor picnic last Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 上个星期天我们进行了户外野餐。
words.en: relating to or done in the open air; not inside a building

words.ex: I take the subway to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天坐地铁去上班。
words.en: An underground railway system in a city, usually operated by electricity, which provides a rapid means of transportation.

words.ex: The birds mate in spring.
words.ex_cn: 这些鸟在春天交配。
words.en: A mate is a friend, someone you work with, or someone you are married to or in a sexual relationship with. As a verb, to mate means to have sex in order to produce young or to bring two animals together for breeding.

words.tr:
v. 交谈；说话；
n. 谈话；
words.ex: They talk every evening after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天晚饭后都会交谈。
words.en: To speak in order to give information or express ideas or feelings; conversation or discussion.

words.ex: I love swimming in the sea during summer.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢在夏天去海里游泳。
words.en: Summer is the season between spring and autumn when the weather is usually warm or hot.

words.ex: The hacker broke into the computer system.
words.ex_cn: 这个黑客入侵了计算机系统。
words.en: A hacker is someone who is skilled at using computers and the internet, especially for finding out secret information or for causing damage to computer systems.

words.ex: The apple's flesh is sweet and juicy.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的果肉又甜又多汁。
words.en: The soft substance consisting of muscle and fat that is found between the skin and bones of an animal or a human.

words.tr:
v. 注册；登记；
n. 登记簿；
words.ex: He will register for the course next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会注册这门课程。
words.en: If you register something, you officially record it or list it.

words.ex: He eats healthy food every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃健康的食物。
words.en: Food is what people and animals eat to live and grow.

words.ex: He was reluctant to leave his home.
words.ex_cn: 他不愿意离开家。
words.en: If you are reluctant to do something, you are unwilling to do it and hesitate before doing it, or do it slowly and without enthusiasm.

words.ex: He gets a salary of 3000 dollars each month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月赚3000美元的工资。
words.en: A salary is the money that someone is paid each month by their employer, especially when they are in a profession such as teaching, law, or medicine.

words.ex: He is a former teacher who now works as a writer.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名以前的老师，现在是一名作家。
words.en: Former is used to describe someone who used to have a particular job, position, or role, but no longer has it.

chapters.name: 一般要求词汇 Word List 24

words.ex: He compare apples and oranges to see which is sweeter.
words.ex_cn: 他比较苹果和橙子，看看哪个更甜。
words.en: If you compare one thing with another, you consider the similarities and differences between them.

words.ex: The riot broke out after the game.
words.ex_cn: 比赛结束后爆发了骚乱。
words.en: A riot is a violent disturbance of the peace by a crowd.

words.ex: The tourist took photos at the museum.
words.ex_cn: 这位旅游者在博物馆拍照。
words.en: A tourist is a person who is visiting a place for pleasure and interest, especially when they are on holiday.

words.tr:
v. 赢；获得；
n. 胜利；赢得；
words.ex: I want to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 我想赢这场比赛。
words.en: to achieve first position and/or get a prize in a competition, election, fight, etc.

words.ex: He made a proposal to improve the school lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他提出了一个改善学校午餐的提案。
words.en: A proposal is a plan or suggestion, especially a formal one that is put forward for people to think about and decide upon.

words.tr: n. 效用；实用；公用事业；
words.ex: The utility of this tool is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具的效用非常高。
words.en: Utility refers to the state of being useful, profitable, or beneficial.

words.ex: I eat carrot and broccoli every day as vegetable.
words.ex_cn: 我每天吃胡萝卜和西兰花作为蔬菜。
words.en: A vegetable is a plant or part of a plant that is used as food, typically as accompaniment to meat or fish, such as a cabbage, potato, carrot, or bean.

words.ex: The doctor will weigh the baby at the clinic.
words.ex_cn: 医生将在诊所称量婴儿的体重。
words.en: To weigh something means to measure how heavy it is, usually by using scales. It can also mean to consider something carefully before making a decision.

words.tr: adj. 富有成效的；多产的；生产的；
words.ex: He had a productive day and finished all his work.
words.ex_cn: 他度过了富有成效的一天，完成了所有工作。
words.en: Producing or able to produce large amounts of goods, crops, or other commodities.

words.tr:
v. 转移；转让；调任；
n. 转移；转让；调任；
words.ex: He will transfer the money to his bank account.
words.ex_cn: 他将把钱转到他的银行账户。
words.en: If you transfer something or someone from one place to another, or they transfer from one place to another, they go from the first place to the second.

words.tr: v. 逐渐削弱；暗中损害；
words.ex: Constant criticism can undermine your confidence.
words.ex_cn: 不断的批评会逐渐削弱你的信心。
words.en: To undermine something means to weaken it or make it less effective, often in a gradual or sneaky way.

words.tr: n. 运动；动作；活动；乐章；
words.ex: The movement of the sun changes the shadow.
words.ex_cn: 太阳的运动改变了影子。
words.en: The act or process of moving or being moved; a change of position or place.

words.ex: She wears a necklace made of crystal.
words.ex_cn: 她戴一条水晶制成的项链。
words.en: A crystal is a solid that has a regular, repeating arrangement of atoms. Crystals are often transparent and can be used in jewelry or as decorative objects.

words.ex: The long meeting was tedious.
words.ex_cn: 这场漫长的会议很沉闷。
words.en: If you describe something such as a job, task, or situation as tedious, you mean it is boring and rather frustrating.

words.tr:
adj. 深的；
adv. 深深地；
n. 深处；
words.ex: The well is deep.
words.ex_cn: 这口井很深。
words.en: Extending far down from the top or surface; of great vertical extent.

words.tr:
n. 顺序；条理；命令；订单；(生物学的)目；
v. 订购；命令；点餐；整理；
words.ex: The books are in alphabetical order.
words.ex_cn: 这些书是按字母顺序排列的。
words.en: If you order someone to do something, you tell them to do it in a way that they have to obey. Order can also refer to the way things are arranged or a request to make or supply something.

words.ex: The country expanded its territory after the war.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家在战争后扩大了它的领土。
words.en: An area of land that is controlled by a particular country, ruler, or military force.

words.ex: He eats a nut every morning for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一颗坚果当早餐。
words.en: A nut is a fruit consisting of a hard or tough shell around an edible kernel. It is also a metal block with a threaded hole that is used with a bolt to fasten things together. Informally, it can refer to someone who is crazy or eccentric.

words.tr: adj. 奇怪的；奇数的；余的；
words.ex: He wore an odd hat to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了一顶奇怪的帽子去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as odd, you mean that they are strange or unusual.

words.ex: The climbers reached the summit of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 登山者到达了山顶。
words.en: The highest point of a hill or mountain; a meeting between heads of government.

words.ex: He checked the thermometer to see the temperature.
words.ex_cn: 他看了温度计来查看温度。
words.en: A thermometer is an instrument for measuring and indicating temperature.

words.tr: adv. 不管怎样；无论如何；
words.ex: I don't like the weather, but anyway, we will go for a walk.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢这天气，但不管怎样，我们会去散步。
words.en: You use anyway or anyhow to indicate that a statement explains or supports a previous point.

words.ex: He worked hard and succeeded in the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习，考试成功了。
words.en: To achieve something that you have been aiming for, or to take over a position or role after someone else.

words.ex: Please don't disturb me while I'm reading.
words.ex_cn: 我读书时请不要打扰我。
words.en: To disturb someone means to interrupt what they are doing and cause them inconvenience or annoyance.

words.ex: He was born in September.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在九月。
words.en: September is the ninth month of the year in the Gregorian calendar, coming after August and before October.

words.tr:
conj. 两者之一；
adv. 也（用于否定词组后）；
pron. 两者中的任何一个；（用于否定句）两者都不；
words.ex: You can have either tea or coffee.
words.ex_cn: 你可以喝茶或者咖啡，二选一。
words.en: Used before the first of two (or occasionally more) alternatives that are being specified (the other being introduced by ‘or’).

words.ex: The weather can dictate what we wear each day.
words.ex_cn: 天气可以支配我们每天穿什么。
words.en: To dictate means to say or read something aloud for someone else to write down, or to give orders in an authoritative manner.

words.ex: He acquired a new skill last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年获得了一项新技能。
words.en: If you acquire something, you buy or obtain it for yourself, or someone gives it to you.

words.ex: A gentle breeze blew through the trees.
words.ex_cn: 一阵微风轻轻吹过树梢。
words.en: A breeze is a gentle wind.

words.ex: The ticket is your admission to the concert.
words.ex_cn: 这张票是进入音乐会的许可。
words.en: An admission is a statement in which you admit that something bad, unpleasant, or embarrassing is true, or the act of allowing someone to enter a place or organization.

words.tr:
n. 屏幕；屏风；掩蔽物；
v. 筛查；掩蔽；
words.ex: The movie is playing on the screen.
words.ex_cn: 电影正在屏幕上播放。
words.en: A screen is a flat surface on which pictures or words are shown, such as the one on a television or computer. It can also refer to a partition used to divide or protect an area. As a verb, to screen means to examine something in order to decide whether it is suitable for a particular purpose, or to protect someone or something from something harmful or unpleasant.

words.ex: I assure you that everything will be fine.
words.ex_cn: 我向你保证一切都会好起来的。
words.en: If you assure someone that something is true or will happen, you tell them that it is definitely true or will definitely happen, often in order to make them less worried.

words.ex: He seeks help when he is stuck.
words.ex_cn: 当他遇到困难时，他会寻求帮助。
words.en: If you seek something, you try to find it or obtain it.

words.tr:
n. 信用；赊账；赞扬；贷款；荣誉；
v. 相信；
words.ex: He has good credit with the bank.
words.ex_cn: 他在银行有良好的信用。
words.en: If you are allowed credit, you are allowed to pay for goods or services several weeks or months after you have received them.

words.ex: The soldier shoot at the target.
words.ex_cn: 士兵向目标射击。
words.en: To shoot means to fire a bullet from a gun or to take a photograph. It can also refer to the act of a plant sprouting or a player attempting to score in sports by sending the ball or puck towards the goal.

words.ex: She seeks perfection in everything she does.
words.ex_cn: 她在所做的每件事中都追求完美。
words.en: The state of being perfect; the highest degree of excellence or quality.

words.ex: He uses logic to solve the puzzle.
words.ex_cn: 他用逻辑来解决这个谜题。
words.en: Logic is a method of reasoning that involves a series of statements, each of which must be true if the statement before it is true.

words.ex: The sky is blue today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天空是蓝色的。
words.en: The sky is the space around the Earth which you can see when you stand outside and look upwards.

words.ex: The layout of the room makes it feel bigger.
words.ex_cn: 房间的布局让它显得更大。
words.en: The way in which the parts of something are arranged or laid out.

words.ex: He bought a sandwich at the snack-bar.
words.ex_cn: 他在小吃吧买了一个三明治。
words.en: A snack-bar is a small restaurant where you can buy drinks and simple meals such as sandwiches.

words.ex: He eats a pea from his plate.
words.ex_cn: 他从盘子里吃了一颗豌豆。
words.en: A pea is a small, round, green seed which is eaten as a vegetable and which is formed in a pod on a climbing plant.

words.ex: The music touched his soul.
words.ex_cn: 这音乐触动了他的灵魂。
words.en: A person's soul is the spiritual part of them which some people believe continues existing after their body is dead.

words.ex: Parents often spoil their children with too many toys.
words.ex_cn: 父母经常用太多玩具宠坏孩子。
words.en: To spoil something means to reduce its quality or value, often by damaging it in some way. It can also mean to treat someone, especially a child, with too much kindness or indulgence, leading to their detriment.

words.ex: He accepted the gift with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着接受了这份礼物。
words.en: If you accept something that you have been offered, you say yes to it or agree to take it.

words.tr:
n. 污点；
v. 玷污；
words.ex: There is a coffee stain on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有一个咖啡污点。
words.en: A stain is a mark on something that is difficult to remove, especially one made by a liquid such as blood or coffee. To stain something means to leave a mark on it that is difficult to remove.

words.tr:
n. 材料；原料；
adj. 物质的；
words.ex: The table is made of wood material.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是由木头材料制成的。
words.en: Material refers to the substance or substances from which a thing is made or can be made, or information or ideas for use in creating a book or other work.

words.ex: The pond is shallow, so you can see the bottom.
words.ex_cn: 这个池塘很浅，所以你能看到底部。
words.en: If something is shallow, it does not extend far down from the top surface.

words.ex: The police found evidence at the crime scene.
words.ex_cn: 警察在犯罪现场找到了证据。
words.en: Evidence is anything that you see, experience, read, or are told that causes you to believe that something is true or has really happened.

words.ex: The soldier walks to the camp every morning.
words.ex_cn: 士兵每天早上步行去营地。
words.en: A soldier is a person who serves in an army.

words.tr:
adv. 在户外；在野外；
n. 野外；旷野；郊外；
words.ex: The children love to play outdoors.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢在户外玩耍。
words.en: If something happens outdoors, it happens outside in the fresh air rather than in a building.

words.tr:
adj. 狭窄的；窄小的；
v. 使窄小；
words.ex: The road is narrow and hard to drive on.
words.ex_cn: 这条路很窄，开车很难。
words.en: If something narrows, or if you narrow it, it becomes less wide.

words.ex: She sings a song every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上唱歌。
words.en: To produce musical sounds with the voice, especially words with a set tune.

words.ex: He reads books in his leisure.
words.ex_cn: 他在空闲时间读书。
words.en: Leisure is the time when you are not working and you can relax and do things that you enjoy.

words.ex: The economic situation is getting worse.
words.ex_cn: 经济状况正在恶化。
words.en: Economic means concerned with the organization of the money, industry, and trade of a country, region, or society.

words.ex: She licked her lip before speaking.
words.ex_cn: 她在说话前舔了舔嘴唇。
words.en: Your lips are the two outer parts of the edge of your mouth.

words.ex: He walks on the sidewalk every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在人行道上走路。
words.en: A sidewalk is a path with a hard surface by the side of a road that people walk on.

words.ex: He packed his luggage before the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他在旅行前收拾好了行李。
words.en: Luggage consists of the suitcases and bags that you take with you when you travel.

words.tr:
adv. 在夜里；突然；
adj. 整晚的；
words.ex: The baby slept overnight in the crib.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿整夜睡在小床上。
words.en: If something happens overnight, it happens during the night or for the period of one night. It can also mean happening very quickly or suddenly.

words.ex: The sky turned pale blue at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 黎明时，天空变成了淡蓝色。
words.en: Something that is pale is not strong or bright in color.

words.ex: The consumption of water has increased this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年水的消耗量增加了。
words.en: Consumption is the act of buying and using products.

words.ex: The rainbow is a natural phenomenon.
words.ex_cn: 彩虹是一种自然现象。
words.en: A phenomenon is something that is observed to happen or exist, especially something that is unusual or interesting.

words.ex: He made an investment in a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他投资了一家小企业。
words.en: An investment is an amount of money that you invest in something.

words.ex: We watched three plays last week.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周看了三部戏剧。
words.en: To engage in activity for enjoyment and recreation rather than a serious or practical purpose.

words.ex: Children have a strong imagination.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们有很强的想象力。
words.en: The ability to form pictures or ideas in your mind of things that are new and exciting, or not real.

words.ex: He ate only a small portion of the cake.
words.ex_cn: 他只吃了一小部分蛋糕。
words.en: A portion of something is a part of it.

words.ex: The conductor raised his baton to start the orchestra.
words.ex_cn: 指挥举起指挥棒，开始演奏交响乐。
words.en: A conductor is a person who directs the performance of an orchestra or choir, or a substance that allows heat or electricity to pass through it.

words.tr:
adj. 黑色的；
n. 黑色；
words.ex: He wore a black shirt to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一件黑色的衬衫去参加派对。
words.en: Something that is black is of the darkest colour that there is, the colour of the sky at night when there is no light at all.

words.ex: I watched a clip of the movie on YouTube.
words.ex_cn: 我在YouTube上看了这部电影的一个片段。
words.en: A clip is a small device, usually made of metal or plastic, that is specially shaped for holding things together. As a verb, to clip means to cut something, especially to make it shorter or neater.

words.ex: The aeroplane flies high in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 飞机在高空中飞行。
words.en: An aeroplane is a vehicle with wings and one or more engines that enable it to fly through the air.

words.ex: He sees an airplane in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 他看到天上有一架飞机。
words.en: An airplane is a vehicle with wings and one or more engines that enable it to fly through the air.

words.tr:
v. 实施；传导（电、热）；
n. 行为；举止；
words.ex: The company will conduct a survey next week.
words.ex_cn: 公司将在下周进行一项调查。
words.en: To organize and carry out a particular activity.

words.ex: I appreciate the beauty of nature.
words.ex_cn: 我欣赏大自然的美。
words.en: If you appreciate something, you recognize its value and feel grateful for it.

words.ex: He drinks coffee every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝咖啡。
words.en: Coffee is a hot drink made from the roasted and ground seeds of a tropical shrub.

words.ex: This forest has many different species of birds.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林有多种不同的鸟类物种。
words.en: A species is a class of plants or animals whose members have the same main characteristics and are able to breed with each other.

words.ex: The extent of his knowledge surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他的知识广度让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: The area or length to which something extends.

words.ex: The book fell to the bottom of the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书掉到了架子的底部。
words.en: The lowest part or edge of something, especially the part on which it rests or is supported.

words.ex: We have lunch in the afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 我们在下午吃午饭。
words.en: The part of the day from noon or lunchtime to evening.

words.ex: The workers used a drill to make holes in the rock.
words.ex_cn: 工人们用钻机在岩石上打孔。
words.en: A drill is a tool or machine that you use for making holes, or a method of teaching people something by making them repeat it many times.

words.ex: He exclaim when he saw the surprise.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到惊喜时，他大喊起来。
words.en: If you exclaim, you say something suddenly and loudly, often because you are surprised, excited, or angry.

words.ex: The battery gives out 9 volts.
words.ex_cn: 这节电池输出9伏特。
words.en: A volt is a unit used to measure the force of an electric current.

words.ex: My tutor helps me with math homework.
words.ex_cn: 我的导师帮我做数学作业。
words.en: A tutor is someone who gives private lessons to one pupil or a very small group of pupils.

words.ex: The body expels waste through the kidneys.
words.ex_cn: 身体通过肾脏排出废物。
words.en: If someone is expelled from a school or organization, they are officially told to leave because they have behaved badly or broken the rules.

words.tr:
n. 皱纹
v. 起皱纹；弄皱…
words.ex: He has a deep wrinkle on his forehead.
words.ex_cn: 他的额头上有一道深深的皱纹。
words.en: A wrinkle is a small line or fold in something, especially fabric or the skin.

words.ex: I prepare my lunch every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上准备午餐。
words.en: If you prepare something, you make it ready for something that is going to happen.

words.ex: The workers unload the boxes from the truck.
words.ex_cn: 工人们从卡车上卸下箱子。
words.en: To remove goods from a vehicle, ship, container, etc.

words.ex: The coach endorses the new player.
words.ex_cn: 教练支持这位新球员。
words.en: If you endorse someone or something, you say publicly that you support or approve of them.

words.ex: This jacket is waterproof.
words.ex_cn: 这件夹克是防水的。
words.en: Something that is waterproof does not let water pass through it.

words.ex: He misses his youth when he played football every day.
words.ex_cn: 他怀念每天踢足球的青春时光。
words.en: The period of your life when you are young, or the state of being young.

words.ex: The train's destination is Beijing.
words.ex_cn: 这列火车的目的地是北京。
words.en: The place to which someone or something is going or being sent.

words.ex: He put vinegar on his salad.
words.ex_cn: 他把醋倒在沙拉上。
words.en: A sour-tasting liquid used as a condiment or preservative, typically made by fermenting dilute alcoholic liquids such as wine, cider, or beer.

words.tr:
n. 伪装；伪装物；
v. 伪装；掩饰；
words.ex: He wore a hat and glasses as a disguise.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了帽子和眼镜作为伪装。
words.en: To disguise means to change your appearance or behavior so that people will not recognize you, or to make something seem different from what it really is.

words.tr:
v. 逃避；逃走；
n. 逃脱；逃避；
words.ex: He tried to escape from the prison.
words.ex_cn: 他试图逃离监狱。
words.en: To escape means to get away from a place or a situation that you are in, especially because it is difficult or dangerous to stay there.

words.ex: He threw the trash into the dustbin.
words.ex_cn: 他把垃圾扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: A dustbin is a container for waste, especially one that is kept outside a house or other building.

words.tr:
pron. 我的（东西）；
n. 矿；
v. 采矿；
words.ex: This book is mine.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是我的。
words.en: Used to refer to a thing or things belonging to or associated with the speaker. A place where minerals are extracted from the earth. To extract minerals from the earth.

words.ex: He lives in a small county in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 他住在乡村的一个小郡里。
words.en: A county is a region of a country used for administrative or other purposes in certain modern nations.

words.ex: The doctor gave him a small dose of medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生给了他一小剂量的药。
words.en: A dose of a medicine or a drug is the amount of it that you take at one time, or the amount that is recommended for you to take.

words.ex: The wound began to swell after the insect bite.
words.ex_cn: 被昆虫叮咬后，伤口开始肿胀。
words.en: To increase in size or volume as a result of internal pressure; to expand.

words.ex: He won a gold medal in the Olympics.
words.ex_cn: 他在奥运会上赢得了一枚金牌。
words.en: A medal is a small metal disc which is given as an award for bravery or as a prize in a sporting event.

words.ex: He finished his homework before the deadline.
words.ex_cn: 他在截止日期前完成了作业。
words.en: A deadline is a time or date before which a particular task must be finished or a particular thing must be done.

words.ex: He is a tall man.
words.ex_cn: 他是个高个子男人。
words.en: If something is tall, it is higher than usual or than other things of its type.

words.tr:
n. 循环；周期；自行车；
v. 骑自行车；循环；
words.ex: The water cycle is important for nature.
words.ex_cn: 水循环对自然界很重要。
words.en: A cycle is a series of events that are regularly repeated in the same order or a bicycle.

words.ex: He went to the nightclub with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他和朋友们去了夜总会。
words.en: A nightclub is a place where people go late in the evening to drink and dance.

words.ex: The cat jumped onto the table.
words.ex_cn: 猫跳到了桌子上。
words.en: If something moves or is put onto an object or surface, it is then on that object or surface.

words.ex: He is not happy.
words.ex_cn: 他不开心。
words.en: Used to make a negative statement or to negate a verb, adjective, or other adverb.

words.tr:
adj. 许多的；
pron. 许多人或物；
words.ex: Many students like to play soccer after school.
words.ex_cn: 许多学生喜欢放学后踢足球。
words.en: A large number of.

words.ex: He has a big nose.
words.ex_cn: 他有一个大鼻子。
words.en: The part of the face or head that contains the nostrils and organs of smell and through which a person or animal breathes.

words.ex: The thieves robbed the bank last night.
words.ex_cn: 小偷昨晚抢劫了银行。
words.en: To rob someone or somewhere means to take money or property illegally from them, often using force.

words.ex: He scan the QR code with his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他用手机扫描了二维码。
words.en: To look at something carefully or quickly in order to find out specific information or to examine something thoroughly.

words.tr:
n. 燃料；燃油；
v. 加剧；
words.ex: The rocket uses fuel 627 for propulsion.
words.ex_cn: 火箭使用627号燃料推进。
words.en: Fuel is a substance such as coal, gas, or oil that is burned to provide heat or power.

words.ex: He rubs his hands together to warm them.
words.ex_cn: 他搓手来暖和它们。
words.en: To move one's hand or a cloth repeatedly back and forth on the surface of something with firm pressure.

words.tr: n. 差距；隔阂；缺口；缝隙；
words.ex: There is a big gap between rich and poor.
words.ex_cn: 富人和穷人之间有很大的差距。
words.en: A gap is a space between two things or a hole in the middle of something solid.

words.ex: The reporter asked the president a difficult question.
words.ex_cn: 记者问了总统一个困难的问题。
words.en: A reporter is a person whose job is to discover information about news events and describe them for a newspaper, magazine, radio, or television.

words.ex: He put on his glove before playing baseball.
words.ex_cn: 他在打棒球前戴上了手套。
words.en: A glove is a piece of clothing which covers your hand and wrist and has individual sections for each finger.

words.tr: adj. 卑微的；谦逊的；虚心的；
words.ex: He lived in a humble house near the river.
words.ex_cn: 他住在河边一座简陋的房子里。
words.en: If you describe someone as humble, you mean that they do not think they are better or more important than other people.

words.ex: This plant is resistant to drought.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物对干旱有抵抗力。
words.en: If someone is resistant to something, they are opposed to it and want to prevent it.

words.tr:
v. 能；
n. 金属罐；
words.ex: I can swim very well.
words.ex_cn: 我能够游得很好。
words.en: Can is a modal verb. It is used with the base form of a verb. It is used to indicate that someone is able to do something or that something is possible.

words.ex: The ship dropped its anchor in the harbor.
words.ex_cn: 船在港口放下了锚。
words.en: An anchor is a heavy object that is dropped from a boat or a ship into the water to prevent the vessel from moving.

words.ex: This is a comparative study of two languages.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个关于两种语言的比较研究。
words.en: You use comparative to show that you are judging something against a previous or different situation. For example, if you say that something is comparative luxury, you mean that it is luxurious compared to something else.

words.ex: He earned a bachelor in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了计算机科学学士学位。
words.en: A bachelor is a man who has never been married.

words.ex: He walks on the carpet every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都走在地毯上。
words.en: A carpet is a thick covering of soft material which is laid over a floor or a staircase.

words.ex: My aunt bought me a birthday gift.
words.ex_cn: 我姨给我买了一份生日礼物。
words.en: The sister of your father or mother, or the wife of your uncle.

words.ex: The bang woke me up at midnight.
words.ex_cn: 那声巨响在午夜把我吵醒了。
words.en: A bang is a sudden loud noise such as the noise of an explosion.

words.ex: The ceiling is white and low.
words.ex_cn: 天花板是白色的，而且很低。
words.en: The ceiling is the upper interior surface of a room or other similar compartment.

words.ex: He rowed the boat across the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他划着小船渡过湖面。
words.en: A boat is a small vehicle for travelling on water.

words.ex: He became the champion of the tennis tournament.
words.ex_cn: 他赢得了网球锦标赛的冠军。
words.en: A champion is someone who has won first prize in a competition, contest, or fight.

words.tr:
prep. 除…以外；
adv. 此外；
words.ex: Besides apples, he likes oranges.
words.ex_cn: 除了苹果，他还喜欢橙子。
words.en: In addition to; apart from.

words.ex: He chopped the carrots into small pieces.
words.ex_cn: 他把胡萝卜剁成了小块。
words.en: To chop something means to cut it into pieces with a sharp tool such as a knife or axe. It can also refer to the act of reducing something in amount or size.

words.ex: The princess lived in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 公主住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: A princess is a female member of a royal family, especially a daughter or granddaughter of a king and queen, or the wife of a prince.

words.ex: The cake is yummy.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕很好吃。
words.en: If you describe food as yummy, you mean that it tastes extremely good.

words.tr:
pron. 无论哪个；
adj. 无论哪个的；
words.ex: You can pick whichever book you like.
words.ex_cn: 你可以选无论哪本书。
words.en: You use whichever to refer to any one of a group of things or people, when it does not matter which one is chosen or considered.

words.tr:
n. 琐事；少量
v. 玩弄；轻视
words.ex: He threw away a trifle of money on candy.
words.ex_cn: 他花了一点钱买糖果。
words.en: A trifle is something that is considered to have little importance, value, or significance. It can also refer to a small amount of something. As a verb, to trifle means to treat someone or something without seriousness or respect.

words.tr:
v. 拉；拖；牵；拔；
n. 拉；拖；牵；拔；
words.ex: He pull the door open.
words.ex_cn: 他拉开了门。
words.en: To pull something means to use your hands to make it move towards you or in the direction that your hands are moving.

words.ex: She wore a woolen scarf in winter.
words.ex_cn: 她在冬天戴了一条羊毛围巾。
words.en: Made of wool; relating to wool.

words.ex: She wore a woollen scarf in winter.
words.ex_cn: 她冬天戴了一条毛纺围巾。
words.en: Made of wool; relating to wool.

words.ex: The arrival of the train was delayed by 20 minutes.
words.ex_cn: 火车的到达晚了20分钟。
words.en: The act of coming to a place or the moment when something or someone arrives.

words.ex: The crowd cheered when the team scored.
words.ex_cn: 当球队得分时，观众欢呼起来。
words.en: If people cheer, they shout loudly to show their approval or to encourage someone who is doing something such as taking part in a game.

words.ex: She gave a cheerful smile.
words.ex_cn: 她露出了快乐的微笑。
words.en: Someone who is cheerful is happy and shows this in their behavior.

words.ex: The bath is next to the bedroom.
words.ex_cn: 浴室在卧室旁边。
words.en: A bath is the process of washing your body, usually by sitting or lying in a container of water.

words.ex: Can you clarify your answer?
words.ex_cn: 你能澄清一下你的答案吗？
words.en: To clarify something means to make it easier to understand by explaining it more clearly.

words.ex: He will alter the plan tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会改动计划。
words.en: To alter something means to change it, usually slightly, or to cause the characteristics of something to change.

words.tr:
n. 连环漫画；
adj. 滑稽的；
words.ex: He reads a comic every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上读一本连环漫画。
words.en: A comic is someone who entertains people by making them laugh, especially a professional comedian.

words.tr:
n. 预算；预算金额；
adj. 廉价的；花钱少的；
v. 为 ... 做预算；
words.ex: We made a budget for our vacation.
words.ex_cn: 我们为旅行制定了一个预算。
words.en: A budget is a plan that shows how much money a person or organization will earn and how much they will need or be able to spend.

words.ex: His comprehension of the story was very good.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个故事的理解很好。
words.en: Comprehension is the ability to understand something.

words.ex: She spread butter on her toast.
words.ex_cn: 她在吐司上抹了黄油。
words.en: Butter is a pale yellow edible fatty substance made by churning cream and used as a spread or in cooking.

words.ex: The fish swam fast using its fin.
words.ex_cn: 鱼用它的鳍快速游动。
words.en: A fin is a thin flat part that sticks out from the body of a fish, used for swimming and balancing.

words.ex: He hardly ate anything at dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐几乎没吃东西。
words.en: You use hardly to modify a statement when you want to emphasize that it is only a small amount or degree which is true, or that it is not true at all.

words.ex: He bought a recorder to record his lessons.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一台录音机来录课程。
words.en: A recorder is a device or a person that records something, especially sounds or events.

words.tr:
adj. 学术的；
n. 大学教师；学者；
words.ex: He published an academic paper on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他发表了一篇关于气候变化的学术论文。
words.en: relating to education, especially at college or university level

words.ex: Hydrogen is the lightest element.
words.ex_cn: 氢是最轻的元素。
words.en: Hydrogen is a chemical element with symbol H and atomic number 1. With a standard atomic weight of 1.008, hydrogen is the lightest element in the periodic table.

words.ex: I will borrow a book from the library.
words.ex_cn: 我将从图书馆借一本书。
words.en: To take and use something that belongs to someone else with the intention of returning it.

chapters.name: 较高要求词汇 Word List 25

words.tr: n. 中士；巡佐；军士；警官
words.ex: The sergeant gave orders to the soldiers.
words.ex_cn: 军士向士兵们下达了命令。
words.en: A sergeant is a non-commissioned officer in the army or marines ranking above a corporal and below a lieutenant, or a police officer ranking below an inspector.

words.ex: The horses run fast on the racecourse.
words.ex_cn: 马在赛马场跑得很快。
words.en: A racecourse is a track or ground where races are held, especially horse races.

words.ex: The boat has a watertight hull.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船有一个不透水的船体。
words.en: Something that is watertight does not allow water to pass through it, often used to describe containers, compartments, or arguments that are completely secure and cannot be faulted.

words.ex: We need to quantify the results of the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要量化实验的结果。
words.en: If you try to quantify something, you try to calculate how much of it there is.

words.tr: adj. 清醒的；严肃的；素淡的；
words.ex: He stayed sober after drinking only water.
words.ex_cn: 他只喝了水，保持清醒。
words.en: If you are sober, you are not drunk. If you are sober, you are serious and thoughtful.

words.ex: The lab technician transcribes the DNA sequence into RNA.
words.ex_cn: 实验室技术员将DNA序列转录成RNA。
words.en: To transcribe something means to write it down or to copy it from one form of recording to another.

words.tr: n. 请愿人；上诉人；离婚上诉方
words.ex: The petitioner asked the court for help.
words.ex_cn: 申请人请求法院给予帮助。
words.en: A petitioner is a person who presents a petition to a court or other authority in order to request a legal action or a favor.

words.tr: adj. 单独的；独唱的；独奏的；
words.ex: He played a solo guitar piece at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 他在音乐会上演奏了一首独奏吉他曲。
words.en: A solo is a piece of music or a performance done by one person alone, without any accompaniment.

words.ex: The system will validate your password.
words.ex_cn: 系统将验证你的密码。
words.en: To validate something such as a claim or statement means to prove or confirm that it is true or correct.

words.ex: The new policy has a wide radius of influence.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策的影响范围很广。
words.en: A straight line from the center to the circumference of a circle or sphere.

words.tr: n. 悬浮；暂时停职（停学、停赛）；
words.ex: The suspension of dust in the air made the sky look gray.
words.ex_cn: 空气中的尘埃悬浮使天空看起来灰蒙蒙的。
words.en: The act of temporarily stopping something from happening or being in effect, or the state of being stopped in this way.

words.ex: The clock has a quartz crystal inside.
words.ex_cn: 这个钟里面有一个石英晶体。
words.en: Quartz is a hard, crystalline mineral composed of silicon and oxygen atoms. It is one of the most common minerals in the Earth's continental crust.

words.ex: The teacher will terminate the class at 5 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 老师将在下午5点结束课程。
words.en: To terminate something means to bring it to an end or to stop it from continuing.

words.tr:
adj. 反动的；保守的
n. 反动派；保守人士
words.ex: The reactionary government banned free speech.
words.ex_cn: 这个反动政府禁止了言论自由。
words.en: A reactionary person or group tries to prevent changes in the political or social system of their country.

words.ex: He has an ulcer from eating too much spicy food.
words.ex_cn: 他因为吃太多辣食而得了溃疡。
words.en: An ulcer is a sore area on the skin or inside the body that is very painful and may bleed or produce a poisonous substance.

words.ex: The house is situated near the river.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子位于河边。
words.en: If something is situated in a particular place or position, it is in that place or position.

words.ex: The bottle contains zinc to help your body stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 这个瓶子里含有锌，有助于你的身体健康。
words.en: Zinc is a bluish-white metal that is used in making other metals or for covering other metals to protect them.

words.tr: adj. 精神病的；精神病学的；
words.ex: He works in a psychiatric hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家精神病医院工作。
words.en: Psychiatric means relating to psychiatry or to mental illness.

words.ex: He chose an occupational therapy course.
words.ex_cn: 他选择了一门职业治疗课程。
words.en: Relating to a job or profession.

words.ex: The receptor detects the signal from the hormone.
words.ex_cn: 受体检测激素的信号。
words.en: A receptor is a cell or a group of cells that receives stimuli.

words.ex: Her speciality is cooking Italian food.
words.ex_cn: 她的专长是做意大利菜。
words.en: A speciality is a particular field of work or study that someone specializes in, or a product that is particularly associated with a specific place or producer.

words.tr:
v. 成为三倍；使增至三倍；
n. 三倍的数；三个一组；
adj. 三部分的；
words.ex: The company's profits tripled last year.
words.ex_cn: 该公司去年的利润增长了三倍。
words.en: To triple something means to make it three times as much in size or number.

words.tr: v. 要求归还；收回；开垦；感化
words.ex: He wants to reclaim his lost wallet.
words.ex_cn: 他想要要求归还他丢失的钱包。
words.en: If you reclaim something that you have lost or that has been taken away from you, you succeed in getting it back. If you reclaim land, you make it suitable for use, for example by draining it or by getting rid of unwanted buildings or plants.

words.ex: The company streamlined its hiring process.
words.ex_cn: 公司简化了招聘流程。
words.en: To make something such as a business, organization, or process work more effectively by making it simpler or more efficient.

words.ex: The workers dug a trench to lay the pipe.
words.ex_cn: 工人们挖了一条沟来铺设管道。
words.en: A trench is a long, narrow ditch. In warfare, trenches are dug by troops to provide shelter from enemy fire.

words.ex: The red light signifies stop.
words.ex_cn: 红灯表示停止。
words.en: If an event, a sign, or a symbol signifies something, it is a sign of that thing or represents that thing.

words.ex: The problem recurs every week.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题每周都会再次出现。
words.en: If something recurs, it happens again, either once or several times.

words.ex: The country made a unilateral decision to close the border.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家单方面决定关闭边境。
words.en: Involving only one group or country.

words.tr:
n. 经常重复的评价（或抱怨）；叠句；
v. 克制；
words.ex: His constant refrain is that the food is too expensive.
words.ex_cn: 他经常抱怨食物太贵。
words.en: If you refrain from doing something, you deliberately do not do it.

words.ex: He went to a tutorial to understand math better.
words.ex_cn: 他去参加辅导以更好地理解数学。
words.en: A tutorial is a period of teaching and discussion with a tutor, especially in a British university or college.

words.tr: adj. 精明的；敏锐的；机灵的；
words.ex: He made a shrewd decision to buy the house low.
words.ex_cn: 他精明地决定低价买下这栋房子。
words.en: A shrewd person is able to understand and judge a situation quickly and to use this understanding to their own advantage.

words.ex: The car's velocity increased on the highway.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车在高速公路上的速度增加了。
words.en: Velocity is the speed at which something moves in a particular direction.

words.tr:
n. （军队的）团；大群；大量
v. 把...编组；严格管制
words.ex: He joined the army and was in a regiment.
words.ex_cn: 他参军了，被编入一个团。
words.en: A regiment is a large group of soldiers that is commanded by a colonel.

words.tr: adj. 根本的；潜在的； v. “underlie”的现在分词；
words.ex: The underlying cause of the problem is poverty.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题的根本原因是贫困。
words.en: An underlying thing is the thing that is the most important or basic, although it is not easily noticed or stated directly.

words.tr:
n. 蔑视
v. 蔑视
words.ex: He looked at the lie with scorn.
words.ex_cn: 他轻蔑地看着这个谎言。
words.en: If you scorn someone or something, you feel or show contempt for them.

words.ex: He graduated in 2020, and thereafter he moved to New York.
words.ex_cn: 他2020年毕业，之后搬到了纽约。
words.en: After a particular event or time.

words.ex: Children have reliance on their parents for food and shelter.
words.ex_cn: 孩子依赖父母提供食物和住所。
words.en: Reliance is the state of depending on or trusting in someone or something.

words.tr: adj. 增补性的；补充性的；
words.ex: The teacher gave supplementary notes for the lesson.
words.ex_cn: 老师为这节课提供了增补性的笔记。
words.en: Supplementary things are added to something in order to improve it or make it more complete.

words.tr: adj. 可更新的；可再生的；
words.ex: Solar energy is a renewable resource.
words.ex_cn: 太阳能是一种可更新的资源。
words.en: A renewable resource is a natural resource which will replenish to replace the portion depleted by usage and consumption, either through natural reproduction or other recurring processes in a finite amount of time in a human time scale.

words.ex: The cold water gave her a sudden sensation.
words.ex_cn: 冷水给了她一种突然的感觉。
words.en: A sensation is a physical feeling or a reaction of interest or excitement that something causes in a person or in a group of people.

words.ex: His calm temperament helps him stay peaceful in stress.
words.ex_cn: 他平静的性情让他在压力下保持平和。
words.en: Your temperament is your basic nature, especially as it is shown in the way that you react to situations or to other people.

words.ex: The forest is a virgin land, untouched by humans.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林是未开发的土地，从未被人类触及过。
words.en: A virgin is someone who has never had sexual intercourse. It can also describe something that is in its original pure or natural condition and has not been touched or changed by people.

words.ex: My teacher is tolerant of different opinions.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师对不同的观点很宽容。
words.en: If you describe someone as tolerant, you approve of the fact that they allow other people to say and do as they like, even if they do not agree with or like it.

words.ex: The shareholder voted on the company's new plan.
words.ex_cn: 股东对公司的新计划进行了投票。
words.en: A shareholder is a person who owns shares in a company and therefore gets part of the company's profits and the right to vote on how the company is managed.

words.tr: n. 措辞；用词； v. “word”的现在分词；
words.ex: The wording of the notice was clear.
words.ex_cn: 通知的措辞很清晰。
words.en: The way in which words are used to express something, especially in a document or speech.

words.ex: The rescuer saved the cat from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 救援者把猫从树上救了下来。
words.en: A rescuer is someone who saves people from dangerous or harmful situations.

words.tr:
n. 接缝；缝合处；矿层；煤层
v. 缝合；有裂痕
words.ex: The seam of the shirt came loose.
words.ex_cn: 衬衫的接缝松开了。
words.en: A seam is a line where two pieces of fabric are sewn together in a garment or other article.

words.ex: The plane's takeoff was delayed by strong wind.
words.ex_cn: 飞机的起飞因强风而延误了。
words.en: Takeoff is the beginning of a flight, when an aircraft leaves the ground.

words.ex: He works hard to earn his subsistence.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以维持生计。
words.en: Subsistence is the condition of just having enough food or money to stay alive.

words.ex: He lives in a residential area near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他住在公园附近的一个住宅区。
words.en: Relating to or suitable for residence.

words.ex: The volcano released sulfur into the air.
words.ex_cn: 火山向空气中释放了硫。
words.en: Sulfur is a pale yellow, odorless, brittle solid, which is insoluble in water but soluble in carbon disulfide.

words.tr: n. 举办地点；（比赛）地点；会场；
words.ex: The concert will be held at a new venue.
words.ex_cn: 这场音乐会将在一个新的举办地点举行。
words.en: A place where an event or meeting is held, such as a concert hall or conference center.

words.ex: He plays the saxophone in a jazz band.
words.ex_cn: 他在爵士乐队中吹奏萨克斯管。
words.en: A saxophone is a musical instrument that is made of brass and is played by blowing into it and pressing keys to change the notes.

words.ex: The doctor sensed the urgency and acted quickly.
words.ex_cn: 医生感受到了紧急情况，迅速采取了行动。
words.en: The quality or condition of being urgent; pressing importance.

words.tr: adj. 资源丰富的；机敏的；足智多谋的
words.ex: He is a resourceful man who can fix anything with little material.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个资源丰富的男人，能用很少的材料修好任何东西。
words.en: If someone is resourceful, they are good at finding ways of dealing with problems.

words.tr:
adj. 主要的；重要的；
n. 主要产品；主要部分；主食；
words.ex: Rice is a staple food in many Asian countries.
words.ex_cn: 大米是许多亚洲国家的主要食物。
words.en: A staple is a basic food that is eaten regularly and in such quantities that it constitutes a dominant portion of a standard diet for a given people, supplying a large fraction of energy needs and generally forming a significant proportion of the intake of other nutrients as well.

words.ex: The company decided to restructure its departments.
words.ex_cn: 公司决定重构其部门。
words.en: To change the way in which something is organized or arranged, especially in order to make it more effective or efficient.

words.ex: The fence safeguards the garden from animals.
words.ex_cn: 围栏保护花园免受动物侵扰。
words.en: A safeguard is a measure taken to protect someone or something from potential harm or danger.

words.tr: adj. 即将发生（或来临）的
words.ex: The upcoming meeting is on Friday.
words.ex_cn: 即将到来的会议在周五。
words.en: An upcoming event is one that is going to happen soon.

words.ex: The retrieval of lost files took a long time.
words.ex_cn: 找回丢失文件花费了很长时间。
words.en: The act of getting something back from somewhere.

words.ex: I ate an apple as a snack after school.
words.ex_cn: 我放学后吃了一个苹果当小吃。
words.en: A snack is a small amount of food that is eaten between meals.

words.tr: n. 恐怖主义；恐怖行动
words.ex: The country is fighting terrorism with strong laws.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家通过严格的法律打击恐怖主义。
words.en: Terrorism is the use of violence and intimidation in the pursuit of political aims.

words.ex: The change is reversible under normal conditions.
words.ex_cn: 在正常条件下，这种变化是可逆的。
words.en: Capable of being reversed; able to return to an original state or condition.

words.ex: He listened to a beautiful symphony last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚听了一首美妙的交响乐。
words.en: A symphony is a long piece of music that is usually in four parts and is performed by an orchestra.

words.tr: adj. 顺利的；宽裕的；有钱的
words.ex: He comes from a well-off family and never worries about money.
words.ex_cn: 他来自一个顺利的家庭，从不为钱发愁。
words.en: Someone who is well-off is rich enough to be able to do and buy most of the things that they want.

words.ex: The robbery happened at the bank yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天银行发生了抢劫。
words.en: The crime of stealing from someone or somewhere, especially using violence or threats.

words.ex: His opinion is subordinate to the manager's.
words.ex_cn: 他的意见比经理的次要。
words.en: If someone is your subordinate, they have a less important position than you in the organization that you both work for.

words.ex: There are roughly 100 students in the class.
words.ex_cn: 这个班级大约有100名学生。
words.en: In a manner that is not exact or detailed; approximately.

words.ex: The king sat on the throne.
words.ex_cn: 国王坐在王位上。
words.en: The throne is the special chair used by a king, queen, or emperor during ceremonies, or the position of being a ruler.

words.ex: The rope is slack and hangs loosely.
words.ex_cn: 绳子是松弛的，垂挂着。
words.en: If something is slack, it is loose and not firmly stretched or tightly in position. It can also describe a period of low activity or a lack of effort in work or activity.

words.ex: He is learning vocational skills to become a mechanic.
words.ex_cn: 他正在学习职业技能以成为一名机械师。
words.en: Relating to the skills you need to do a particular job.

words.ex: The colors in the rainbow cover a wide spectrum.
words.ex_cn: 彩虹中的颜色覆盖了广泛的范围。
words.en: A spectrum is a range of a particular type of thing, often a range of colors, ideas, or opinions.

words.ex: The boxes are stored in the warehouse.
words.ex_cn: 这些箱子存放在仓库里。
words.en: A warehouse is a large building where raw materials or manufactured goods may be stored before their export or distribution for sale.

words.ex: The doctor tried to stabilize the patient's heart rate.
words.ex_cn: 医生试图稳定病人的脉搏。
words.en: To stabilize something means to make it stable or to prevent it from changing or declining.

words.ex: The doctor gave medicine to stabilise his blood pressure.
words.ex_cn: 医生给了药来稳定他的血压。
words.en: To stabilise something means to make it stable or to prevent it from changing or declining.

words.ex: The tuition for this course is $500.
words.ex_cn: 这门课程的学费是500美元。
words.en: Tuition is the fee charged for instruction, especially at a college, university, or private school.

words.tr:
n. 针脚；缝线；一针
v. 缝；缝合
words.ex: She sews a stitch to fix the tear.
words.ex_cn: 她缝一针来补破洞。
words.en: A stitch is a piece of thread that has been used to sew the edges of a wound together. It can also refer to a loop of thread or yarn resulting from a single pass or movement of the needle in sewing, knitting, or crocheting.

words.ex: The red team played versus the blue team.
words.ex_cn: 红队与蓝队比赛。
words.en: Used to indicate the two sides in a competition or conflict.

words.tr:
n. 树桩；残段；残根
v. 难倒；重步走
words.ex: The tree stump is still in the yard.
words.ex_cn: 树桩还在院子里。
words.en: A stump is the base part of a tree that remains after the rest of the tree has been cut down. It can also refer to a difficult problem or to the act of walking heavily.

words.ex: The children love watching animated movies.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢看动画电影。
words.en: Animated means full of life or excitement, or made to appear to move as if by magic or technology.

words.ex: The two countries are in the same bloc.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家属于同一个集团。
words.en: A bloc is a group of countries or parties with similar political interests, especially when they act together in international affairs.

words.ex: The atmospheric pressure dropped before the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴来临前，大气压下降了。
words.en: Relating to the atmosphere of the Earth or another planet; creating a distinctive mood, typically of romance or nostalgia.

words.ex: The brewery makes fresh beer every day.
words.ex_cn: 这家啤酒厂每天生产新鲜的啤酒。
words.en: A brewery is a place where beer is made commercially.

words.ex: The company wants to globalize its business.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司想将业务全球化。
words.en: To make something worldwide in scope or application.

words.tr: adj. 秃头的；不加修饰的；赤裸裸的
words.ex: The old man is bald.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人是秃头的。
words.en: Someone who is bald has little or no hair on the top of their head.

words.ex: The speaker will amplify the sound for everyone to hear.
words.ex_cn: 扬声器会放大声音，让每个人都能听到。
words.en: To amplify something means to make it louder, stronger, or more detailed.

words.ex: He took a brisk walk in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 他早上轻快地散步。
words.en: If someone or something is brisk, they are quick and lively in their actions or movements.

words.ex: He turned his head to avert the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他转过头去避免了事故。
words.en: If you avert something unpleasant, you prevent it from happening.

words.tr:
n. 织布机；
v. 迫近；
words.ex: The old loom made a loud clicking sound.
words.ex_cn: 那台旧织布机发出很大的咔嗒声。
words.en: If something looms over you, it appears as a large or unclear shape, often in a way that is frightening or causes worry.

words.tr: n. 人工制品；手工艺品；加工品
words.ex: The museum has an ancient artifact.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆里有一件古代文物。
words.en: An artifact is an object that is made by a person, especially something of historical or cultural interest.

words.ex: The city improved its power grid to handle more electricity.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市改进了其电力输送网，以承载更多的电力。
words.en: A grid is a pattern of straight lines that cross each other to form squares. It is used to help you draw or to help you find places on a map.

words.ex: The bird hatched her eggs after three weeks.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟在三周后孵出了她的蛋。
words.en: To hatch means to cause an egg to break open so that a young animal can come out, or to plan secretly with other people to do something bad or illegal.

words.ex: The team gained momentum after scoring the first goal.
words.ex_cn: 球队在进第一个球后获得了势头。
words.en: Momentum is the ability of something to keep increasing, developing, or being more successful.

words.ex: The city is at a latitude of 40 degrees north.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市位于北纬40度。
words.en: Latitude is the distance of a place north or south of the equator, measured in degrees.

words.ex: The heater uses 2 kilowatt of electricity.
words.ex_cn: 这台加热器使用2千瓦的电力。
words.en: A kilowatt is a unit of power equal to one thousand watts.

words.ex: The memory of the accident still haunts him.
words.ex_cn: 那场事故的记忆仍然长期困扰着他。
words.en: If something unpleasant haunts you, you keep thinking or worrying about it over a long period of time. A place that is haunted is believed to be visited regularly by a ghost.

words.tr: n. 阁下；贵族身分（或权威）；统治
words.ex: The lordship welcomed the guests with kindness.
words.ex_cn: 阁下以仁慈欢迎了宾客。
words.en: Lordship is a title used to address or refer to a man who has a high rank in the nobility, especially in Britain.

words.ex: A hawk flew over the field.
words.ex_cn: 一只鹰飞过田野。
words.en: A hawk is a bird of prey with a strong beak and sharp claws, known for its keen vision and swift flight. As a verb, to hawk means to sell goods aggressively, often in public places.

words.tr: n. 玩忽职守；治疗失当；营私舞弊
words.ex: The doctor was sued for medical malpractice.
words.ex_cn: 这位医生因医疗过失被起诉。
words.en: Improper, illegal, or negligent professional activity or treatment, especially by a medical practitioner, lawyer, or public official.

words.ex: The chemicals are hazardous to health.
words.ex_cn: 这些化学物质对健康有危险。
words.en: Something that is hazardous is dangerous, especially to people's health or safety.

words.ex: The milk looks milky and smooth.
words.ex_cn: 这牛奶看起来乳状且顺滑。
words.en: Resembling milk in color or consistency; containing milk.

words.ex: The historian wrote a book about ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 这位历史学家写了一本关于古罗马的书。
words.en: A historian is a person who studies or writes about history; an expert in history.

words.ex: He found an old manuscript in the library.
words.ex_cn: 他在图书馆里发现了一份旧手稿。
words.en: A manuscript is a handwritten or typed document, especially a writer's first version of a book before it is published.

words.ex: He tries to assimilate new words every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天努力吸收新单词。
words.en: To assimilate means to take in and understand fully ideas, information, or culture, or to make something become part of a group or system.

words.ex: His answer was erroneous because he added wrong.
words.ex_cn: 他的答案是错误的，因为他加错了。
words.en: If you describe someone's beliefs or opinions as erroneous, you mean that they are incorrect and based on false information.

words.ex: The nurse will dispense medicine to the patients.
words.ex_cn: 护士将分发药品给病人。
words.en: To dispense means to distribute or provide something, especially in a systematic way, or to prepare and give out medicine.

words.ex: His dog gave him constant companionship.
words.ex_cn: 他的狗给了他不断的陪伴。
words.en: the state of being with someone or having someone to spend time with

words.tr:
n. 摘录；摘要
v. 摘录；引用
words.ex: He read an excerpt from the book.
words.ex_cn: 他读了这本书的一段摘录。
words.en: An excerpt is a short piece of writing or music which is taken from a larger piece.

words.ex: The ship arrived at the dock at sunrise.
words.ex_cn: 船在日出时到达了码头。
words.en: A dock is an enclosed area of water in a port where ships go to be loaded, unloaded, and repaired.

words.ex: The red hat was conspicuous in the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 那顶红帽子在人群中非常显眼。
words.en: Something that is conspicuous is very obvious or easy to notice.

words.tr: adj. 可区别的；可辨别的
words.ex: The two colors are distinguishable under bright light.
words.ex_cn: 在强光下，这两种颜色是可以区分的。
words.en: If something is distinguishable, it can be recognized or identified as different from something else.

words.ex: The family reduced their monthly expenditure.
words.ex_cn: 这个家庭减少了每月的开支。
words.en: Expenditure is the spending of money on something, or the money that is spent on something.

words.ex: He is an expert in the domain of artificial intelligence.
words.ex_cn: 他是人工智能领域的专家。
words.en: A domain is a particular field of thought, activity, or interest, especially one over which someone has control, influence, or rights.

words.tr: adj. 灭绝的；熄灭的；绝种的；
words.ex: The dodo is an extinct bird.
words.ex_cn: 渡渡鸟是一种灭绝的鸟。
words.en: If a species of animals or plants is extinct, it no longer has any living members, either in the world or in a particular place.

words.ex: The scientist created a cocktail of chemicals for the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 科学家为实验配制了一种化学混合物。
words.en: A cocktail is a mixed drink typically made with a combination of alcoholic beverages and other ingredients such as fruit juices, syrups, or cream.

words.ex: The horse-drawn carriage was a forerunner of the car.
words.ex_cn: 马车是汽车的先驱。
words.en: A forerunner is someone or something that comes before another and is often considered as a sign of what is to follow.

words.ex: Reading books is his favorite pastime.
words.ex_cn: 读书是他最喜欢的消遣。
words.en: A pastime is something that you do because you enjoy it or are interested in it, rather than as a job.

words.tr: adj. 无价的；非常宝贵的；
words.ex: Her advice was invaluable to me.
words.ex_cn: 她的建议对我而言是无价的。
words.en: If you describe something as invaluable, you mean that it is extremely useful.

words.ex: The legalization of marijuana is happening in some states.
words.ex_cn: 大麻的合法化正在一些州发生。
words.en: The act of making something legal that was previously illegal.

words.ex: The shape has irregular sides.
words.ex_cn: 这个形状的边是不规则的。
words.en: Something that is irregular does not follow the expected pattern, plan, or method; it is not regular.

words.tr: adj. 即将发生（或出版等）的；准备好的；
words.ex: The forthcoming book will be released next month.
words.ex_cn: 即将出版的这本书将在下个月发布。
words.en: If something is forthcoming, it is happening or coming soon.

words.ex: The factory releases a pollutant into the river.
words.ex_cn: 工厂向河里排放一种污染物。
words.en: A pollutant is a substance that pollutes something, especially air, water, or soil.

words.ex: He turned the knob to adjust the volume.
words.ex_cn: 他转动旋钮来调节音量。
words.en: A knob is a round handle, or a round switch on a piece of equipment.

words.ex: He preaches kindness every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日都宣扬仁爱。
words.en: If you preach, you give a talk on a religious or moral subject during a religious service.

words.ex: He overheard them talking about the party.
words.ex_cn: 他无意中听到他们在谈论派对。
words.en: To overhear is to hear what someone is saying without them knowing that you are listening.

words.tr:
v. 喘气；喘息；倒抽气
n. 喘气；喘息
words.ex: He gasped when he saw the big snake.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到那条大蛇时，他倒吸了一口冷气。
words.en: To take a short, quick breath through the mouth, especially because of surprise, pain, or shock.

words.tr: adj. 司法的；法庭的；审判的；
words.ex: The judicial system protects people's rights.
words.ex_cn: 司法系统保护人民的权利。
words.en: Judicial means relating to the legal system and to judgments made in a court of law.

words.ex: He loves studying geology in high school.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在高中学习地质学。
words.en: The science which deals with the physical structure and substance of the earth, their history, and the processes which act on them.

words.ex: He felt jealousy when his friend got a new bike.
words.ex_cn: 当他的朋友得到一辆新自行车时，他感到妒忌。
words.en: Jealousy is the feeling of anger or bitterness which someone has when they think that another person is trying to take a lover or friend, or a possession, away from them.

words.tr:
v. 交叠；使部分重叠；
n. 重叠部分；
words.ex: The two colors overlap on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 两种颜色在墙上交叠。
words.en: If one thing overlaps another, or if you overlap them, a part of the first thing occupies the same area as a part of the other thing. You can also say that two things overlap.

words.ex: The ministerial meeting will be held tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 部长会议将在明天举行。
words.en: Relating to a minister or ministry, especially in government or the church.

words.ex: He is the premier player on the team.
words.ex_cn: 他是队里最优秀的球员。
words.en: The premier is the leader of the government in some countries, equivalent to a prime minister.

words.ex: He is invariably late for meetings.
words.ex_cn: 他总是开会迟到。
words.en: If something invariably happens or is invariably true, it always happens or is always true.

words.tr:
v. 咯咯地笑
n. 咯咯笑；趣事
words.ex: The children giggle when they see the clown.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们看到小丑时咯咯笑。
words.en: To laugh in a silly, often high-pitched way, especially in a nervous or embarrassed manner.

words.ex: The boxer is a lightweight fighter.
words.ex_cn: 这位拳击手是一名轻量级选手。
words.en: Something that is lightweight weighs less than average or is less heavy than usual. It can also refer to someone who is not very important or influential.

words.tr:
n. 闪耀；闪烁；小发光物
v. 闪耀；闪亮；流露（感情）
words.ex: The glitter of the stars lit up the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 星星的闪耀照亮了夜空。
words.en: If something glitters, light comes from or is reflected off different parts of it.

words.ex: The pirate sailed the sea with a black flag.
words.ex_cn: 海盗带着黑旗在海上航行。
words.en: A pirate is someone who attacks and robs ships at sea. The term can also refer to someone who illegally copies and distributes software, music, or films.

words.ex: They stayed at a motel near the highway.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在高速公路旁的一家汽车旅馆。
words.en: A motel is a hotel which is designed for people who are travelling by car, usually with parking spaces next to each room.

words.ex: He took his words in a literal sense.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的话按字面意思理解。
words.en: If you describe something as the literal truth or a literal fact, you are emphasizing that it is true.

words.ex: The boss gave a positive appraisal of his work.
words.ex_cn: 老板对他的工作给予了积极的评估。
words.en: An appraisal is a judgement or assessment of the value, nature, or quality of something or someone.

words.ex: The elephant is gigantic compared to a dog.
words.ex_cn: 这头大象相比狗来说是巨大的。
words.en: If you describe something as gigantic, you are emphasizing that it is extremely large in size, amount, or degree.

words.ex: There was an array of people at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 音乐会上人山人海。
words.en: An array of different things or people is a large number or wide range of them.

words.ex: The fringe of the forest is full of wildflowers.
words.ex_cn: 森林的边缘长满了野花。
words.en: The outer, marginal, or extreme part of an area, group, or sphere of activity.

words.ex: The king was killed by an assassin.
words.ex_cn: 国王被一名刺客杀害了。
words.en: An assassin is a person who murders an important person for political or religious reasons.

words.tr: adj. 官僚的；官僚主义的；
words.ex: The bureaucratic process made it hard to get a permit.
words.ex_cn: 官僚程序让申请许可证变得困难。
words.en: If you describe a system, organization, or process as bureaucratic, you mean that it is complicated and inefficient because of a large number of rules and procedures.

words.ex: The sentence has ambiguity because it can mean two things.
words.ex_cn: 这句话有歧义，因为它可以有两种意思。
words.en: If you say that there is ambiguity in something, you mean that it is unclear or confusing, or it can be understood in more than one way.

words.ex: She ate a crisp apple for snack.
words.ex_cn: 她吃了一个脆苹果当点心。
words.en: Something that is crisp is hard, and makes a pleasant sound when you break it or crush it.

words.ex: He allegedly stole the money.
words.ex_cn: 据他声称，他偷了钱。
words.en: Used to convey that something is claimed to be the case or have taken place, although there is no proof.

words.ex: The robbers took a hostage during the bank robbery.
words.ex_cn: 劫匪在银行抢劫时抓了一名人质。
words.en: A hostage is someone who has been captured by a person or organization and who may be killed or injured if people do not do what that person or organization demands.

words.ex: He affirm that the plan will work.
words.ex_cn: 他断言这个计划会成功。
words.en: If you affirm that something is true or that something exists, you state firmly and publicly that it is true or that it exists.

words.ex: He has ideological beliefs about freedom.
words.ex_cn: 他有关于自由的思想信念。
words.en: Relating to or concerned with ideas, especially of a political or economic nature.

words.ex: The adverse weather delayed the flight.
words.ex_cn: 不利的天气延误了航班。
words.en: If something is adverse, it is harmful or unfavorable.

words.ex: He worked overtime to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 他加班完成了这个项目。
words.en: Overtime refers to the time worked beyond one's regular working hours, often with additional pay.

words.ex: He was shy during his adolescence.
words.ex_cn: 他在青春期时很害羞。
words.en: Adolescence is the period in a person's life when they develop from a child into an adult.

words.tr: adj. 范围狭小的，范围不广的；理解不深的，没有理解力的
words.ex: The library has an incomprehensive collection of science books.
words.ex_cn: 这个图书馆的科学书籍收藏范围很窄。
words.en: Not comprehensive; lacking in breadth or depth.

words.tr: adj. 飞行的；空运的；空中传播的；
words.ex: The airborne soldiers jumped from the plane.
words.ex_cn: 这些空降士兵从飞机上跳下。
words.en: In the air; flying or transported by air.

words.tr: phrase. 覆盖范围的文字说明；用于描述某项服务或产品覆盖区域的标注文字
words.ex: The map includes a coverage lettering that explains the service areas.
words.ex_cn: 这张地图包含了一段文字说明，解释了服务范围。
words.en: Text or lettering used to describe or provide information about an insurance policy's coverage.

words.ex: The mixture is homogeneous and looks the same throughout.
words.ex_cn: 这种混合物是均一的，看起来处处都一样。
words.en: Something that is homogeneous is uniform in nature or character throughout.

words.ex: The microscope can magnify small objects.
words.ex_cn: 显微镜可以放大微小的物体。
words.en: To magnify something means to make it appear larger than it is, especially by using a lens or microscope. It can also mean to exaggerate or make something seem more important or serious than it really is.

words.tr: v. 恳求；辩护；答辩；以…为理由
words.ex: He pleaded for help when he was lost.
words.ex_cn: 当他迷路时，他恳求帮助。
