words.en: If you describe something such as a speech or piece of writing as disjointed, you mean that it is not well organized or easy to follow, often because it contains ideas that are not connected or arranged in a logical order.

words.tr: n. 寄生虫；寄生生物；依赖他人过活者；
words.ex: The parasite lives inside the host's body.
words.ex_cn: 这种寄生虫生活在宿主的体内。
words.en: A parasite is an organism that lives on or in a host organism and gets its food from or at the expense of its host.

words.ex: The river has a large outflow into the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这条河有大量的水流流入大海。
words.en: An outflow is an amount of something such as a liquid or gas that flows out from a place.

words.ex: He gave a quick preview of the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他简要预看了这部电影。
words.en: A preview is an opportunity to see something such as a film or a collection of works of art before it is open to the public.

words.tr: adj. 有帮助的；乐器的；仪器的；
words.ex: Her advice was instrumental in helping me pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 她的建议对帮助我通过考试很有帮助。
words.en: If someone or something is instrumental in a process, plan, or system, they are one of the most important influences in causing it to happen.

words.ex: He was forcibly taken by the police.
words.ex_cn: 他被警察强行带走了。
words.en: In a way that involves physical force or strength, especially against someone's will.

words.ex: The non-profit helps poor children.
words.ex_cn: 这个非营利组织帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: A non-profit organization is one that is not run with the aim of making a profit.

words.ex: The machine makes a perpetual noise.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器发出持续的噪音。
words.en: Something that is perpetual continues indefinitely or for a very long time without interruption.

words.ex: The police did an interrogation at night.
words.ex_cn: 警察在晚上进行了审问。
words.en: The process of asking someone a lot of questions in order to get information, especially in a police or military context.

words.ex: The rain offset the heat yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天的雨抵消了炎热。
words.en: If one thing is offset by another, the effect of the first thing is reduced by the second, so that any advantage or disadvantage is cancelled out.

words.tr: v. 使中立；中和；使无效
words.ex: The government tried to neutralize the conflict by talking to both sides.
words.ex_cn: 政府试图通过与双方交谈来使冲突中立化。
words.en: To neutralize something means to stop it from having any effect or to make it ineffective.

words.ex: The students handed in a petition to the principal.
words.ex_cn: 学生们向校长递交了一份请愿书。
words.en: A petition is a document signed by a lot of people which asks a government or other official group to do a particular thing.

words.ex: He pressed the pedal to speed up the bike.
words.ex_cn: 他踩下踏板让自行车加速。
words.en: A pedal is a lever that you press with your foot in order to control a vehicle or machine.

words.ex: His nickname is 'Speedy' because he runs fast.
words.ex_cn: 他的绰号是‘飞毛腿’，因为他跑得快。
words.en: A nickname is an informal name for someone or something, especially a name that you are called by your friends or family, usually based on your real name or your character.

words.ex: He follows a dietary plan to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他遵循一种饮食计划来保持健康。
words.en: Relating to the diet or the kinds of food that a person, animal, or community habitually eats.

words.ex: The ticket is invalid because it expired.
words.ex_cn: 这张票无效，因为它已经过期了。
words.en: If something is invalid, it is not legally or officially acceptable, or it is not based on truth or reason.

words.ex: The school has a disciplinary policy for students who break rules.
words.ex_cn: 学校对违反规则的学生有纪律规定。
words.en: Relating to discipline; enforcing or administering discipline.

words.tr:
n. 小心；警告；注意；
v. 警告；劝...小心；
words.ex: He drove with caution on the icy road.
words.ex_cn: 他在结冰的道路上小心驾驶。
words.en: Caution is care that you take in order to avoid possible danger or trouble.

words.tr: n. 双层电汽车，双层甲板船，<美口>双层夹心三明治
words.ex: He bought a ticket for the double-decker bus.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一张双层巴士的票。
words.en: A double-decker is a bus or other vehicle that has two levels for passengers, one above the other.

words.tr:
n. 插图说明；标题；字幕
v. 加上说明；加上标题；加上字幕
words.ex: The photo has a caption that says 'Happy birthday'.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片有一个标题，写着‘生日快乐’。
words.en: A caption is a short piece of text under a picture in a book, magazine, or newspaper that describes the picture or explains what is happening in it.

words.tr:
v. 害怕；畏惧
n. 恐惧；畏惧
words.ex: He dreads going to the dentist.
words.ex_cn: 他害怕去看牙医。
words.en: If you dread something, you fear it intensely.

words.tr: adj. 仁慈的；慈善事业的；
words.ex: She gave charitable donations to the poor.
words.ex_cn: 她向穷人捐赠了仁慈的善款。
words.en: A charitable organization or activity helps and supports people who are ill, very poor, or who have disabilities.

words.tr:
adj. 最重要的；
adv. 首要地；
words.ex: He is the foremost expert in this field.
words.ex_cn: 他是这个领域最重要的专家。
words.en: Most important or prominent; leading.

words.tr: v. 打电话；“call”的现在分词；叫； n. 职业；
words.ex: He is calling his mother now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在正在给妈妈打电话。
words.en: A strong urge toward a particular way of life or career; a vocation.

words.tr: adj. 可疑的；怀疑的；拿不准的；
words.ex: The deal seemed dubious to me.
words.ex_cn: 这个交易在我看来很可疑。
words.en: If you describe something as dubious, you mean that you do not consider it to be completely honest, safe, or reliable.

words.tr:
n. 半身像；胸部；搜捕
v. 打碎；搜捕
adj. 破产的；打碎的
words.ex: The museum has a marble bust of the ancient king.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆里有一座古代国王的大理石半身像。
words.en: A bust is a sculpture of a person's head, shoulders, and chest. As a verb, to bust means to break something, to arrest someone, or to go bankrupt.

words.ex: The committee is consultative and gives advice.
words.ex_cn: 这个委员会是咨询性的，提供意见。
words.en: A consultative committee or document gives advice about something rather than having the power to make decisions or enforce laws.

words.tr: adj. 命中注定的； v. “destine”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was destined to become a great teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他命中注定会成为一名伟大的老师。
words.en: If something is destined to happen or if someone is destined to behave in a particular way, it seems certain to happen or they seem certain to behave in that way, often because of fate or because it has been decided in advance.

words.ex: The clan lived in a small village for centuries.
words.ex_cn: 这个氏族几个世纪以来一直住在一个小村庄里。
words.en: A clan is a group of families or relatives who are connected by blood or marriage and who often share the same surname.

words.ex: He is an eccentric man who wears socks with sandals.
words.ex_cn: 他是个古怪的人，穿着袜子配凉鞋。
words.en: If you say that someone is eccentric, you mean that they behave in a strange way, and have habits or opinions that are different from those of most people.

words.ex: The accident caused many casualties.
words.ex_cn: 这场事故造成了许多伤亡人员。
words.en: A casualty is a person who is killed or injured in a war or in an accident.

words.ex: There is a discrepancy between the two reports.
words.ex_cn: 这两份报告之间有差异。
words.en: A discrepancy is a difference between two or more things that should be the same.

words.tr: n. 放宽监管；解除管制；
words.ex: The government introduced deregulation to help small businesses.
words.ex_cn: 政府推出了放宽监管措施以帮助小企业。
words.en: The removal of regulations or restrictions, especially in a particular industry.

words.ex: He felt a bodily pain after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他感到身体疼痛。
words.en: Relating to the human body.

words.ex: The riddle perplexed the children.
words.ex_cn: 这个谜语让孩子们感到困惑。
words.en: If something perplexes you, it confuses and worries you because you do not understand it or because it causes you difficulty.

words.ex: The midwife helped the baby come out safely.
words.ex_cn: 助产士帮助婴儿安全出生。
words.en: A midwife is a person, usually a woman, who is trained to help women during childbirth.

words.tr:
v. 振翼；颤动；飘动；挥动
n. 鼓翼；飘扬；激动不安
words.ex: The flag is fluttering in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 旗帜在风中飘扬。
words.en: If something thin or light flutters, or if you flutter it, it moves up and down or from side to side with a lot of quick, light movements.

words.tr: n. 领取退休、养老金或抚恤金的人；
words.ex: The pensioner walks his dog every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这位领取养老金的人每天早上都遛狗。
words.en: A pensioner is someone who receives a pension, especially a retirement pension.

words.tr: n. 先见；预见；先见之明
words.ex: He showed foresight by saving money for the future.
words.ex_cn: 他通过为未来存钱展现了远见。
words.en: The ability to predict or the action of predicting what will happen or be needed in the future.

words.tr: n. 交叉；相交；十字路口；交叉路口；
words.ex: The intersection of two roads is busy.
words.ex_cn: 两条路的交叉口很繁忙。
words.en: An intersection is a place where roads or other lines meet or cross.

words.ex: The pedestrian crossed the street at the zebra crossing.
words.ex_cn: 行人在斑马线处过马路。
words.en: A pedestrian is a person who is walking in a city, town, or village, especially along a pavement or in a pedestrian area.

words.ex: The data points correlate with each other.
words.ex_cn: 这些数据点相互关联。
words.en: If one thing correlates with another, there is a close similarity or connection between them, often because one thing causes the other.

words.tr: v. 复制；复印；再做一次；
words.ex: He duplicated the file to save a copy.
words.ex_cn: 他复制了该文件以保存一份副本。
words.en: To duplicate something means to make an exact copy of it.

words.ex: Bread and rice are rich in carbohydrate.
words.ex_cn: 面包和米饭富含碳水化合物。
words.en: A carbohydrate is a substance found in foods such as bread, potatoes, and rice which provides your body with heat and energy and which consists of carbon, hydrogen, and oxygen.

words.ex: Farming is his main livelihood.
words.ex_cn: 务农是他的主要生计。
words.en: A person's livelihood is the way they earn money in order to live.

words.ex: Can you differentiate between the two colors?
words.ex_cn: 你能区分这两种颜色吗？
words.en: To differentiate means to recognize or express the difference between things or people.

words.tr: v. 珍爱；爱惜；怀念；怀有（感情）；抱有（希望）
words.ex: I cherish the time I spend with my family.
words.ex_cn: 我珍惜与家人共度的时光。
words.en: If you cherish something, you care for it lovingly and protect it carefully.

words.ex: The team worked in a harmonious way.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队以和谐的方式合作。
words.en: A harmonious situation, relationship, or agreement is one in which people are friendly and helpful to one another, and in which there is no serious disagreement or argument.

words.tr:
n. 司法部；司法制度；法官（总称）
adj. 司法的；法院的；法官的
words.ex: The judiciary made a fair decision.
words.ex_cn: 司法部做出了公正的裁决。
words.en: The judiciary is the system of courts that interprets and applies the law in the name of the state.

words.tr:
adj. 同性恋的
n. 同性恋者
words.ex: He is homosexual and loves his partner.
words.ex_cn: 他是同性恋，爱他的伴侣。
words.en: A homosexual is someone who is sexually attracted to people of the same sex.

words.ex: The magnitude of this decision will affect everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个决定的重要性会影响每个人。
words.en: Magnitude refers to the great size or extent of something, or the importance of something.

words.ex: They argued hotly about the decision.
words.ex_cn: 他们激动地争论这个决定。
words.en: If something is done hotly, it is done with a lot of strong feeling or enthusiasm.

words.ex: He has a managerial role in the company.
words.ex_cn: 他在公司中担任管理职务。
words.en: relating to the job of a manager

words.tr:
v. 提取；
n. 摘录；提取物；
words.ex: They extract oil from plants.
words.ex_cn: 他们从植物中提取油。
words.en: To remove or take out something, especially by effort or force.

words.tr: n. 人文主义者；人道主义者；
words.ex: He is a humanist who values kindness and reason.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位重视仁爱与理性的文艺复兴人文主义者。
words.en: A humanist is someone who believes in the value and dignity of all human beings, often emphasizing the importance of human values and the human condition over religious or supernatural beliefs.

words.ex: This temperature is the optimum for growing plants.
words.ex_cn: 这个温度是最适宜植物生长的。
words.en: The optimum is the best or most favorable condition, degree, amount, etc., for achieving a particular result.

words.ex: The humidity in the room made the air feel heavy.
words.ex_cn: 房间里的湿度让空气感觉很闷。
words.en: Humidity is the amount of water vapor in the air. High humidity makes the air feel wet and sticky.

words.ex: He is an icon of pop music.
words.ex_cn: 他是流行音乐的偶像。
words.en: An icon is a small picture or symbol on a computer screen that represents a program or a file.

words.tr: v. 使相混；使联结；交际
words.ex: He mingled the two colors to make a new one.
words.ex_cn: 他把两种颜色混合在一起，创造出一种新颜色。
words.en: If things such as sounds, smells, or feelings mingle, they mix or combine with each other, or if people mingle, they talk to each other at a social event.

words.ex: The child gave an imaginative story about flying cats.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子讲了一个关于会飞的猫的富有想象力的故事。
words.en: If you describe someone or their ideas as imaginative, you are praising them because they are easily able to think of or create new or exciting things.

words.tr: adj. 法律许可的；守法的；合法的
words.ex: He did a lawful job to help the community.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一份合法的工作来帮助社区。
words.en: If something is lawful, it is allowed by the law.

words.ex: The new law gave impetus to environmental protection.
words.ex_cn: 新法律为环境保护提供了推动力。
words.en: Something that gives a process impetus or an impetus makes it happen or progress more quickly.

words.ex: The legend says a dragon lives in the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 传说有一条龙住在山里。
words.en: A legend is a very old and popular story that may be true or may be imaginary.

words.tr: n. 工艺专科学院；理工专科学院；
words.ex: He enrolled in a polytechnic to learn engineering.
words.ex_cn: 他进入了一所工艺专科学院学习工程。
words.en: A polytechnic is an institution of higher education offering courses in many subjects, especially vocational or technical subjects.

words.tr: v. 开创；为（某人）举行就职典礼；为…举行开幕仪式
words.ex: The president will inaugurate the new hospital next week.
words.ex_cn: 总统将于下周为新医院举行揭幕仪式。
words.en: If you inaugurate a new system, service, or project, you start it or introduce it officially.

words.tr: adj. 固执己见的；顽固的
words.ex: He is opinionated and never changes his mind.
words.ex_cn: 他很有主见，从不改变主意。
words.en: If you describe someone as opinionated, you mean that they have very strong opinions and refuse to accept that they may be wrong.

words.ex: The painting is considered a masterpiece by art critics.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画被艺术评论家视为杰作。
words.en: A masterpiece is a work of art such as a painting, film, or book that is made with great skill and is considered to be the best work of a particular artist or writer.

words.ex: There is an inconsistency between his words and actions.
words.ex_cn: 他的言行不一致。
words.en: The quality or state of being inconsistent; lack of consistency.

words.tr: n. 运作方式；力学；“mechanic”的复数；
words.ex: The mechanics of this machine are simple to understand.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器的运作方式很简单易懂。
words.en: Mechanics is the branch of physics that deals with the action of forces on bodies and with motion, comprised of kinetics, statics, and kinematics.

words.ex: The app has an interactive game for kids.
words.ex_cn: 这个应用有一个适合孩子的交互式游戏。
words.en: An interactive computer program or system is designed to involve the user in the exchange of information.

words.ex: The monks live in a quiet monastery.
words.ex_cn: 僧侣们住在一座安静的修道院里。
words.en: A monastery is a building or collection of buildings in which monks live and work.

words.ex: He incurred a fine for speeding.
words.ex_cn: 他因超速而招致了一笔罚款。
words.en: If you incur something unpleasant, it happens to you because of something you have done.

words.ex: The presidential speech was broadcast on TV.
words.ex_cn: 总统的演讲在电视上播出。
words.en: Relating to a president or presidency.

words.ex: The dogs had three offspring last spring.
words.ex_cn: 这些狗去年春天生了三只幼崽。
words.en: Someone's offspring are their children.

words.ex: The university has great prestige for its research.
words.ex_cn: 这所大学因其研究而享有很高的声望。
words.en: The widespread respect and admiration felt for someone or something on the basis of a perception of their achievements or quality.

words.ex: The two groups are discrete and do not overlap.
words.ex_cn: 这两个群体是分离的，没有重叠。
words.en: Something that is discrete is separate and distinct in form or concept.

words.ex: Pandas and bamboo coexist in the wild.
words.ex_cn: 熊猫和竹子在野外共存。
words.en: The state or fact of existing at the same time or in the same place.

words.ex: The plane began its descent at 10,000 feet.
words.ex_cn: 飞机在一万英尺高度开始下降。
words.en: The act of moving or falling downward.

words.ex: The bishop moves diagonally across the chessboard.
words.ex_cn: 象在国际象棋棋盘上斜着走。
words.en: A bishop is a senior member of the Christian clergy, usually in charge of a diocese and empowered to confer holy orders.

words.tr: v. 考虑；深思；凝视；思考…的可能性
words.ex: He contemplates quitting his job.
words.ex_cn: 他正在考虑辞去工作。
words.en: If you contemplate an action, you think about whether to do it or not.

words.ex: The book has a finite number of pages.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的页数是有限的。
words.en: Something that is finite has a definite fixed size or extent.

words.tr:
n. 意图；目的；
adj. 专注的；
words.ex: His intent was to help, not to hurt.
words.ex_cn: 他的意图是帮助，而不是伤害。
words.en: If you are intent on doing something, you are determined to get it done. If you have an intent to do something, you have a plan or purpose in mind.

words.ex: Notwithstanding the rain, they went for a walk.
words.ex_cn: 虽然下着雨，他们还是去散步了。
words.en: In spite of; although.

words.tr: adj. 普遍的；流行的；盛行的；
words.ex: Smoking is prevalent in that country.
words.ex_cn: 在那个国家，吸烟很普遍。
words.en: If a condition, practice, or belief is prevalent, it is common or widespread.

words.ex: He flipped the pancake with a spatula.
words.ex_cn: 他用铲子快速翻转了煎饼。
words.en: To flip something means to turn it over quickly one or more times, or to make something do this.

chapters.name: 较高要求词汇 Word List 32

words.ex: The people tried to overthrow the corrupt government.
words.ex_cn: 人民试图推翻腐败的政府。
words.en: To overthrow a government or a leader means to remove them from power, often by force.

words.ex: The dictator ruled the country for many years.
words.ex_cn: 这位独裁者统治这个国家很多年。
words.en: A dictator is a ruler who has complete power in a country, especially when this power has been obtained by force and is used unfairly or cruelly.

words.ex: He infringes the rules by arriving late.
words.ex_cn: 他因迟到而违反了规则。
words.en: To infringe means to violate or break a law, agreement, or right.

words.ex: The penguin walks on the ice.
words.ex_cn: 企鹅在冰上行走。
words.en: A penguin is a type of bird that cannot fly, lives in the southern hemisphere, and swims very well.

words.tr: adj. 东方的（尤指中国和日本）
words.ex: He bought an oriental rug at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一张东方地毯。
words.en: Oriental is used to describe things that come from or are associated with eastern Asia, especially China and Japan.

words.ex: The castle is a medieval building.
words.ex_cn: 这座城堡是一座中世纪的建筑。
words.en: Relating to the Middle Ages, the period in European history from about the 5th century to the 15th century.

words.tr:
v. （突然）烧旺；闪耀；突然爆发；张开；加剧
n. 旺火；亮光
words.ex: The fire began to flare up suddenly.
words.ex_cn: 火突然燃了起来。
words.en: A flare is a sudden bright light or flame, or a sudden increase in something such as activity or trouble.

words.ex: The boxing match took place in an arena.
words.ex_cn: 拳击比赛在竞技场举行。
words.en: An arena is a place or scene of activity, debate, or conflict, especially one where a competition or performance is held.

words.ex: The country is on the brink of war.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正处于战争的边缘。
words.en: If you are on the brink of something, you are about to do it or experience it.

words.ex: The child showed obedience to his parents.
words.ex_cn: 孩子对父母表现出顺从。
words.en: Obedience is the act of following orders or instructions from someone in authority.

words.tr: adj. 自吹自擂的；自夸的
words.ex: He is boastful about his new car.
words.ex_cn: 他炫耀自己的新车。
words.en: If someone is boastful, they talk too proudly about something that they have done or that they own.

words.ex: The company will consolidate two departments next month.
words.ex_cn: 公司下个月将合并两个部门。
words.en: To consolidate something means to make it stronger, more secure, or more solid.

words.tr:
v. 使困惑；难倒；阻碍
n. 挡板；遮护物；阻碍体
words.ex: The magic trick baffled the children.
words.ex_cn: 这个魔术让孩子们感到困惑。
words.en: If something baffles you, you cannot understand it or explain it.

words.ex: The factory reduces emission to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 工厂减少排放以保护环境。
words.en: An emission is the production and discharge of something, especially gas or radiation.

words.tr:
v. 酿造；沏；酝酿
n. 酿造的饮料；啤酒
words.ex: He brews coffee every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上冲咖啡。
words.en: If you brew tea or coffee, you make it by pouring hot water over tea leaves or ground coffee. If you brew beer, you make it by soaking grain in water and then fermenting it.

words.ex: He looked up the country in an atlas.
words.ex_cn: 他在地图册里查找那个国家。
words.en: An atlas is a book of maps or charts.

words.ex: His behavioral changes worried his parents.
words.ex_cn: 他的行为变化让他的父母担心。
words.en: Relating to the way in which someone behaves.

words.ex: His behavioural changes worried his parents.
words.ex_cn: 他的行为变化让他的父母担心。
words.en: Relating to or involving behaviour.

words.tr: adj. 可食用的；可以吃的；
words.ex: These mushrooms are edible and safe to eat.
words.ex_cn: 这些蘑菇是可食用的，安全可以吃。
words.en: Fit to be eaten as food.

words.ex: His decisive action saved the team.
words.ex_cn: 他果断的行动拯救了团队。
words.en: If a fact, action, or event is decisive, it makes it certain that there will be a particular result.

words.tr: adj. 与选举有关的；选举的
words.ex: He won the electoral vote by a small margin.
words.ex_cn: 他以微弱优势赢得了选举人票。
words.en: Relating to elections or electors.

words.ex: He uses deductive reasoning to solve the puzzle.
words.ex_cn: 他使用演绎推理来解决这个谜题。
words.en: Deductive reasoning is a logical process in which a conclusion is based on the concordance of multiple premises that are generally assumed to be true.

words.tr: adj. 雄辩的；有口才的；有说服力的
words.ex: He gave an eloquent speech at the ceremony.
words.ex_cn: 他在仪式上发表了富有感染力的演讲。
words.en: If you describe someone as eloquent, you mean that they are able to express their ideas and opinions well, so that other people understand them and are influenced by them.

words.ex: This is a good example of teamwork.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个团队合作的好例子。
words.en: An example is a particular instance of something that is representative of a group or used to illustrate a point.

words.ex: He eats cauliflower with dinner every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚餐都吃花椰菜。
words.en: Cauliflower is a large, round, white vegetable that is eaten cooked or raw.

words.tr: adj. 卓越的；杰出的；罕见的；特别的；
words.ex: She is an exceptional student who always gets top grades.
words.ex_cn: 她是一名卓越的学生，总是取得最高分。
words.en: An exceptional person or thing has some unusual quality or ability that makes them different from others.

words.ex: He erased the wrong answer with an eraser.
words.ex_cn: 他用橡皮擦掉了错误的答案。
words.en: To erase something means to remove it completely from a surface or from a place where it is stored.

words.tr: n. 象牙；象牙色 adj. 象牙色的
words.ex: The old piano has ivory keys.
words.ex_cn: 这架旧钢琴有象牙键。
words.en: Ivory is a hard, white material from the tusks and teeth of animals, which is used to make or decorate objects.

words.tr:
n. 溢出；
v. 泛滥；
words.ex: The rain caused an overflow of the river.
words.ex_cn: 雨水导致河水溢出。
words.en: If a liquid or a river overflows, it flows over the edges of the container or place it is in.

words.ex: The loud noise gave her a sudden fright.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音让她吓了一跳。
words.en: A sudden intense feeling of fear.

words.ex: The gland makes saliva in her mouth.
words.ex_cn: 这个腺体在她的嘴里产生唾液。
words.en: An organ in the body which produces and releases substances that perform a specific function in the body, such as hormones or sweat.

words.tr:
n. 闪光；一刹那；
v. 闪光；闪现；
words.ex: The camera captured a sudden flash of light.
words.ex_cn: 相机捕捉到了一道突然的闪光。
words.en: A flash is a sudden bright light that quickly disappears. As a verb, it means to shine brightly for a short time or to appear or pass suddenly.

words.tr: adj. 可协商的；可转让的；可通行的
words.ex: The price is negotiable.
words.ex_cn: 价格可以商量。
words.en: If you describe something as negotiable, you mean that it can be changed or agreed upon through discussion.

words.ex: The glare of the sun made it hard to see.
words.ex_cn: 阳光的刺眼使我看不清。
words.en: If you glare at someone, you look at them with an angry expression on your face. Glare is also a very bright light that is uncomfortable to look at.

words.ex: He is the liaison between the two departments.
words.ex_cn: 他是两个部门之间的联络人。
words.en: A liaison is a person who acts as a link to assist communication between different groups or organizations.

words.tr:
v. 上釉；上玻璃；浇浆汁于；变呆滞
n. 釉料；光滑面；覆罩的一层
words.ex: The potter glazes the clay bowl before firing it.
words.ex_cn: 陶匠在烧制前给陶碗上釉。
words.en: To glaze means to fit panes of glass into a window frame or similar structure. It can also refer to the process of applying a glossy, often transparent, coating to pottery or other materials.

words.ex: He jogs every morning to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上慢跑以保持健康。
words.en: To run at a slow, steady pace, especially as a form of exercise.

words.tr:
n. 筛子；滤器
v. 筛；滤
words.ex: He used a sieve to separate sand from pebbles.
words.ex_cn: 他用筛子把沙子和石子分开。
words.en: A sieve is a tool consisting of a wire or plastic mesh held in a frame, used for separating solids from liquids or larger particles from smaller ones.

words.ex: Radium glows in the dark.
words.ex_cn: 镭在黑暗中发光。
words.en: Radium is a chemical element with the symbol Ra and atomic number 88. It is the sixth element in group 2 of the periodic table, also known as the alkaline earth metals. Pure radium is silvery-white, but it readily reacts with nitrogen (rather than oxygen) upon exposure to air, forming a black surface layer of radium nitride.

words.ex: He wrote a scholarly article about ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于古代历史的学术性文章。
words.en: A scholarly person or activity is serious and academic, and involves a lot of reading and studying.

words.ex: The transcontinental railway was a monumental engineering achievement.
words.ex_cn: 横贯大陆的铁路是一项伟大的工程成就。
words.en: Extending or going across a continent.

words.ex: The savage wolf howled under the moon.
words.ex_cn: 那头野性的狼在月光下嚎叫。
words.en: A savage person or animal is very fierce and violent.

words.ex: The movie got a high rating from viewers.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影获得了观众的高评分。
words.en: A rating is a classification or ranking of someone or something based on a comparative assessment of their quality, standard, or performance.

words.tr: n. 营业额；人员流动率；周转率；
words.ex: The store's turnover increased last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店上个月的营业额增加了。
words.en: The amount of money taken by a business in a particular period.

words.ex: The temple is a sacred place for believers.
words.ex_cn: 这座寺庙对信徒来说是神圣的地方。
words.en: Something that is sacred is considered to be holy or connected with God or a god.

words.ex: She ate a prune for a healthy snack.
words.ex_cn: 她吃了一颗梅干作为健康零食。
words.en: To prune means to cut off some of the branches of a tree or bush to make it grow better. It can also mean to reduce the extent of something by removing superfluous or unwanted parts.

words.tr: adj. 鲁莽的；不计后果的；
words.ex: He drove reckless and got into an accident.
words.ex_cn: 他开车鲁莽，结果出了事故。
words.en: If you say that someone is reckless, you mean that they act in a way which shows that they do not care about danger or the effect their behaviour will have on other people.

words.tr: n. 雕刻（术）；雕塑品；雕刻品；
words.ex: He made a beautiful sculpture from clay.
words.ex_cn: 他用黏土做了一件精美的雕刻。
words.en: Sculpture is the art of making two- or three-dimensional representative or abstract forms, especially by carving stone or wood or by casting metal or plaster.

words.ex: The timid boy whispered his answer.
words.ex_cn: 这个害羞的男孩小声说出了他的答案。
words.en: If you describe someone's behavior or actions as timid, you are criticizing them for being too cautious or slow to act, because they are nervous about the possible consequences of their actions.

words.ex: He will rectify the mistake tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会纠正这个错误。
words.en: If you rectify something that is wrong, you change it so that it becomes correct or satisfactory.

words.ex: He got the promotion because of his seniority.
words.ex_cn: 他因为资历深而获得了晋升。
words.en: Seniority is the state of being older or higher in rank than someone else.

words.ex: The new regime changed the tax laws.
words.ex_cn: 新的管理制度改变了税法。
words.en: A regime is the set of rules or the way that a country or organization is governed, especially when it is considered to be strict or unfair.

words.ex: We eat turkey on Thanksgiving.
words.ex_cn: 我们在感恩节吃火鸡。
words.en: Thanksgiving is a national holiday celebrated primarily in the United States and Canada as a day of giving thanks for the blessing of the harvest and of the preceding year.

words.ex: The prosecution brought evidence against the suspect.
words.ex_cn: 起诉方提供了针对嫌疑人的证据。
words.en: The act or process of holding a trial against a person who is accused of a crime to see if they are guilty.

words.ex: The error is negligible.
words.ex_cn: 这个误差可以忽略。
words.en: If you describe something as negligible, you mean that it is so small or unimportant that it is not worth considering or worrying about.

words.tr: adj. 眼的；视觉的；光学的
words.ex: He wears optic glasses to see clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他戴光学眼镜以便看得清楚。
words.en: Relating to the eye or vision.

words.tr: adj. 断断续续的；间歇的
words.ex: The rain is intermittent today.
words.ex_cn: 今天雨断断续续地下。
words.en: Something that is intermittent happens occasionally rather than continuously.

words.ex: The probability of rain tomorrow is high.
words.ex_cn: 明天下雨的概率很高。
words.en: A probability is a measure of how likely it is that some event will occur.

words.tr: v. 减到最少；使最小化；
words.ex: Try to minimize waste in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 尽量减少厨房里的浪费。
words.en: To minimize something means to reduce it to the smallest possible amount or degree.

words.ex: The beer left foam on the top of the glass.
words.ex_cn: 啤酒在杯子顶部留下了一层泡沫。
words.en: Foam is a mass of small bubbles that are formed in or on a liquid.

words.ex: He left school at 15, which was too premature.
words.ex_cn: 他15岁就离开了学校，这太早了。
words.en: Happening or done before the usual or expected time; not fully developed or mature.

words.ex: It was raining, nonetheless, we went for a walk.
words.ex_cn: 天下着雨，尽管如此，我们还是去散步了。
words.en: Nonetheless is used to indicate that something is true or happens in spite of what has just been said.

words.tr: adj. 可容许的；可承认的
words.ex: It is permissible to use a calculator in this test.
words.ex_cn: 在这次考试中使用计算器是允许的。
words.en: If something is permissible, it is considered to be acceptable because it does not break any laws or rules.

words.ex: The car accident caused one fatality.
words.ex_cn: 这场车祸导致一人死亡。
words.en: A fatality is a death caused by an accident or by violence, or is the fact of causing death.

words.ex: He sits on the porch and drinks coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在门廊上喝咖啡。
words.en: A porch is a covered shelter projecting in front of the entrance of a building.

words.ex: He used the sun to orient himself.
words.ex_cn: 他用太阳来确定方向。
words.en: To orient means to align or position something in relation to the points of a compass or other specified positions, or to familiarize someone with a new situation or environment.

words.tr: v. 主持；指挥；担任会议主席
words.ex: He presides over the meeting every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周一主持会议。
words.en: To preside means to be in charge of a formal meeting, ceremony, or other event.

words.tr: adj. 值得注意的；显著的；
words.ex: This result is noteworthy because it changes our understanding.
words.ex_cn: 这个结果值得注意，因为它改变了我们的理解。
words.en: If you describe something as noteworthy, you mean that it is interesting, significant, or important enough to deserve attention or to be noticed.

words.tr: n. 特性；怪癖；奇异之物
words.ex: One peculiarity of the old house is its red door.
words.ex_cn: 这座老房子的一个特点是它的红门。
words.en: A peculiarity is a characteristic or quality that is distinctive or unique to a particular person, place, or thing.

words.tr:
adj. 内陆的；
adv. 向内地；在内陆；
n. 内地；内陆；
words.ex: The small village is located inland, far from the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这个小村庄位于内陆，远离大海。
words.en: Inland means situated in the interior of a country rather than on the coast.

words.tr: adj. 公开的；明显的；公然的
words.ex: His anger was overt and hard to miss.
words.ex_cn: 他的愤怒是明显的，很难忽视。
words.en: An overt action or attitude is done or shown in an open and obvious way.

words.tr:
v. 拍动；摆动；
n. 薄片；
words.ex: The bird flaps its wings to fly.
words.ex_cn: 鸟拍动翅膀飞翔。
words.en: A flap is a piece of cloth, paper, skin etc that is fixed at one edge to a surface, which you can lift up easily. If something such as a piece of cloth or paper flaps or if you flap it, it moves quickly up and down or from side to side.

words.ex: The ozone layer protects us from the sun's harmful rays.
words.ex_cn: 臭氧层保护我们免受太阳有害射线的伤害。
words.en: Ozone is a form of oxygen that has three atoms in each molecule, and it is a pale blue gas with a pungent smell. It is found in the Earth's atmosphere and absorbs ultraviolet radiation, which is harmful to living organisms.

words.tr: adj. 肌肉的；肌肉发达的；
words.ex: He has a muscular arm from lifting weights.
words.ex_cn: 他因为举重而拥有强壮的手臂。
words.en: Relating to or affecting the muscles; having well-developed muscles.

words.tr:
adj. 无准备的；即兴的；即席的
adv. 无准备地；即兴地；即席地
words.ex: He gave an impromptu speech at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他在派对上做了一次即兴演讲。
words.en: An impromptu action is one that you do without planning or organizing it in advance.

words.ex: She put on red lipstick before the party.
words.ex_cn: 她在派对前涂了红色口红。
words.en: Lipstick is a colored substance in the form of a stick, used for coloring the lips.

words.tr: adj. 包容的；包含全部费用的；
words.ex: The school is inclusive and welcomes all students.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校是包容的，欢迎所有学生。
words.en: Inclusive is used to describe something that is designed to include all types of people, things, or ideas, and to treat them all fairly and equally.

words.ex: The metallic spoon felt cold in her hand.
words.ex_cn: 金属勺子在她手中感觉很冷。
words.en: Metallic means relating to or resembling metal or metals.

words.ex: His incompetence caused the project to fail.
words.ex_cn: 他的无能力导致项目失败。
words.en: If you refer to someone's incompetence, you are criticizing them because they are unable to do their job or a task properly.

words.ex: The study uses a new methodology to collect data.
words.ex_cn: 这项研究使用了一种新的方法论来收集数据。
words.en: A methodology is a system of methods and principles for doing something, for example for teaching or for carrying out research.

words.ex: He made a plea for help.
words.ex_cn: 他恳求帮助。
words.en: A plea is a request or an appeal made in an urgent or emotional manner, or a statement made by someone in a court of law in which they say whether they are guilty of a crime or not.

words.ex: He felt indignant when they blamed him for the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 当他们把错误归咎于他时，他感到愤愤不平。
words.en: If you are indignant, you are shocked and angry, because you think that something is unjust or unfair.

words.ex: The militia protected the village during the conflict.
words.ex_cn: 民兵在冲突期间保护了村庄。
words.en: A militia is a group of people who are not professional soldiers but who have military training and can act as an army.

words.tr: adj. 诱导的；归纳的；感应的
words.ex: The scientist used inductive reasoning to form a hypothesis.
words.ex_cn: 科学家使用归纳推理来形成一个假设。
words.en: Inductive reasoning involves making broad generalizations from specific observations.

words.ex: He waved a patriotic flag during the parade.
words.ex_cn: 他在游行中挥舞着一面爱国的旗帜。
words.en: If someone is patriotic, they feel love, loyalty, and respect for their country.

words.ex: The renaissance brought new art and ideas to Europe.
words.ex_cn: 文艺复兴为欧洲带来了新的艺术和思想。
words.en: The Renaissance was a period in European history marking the transition from the Middle Ages to modernity and covering the 15th and 16th centuries, characterized by an effort to revive and surpass ideas and achievements of classical antiquity.

words.ex: They booked a hotel suite for their honeymoon.
words.ex_cn: 他们为蜜月预订了一间酒店套房。
words.en: A set of rooms designated for use together, especially in a hotel; a set of musical compositions designed to be performed in a sequence.

words.ex: He felt the repression of his true feelings.
words.ex_cn: 他感受到了压抑自己真实情感的痛苦。
words.en: Repression is the act of subduing someone or something by force, or the state of being subdued in such a way.

words.ex: The supervisor checked the workers' progress.
words.ex_cn: 主管检查了工人们的进展。
words.en: A supervisor is a person who oversees and directs the work of others.

words.ex: The purity of the water is checked every day.
words.ex_cn: 每天都会检查水的纯净度。
words.en: The quality or state of being pure, especially in terms of being free from anything that contaminates, pollutes, or dilutes.

words.tr:
v. 责备；指责
n. 责备；指责
words.ex: She reproached him for being late.
words.ex_cn: 她责备他迟到了。
words.en: To express disapproval or disappointment towards someone because of their actions or behavior.

words.ex: They traverse the forest to reach the village.
words.ex_cn: 他们横穿森林去到达村庄。
words.en: To traverse something means to move or travel across it, often with some difficulty.

words.tr:
adj. 季度的；
adv. 每季一次；
words.ex: The company releases its quarterly report every three months.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司每三个月发布一次季度报告。
words.en: Something that happens quarterly happens four times a year, at intervals of three months.

words.ex: The butterfly has perfect symmetry.
words.ex_cn: 这只蝴蝶有完美的对称性。
words.en: Symmetry is the quality of being made up of exactly similar parts facing each other or around an axis.

words.ex: He handed in his resignation last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周递交了辞职信。
words.en: The act of giving up a job or position in a formal or official way; also refers to the acceptance of something undesirable but inevitable.

words.tr:
n. 用力拉；拖拽；拖船
v. 用力拉；使劲拖；拖拽
words.ex: He gave a strong tug on the rope.
words.ex_cn: 他用力拉了绳子一下。
words.en: If you tug something or tug at it, you give it a quick and usually strong pull.

words.ex: The stray dog wandered into the backyard.
words.ex_cn: 这只走失的狗走进了后院。
words.en: If someone or something strays, they wander away from where they are supposed to be.

words.ex: The restoration of the old house took two years.
words.ex_cn: 这座老房子的修复花了两年时间。
words.en: The act of returning something to its original condition, or the state of being returned to its original condition.

words.tr: adj. 位于…的；处于…的境地的； v. 使位于；使坐落于；“situate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The house is situated near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子位于湖边。
words.en: If something is situated in a particular place or position, it is in that place or position.

words.tr:
v. 反驳；回嘴
n. 反驳；顶嘴
words.ex: He gave a quick retort when she criticized him.
words.ex_cn: 当她批评他时，他迅速回了一句。
words.en: If you retort, you reply angrily to someone.

words.tr: adj. 机智的；圆滑的；得体的
words.ex: He was tactful when he said no to her request.
words.ex_cn: 当他拒绝她的请求时，他很得体。
words.en: If you describe someone as tactful, you approve of them because they are careful not to say or do anything that would offend or upset other people.

words.tr:
n. 报复；报仇
v. 报复
words.ex: He wanted revenge for his brother's death.
words.ex_cn: 他想为他兄弟的死报仇。
words.en: Revenge involves hurting or punishing someone who has hurt or harmed you.

words.tr: v. （使）统一；（使）联合；（使）成一体；
words.ex: The two teams decided to unify their efforts.
words.ex_cn: 这两个团队决定统一他们的努力。
words.en: To unify means to make or become united, uniform, or whole.

words.ex: The rivalry between the two teams is very strong.
words.ex_cn: 这两支队伍之间的竞争非常激烈。
words.en: Competition for the same objective or for superiority in the same field.

words.ex: He crossed the threshold of adulthood at 18.
words.ex_cn: 他在18岁时进入了成年的起始点。
words.en: The threshold of something is the point at which it begins or changes.

words.ex: The rotary switch turns on the light.
words.ex_cn: 旋转开关打开灯。
words.en: Relating to or characterized by rotation.

words.tr:
adj. 连续的；连环的
n. 连续剧；连载小说
words.ex: He watched the serial episodes every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上观看连续的剧集。
words.en: A serial is a story or play that is broadcast on television or radio in several parts at fixed times, or a story that is published in a magazine or newspaper in several parts.

words.tr: adj. 摇晃的；颤抖的；不稳固的
words.ex: His hands are shaky when he holds the cup.
words.ex_cn: 他拿杯子时手在发抖。
words.en: If you describe a situation as shaky, you mean that it is weak or unstable, and seems unlikely to last long or be successful.

words.ex: The NGO acts as a watchdog for government spending.
words.ex_cn: 这个非政府组织作为政府开支的看门狗。
words.en: A watchdog is a person or group whose job is to check that companies, governments, or other organizations are not doing anything illegal or harmful.

words.tr:
n. 接力赛；轮换者；
v. 传达；传递；
words.ex: The boys ran in the 4x100 meter relay.
words.ex_cn: 男孩们参加了4x100米接力赛。
words.en: A relay is a race between teams in which each team member runs or swims one section of the race. In electronics, a relay is a device that allows a small electrical current to control a larger one.

words.ex: The two events happened simultaneously.
words.ex_cn: 这两个事件同时发生了。
words.en: Happening, existing, or done at the same time.

words.ex: He gave a vicious smile before leaving.
words.ex_cn: 他离开前露出一个恶毒的微笑。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as vicious, you mean that they are violent and cruel, or that they are intended to cause someone great harm or suffering.

words.ex: He felt guilt for his sin of lying.
words.ex_cn: 他因撒谎的罪行感到内疚。
words.en: Sin is an action or behaviour that is considered to be morally wrong according to religious or social laws.

words.ex: Exercise helps with your well-being.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼有助于你的健康。
words.en: The state of being comfortable, healthy, or happy.

words.ex: The city's skyline looks beautiful at night.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市的天际线在夜晚看起来很美。
words.en: The outline of land and buildings defined against the sky.

words.tr:
n. 之字形；锯齿形；
adj. 之字形的；曲折的；锯齿形的；
words.ex: The road makes a zigzag up the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 这条路沿着山呈之字形向上延伸。
words.en: A zigzag is a line that has a series of angles in it, like a continuous series of 'W's. It can also describe a path or route that proceeds by sharp turns in alternating directions.

words.ex: He tried to smuggle cigarettes across the border.
words.ex_cn: 他试图走私香烟过境。
words.en: To smuggle goods or people means to move them into or out of a country illegally.

words.ex: He writes a verse every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上写一首诗。
words.en: A verse is one of the parts into which a poem, a song, or a chapter of the Bible or the Koran is divided.

words.ex: The shipment arrived on time.
words.ex_cn: 运输按时到达了。
words.en: The act of sending goods from one place to another, especially by ship.

words.tr: adj. 暂定的；不确定的；试验性的；
words.ex: We made a tentative plan to meet next week.
words.ex_cn: 我们制定了一个下周见面的暂定计划。
words.en: If you make a tentative suggestion or plan, you make it without being sure that it is right or acceptable.

words.ex: He gave a sniff of the flower.
words.ex_cn: 他闻了闻那朵花。
words.en: To sniff is to breathe in air through your nose in a way that makes a noise, especially when you are trying to smell something or when you have a cold.

words.tr: v. 后退；减弱；退出（某种活动）
words.ex: The flood waters begin to recede.
words.ex_cn: 洪水开始退去。
words.en: If something recedes, it becomes more distant or less noticeable.

words.ex: The workers showed solidarity during the strike.
words.ex_cn: 工人们在罢工期间表现出团结。
words.en: Solidarity is unity or agreement of feeling or action, especially among individuals with a common interest; mutual support within a group.

words.ex: The refinery makes gasoline from oil.
words.ex_cn: 炼油厂从石油中生产汽油。
words.en: A refinery is a factory where a substance such as oil or sugar is refined.

words.tr:
n. 闪光；闪烁；活力
v. 闪光；焕发活力
words.ex: The diamond showed a tiny sparkle in the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 钻石在阳光下显示出一丝闪光。
words.en: If something sparkles, it shines brightly with a lot of small points of light.

words.ex: The company will withhold his salary until he signs the contract.
words.ex_cn: 公司会扣留他的工资，直到他签署合同。
words.en: If you withhold something that someone wants, you refuse to let them have it.

words.ex: The doctor checked the vein in his arm.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他手臂上的静脉。
words.en: A vein is a tube in your body that carries blood towards your heart. It can also refer to a thin layer of a mineral in rock, or a particular style or mood in writing or speech.

words.ex: He underestimated the difficulty of the test.
words.ex_cn: 他低估了考试的难度。
words.en: If you underestimate something, you do not realize how large, great, or serious it is.

words.ex: The spectator watched the game quietly.
words.ex_cn: 旁观者安静地观看了比赛。
words.en: A spectator is someone who watches an event, show, game, or activity.

words.ex: The loud thunder terrified the child.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的雷声吓坏了那个孩子。
words.en: If something terrifies you, it makes you feel extremely frightened.

words.tr:
n. 刺；戳
v. 刺；戳
words.ex: He felt a sharp stab in his side.
words.ex_cn: 他感到侧腹一阵刺痛。
words.en: If someone stabs you, they push a knife or sharp object into your body.

words.ex: The old machine is unworkable now.
words.ex_cn: 这台旧机器现在难以运转了。
words.en: If a plan, idea, or system is unworkable, it cannot be successful because it is not practical or because people do not agree with it.

words.ex: The bright light was a stimulus for the baby to open his eyes.
words.ex_cn: 明亮的光线是让婴儿睁开眼睛的刺激物。
words.en: Something that causes growth or activity.

words.ex: The upside of working late is more money.
words.ex_cn: 加班的好处是能赚更多钱。
words.en: The upside is the more positive aspect of a situation that is generally bad.

words.ex: He had a stumble on the rocky path.
words.ex_cn: 他在布满石头的小路上绊了一跤。
words.en: To stumble means to trip or momentarily lose one's balance while walking or running. It can also refer to speaking in a hesitant or faltering manner.

words.ex: He got a vaccine last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周打了疫苗。
words.en: A vaccine is a substance containing a virus or bacterium in a form that is not harmful, given to a person or animal to prevent them from getting the disease that the virus or bacterium causes.

words.ex: His submission to the boss ended the conflict.
words.ex_cn: 他对老板的屈服结束了这场冲突。
words.en: The act of submitting something to someone for their decision or consideration; the state of being submissive or obedient.

words.ex: Open the window to ventilate the room.
words.ex_cn: 打开窗户给房间通风。
words.en: To ventilate means to cause fresh air to enter and move around a room, building, etc., or to express your opinions or feelings about something openly.

words.ex: Children are susceptible to colds.
words.ex_cn: 孩子容易感冒。
words.en: If you are susceptible to something or someone, you are very likely to be influenced by them.

words.ex: He works in the telecom industry.
words.ex_cn: 他在电信行业工作。
words.en: Telecom refers to the technology and industry involved in communication over distances by cable, telegraph, telephone, or broadcasting.

words.ex: The negotiations ended in a standoff.
words.ex_cn: 谈判以僵局结束。
words.en: A standoff is a situation in which neither side in a conflict or dispute is willing to back down or compromise, resulting in a deadlock.

words.tr: adj. 发声的；嗓音的；直言不讳的；
words.ex: He made a vocal sound to get attention.
words.ex_cn: 他发出声音来引起注意。
words.en: If you are vocal about something, you express your opinions or feelings about it in a strong and public way.

words.ex: The country has a debt of one trillion dollars.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家有一万亿美元的债务。
words.en: A trillion is a number equal to 10^12 in the American system or 10^18 in the British system.

words.ex: He put his clothes in the wardrobe.
words.ex_cn: 他把衣服放进衣橱里。
words.en: A wardrobe is a tall cupboard or cabinet in which you can hang your clothes.

words.tr: adj. 经验主义的；以经验为根据的；
words.ex: The scientist used empirical data to support her theory.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家使用经验数据来支持她的理论。
words.en: Empirical evidence or study relies on practical experience rather than theories.

words.ex: The noise will diminish after midnight.
words.ex_cn: 午夜后噪音会减少。
words.en: If something diminishes, or if something diminishes it, it becomes reduced in size, importance, or intensity.

words.tr: n. 结构；布局；配置；外形
words.ex: The configuration of the computer is very simple.
words.ex_cn: 这台电脑的配置非常简单。
words.en: The arrangement of parts or elements in a particular form, figure, or combination.

words.tr: n. 入会；入学 ；登记；注册；加入人数
words.ex: His enrollment in the club was approved last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周被批准加入该俱乐部。
words.en: The act of officially joining a course, school, etc., or the number of people who do this.

words.ex: He contradicts what she said.
words.ex_cn: 他反驳了她的话。
words.en: If you contradict someone, you say that what they have just said is wrong, or you suggest that it is wrong by saying something different.

words.tr:
v. （使）突然移动；快速投掷；
n. 镖；
words.ex: The cat darted across the room.
words.ex_cn: 猫突然冲过房间。
words.en: A dart is a small, narrow object with a sharp point which can be thrown or shot. It can also mean to move suddenly and quickly in a particular direction.

words.ex: The two houses are adjacent to each other.
words.ex_cn: 这两栋房子彼此相邻。
words.en: If one thing is adjacent to another, it is next to it or adjoining it.

words.ex: The farmer's cultivation of rice takes months.
words.ex_cn: 农民种植水稻需要几个月的时间。
words.en: The process of trying to acquire or develop a quality or skill.

words.ex: The actuality is that he forgot his homework.
words.ex_cn: 事实是他忘了作业。
words.en: The state of existing in reality, as opposed to being potential, theoretical, or ideal.

words.ex: Wear a helmet to counteract the risk of head injury.
words.ex_cn: 戴头盔以对抗头部受伤的风险。
words.en: If you counteract something, you reduce its effect by doing something that produces an opposite effect.

words.ex: The company wants to decentralize its operations.
words.ex_cn: 公司希望将运营去中心化。
words.en: To decentralize means to distribute the administrative functions or powers of (a central authority) over a less concentrated area.

words.ex: The manager showed accountability for the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 经理对这个错误承担了责任。
words.en: The fact or condition of being accountable; responsibility.

words.ex: She turned on the cooker to boil water.
words.ex_cn: 她打开炉子烧水。
words.en: A cooker is a device or appliance used for cooking food.

words.ex: He accustoms himself to waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 他让自己习惯早起。
words.en: If you accustom yourself or someone else to something, you make yourself or them familiar with it or used to it.

words.ex: He fabricates excuses to avoid work.
words.ex_cn: 他编造借口来逃避工作。
words.en: To fabricate means to invent or produce something false in order to deceive someone.

words.ex: He handed me a pamphlet about the new park.
words.ex_cn: 他递给我一份关于新公园的小册子。
words.en: A pamphlet is a small book containing information on a particular subject or expressing political or religious views.

words.tr:
adj. 哑的；无声的
n. 哑巴；沉默的人
v. 减弱…的声音
words.ex: He stayed mute during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议期间保持沉默。
words.en: If someone is mute, they are unable to speak.

words.ex: Parents shouldn't indulge their children's bad habits.
words.ex_cn: 父母不应该放任孩子的坏习惯。
words.en: To indulge means to allow yourself or someone else to have something enjoyable, especially more than is good for you.

words.ex: He bought a paperback novel at the bookstore.
words.ex_cn: 他在书店买了一本平装小说。
words.en: A paperback is a book with a thin cardboard or paper cover, as opposed to a hardback, which has a hard cover.

words.ex: The feasibility of the project was checked by experts.
words.ex_cn: 专家们检查了这个项目的可行性。
words.en: Feasibility refers to the state or degree of being easily or conveniently done.

words.ex: The small boat docked at the inlet.
words.ex_cn: 小船停靠在小水湾。
words.en: An inlet is a narrow strip of water that leads from a sea or lake into the land or between islands.

words.ex: The virus can propagate quickly among people.
words.ex_cn: 这种病毒可以在人群中迅速传播。
words.en: To propagate something means to spread it and encourage more people to believe in it or support it.

words.tr:
v. 咕哝地抱怨；嘀咕
n. 咕哝地抱怨；嘀咕
words.ex: He mutters under his breath when he is angry.
words.ex_cn: 当他生气时，他会低声嘟囔。
words.en: To speak or say something in a low voice that is hard to hear, often because you are annoyed or complaining.

words.ex: She has a feminine voice.
words.ex_cn: 她的声音很女性化。
words.en: having qualities or an appearance traditionally associated with women, especially delicacy and prettiness.

words.tr: adj. 声名狼藉的；臭名昭著的；
words.ex: He is a notorious thief who stole from many stores.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个声名狼藉的小偷，偷过许多商店。
words.en: Someone or something that is notorious is well known for something bad.

words.tr: adj. 有独创性的；巧妙的；
words.ex: The child came up with an ingenious way to solve the puzzle.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子想出了一个有独创性的方式来解决这个谜题。
words.en: Something that is ingenious is very clever and involves new ideas, methods, or equipment.

words.ex: He eats porridge for breakfast every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃粥。
words.en: A type of food made by boiling oats or another cereal in water or milk.

words.ex: The knight wore heavy armor in the battle.
words.ex_cn: 骑士在战斗中穿着沉重的盔甲。
words.en: Armor is a protective covering that is used to prevent damage from being inflicted to an object, individual, or vehicle by direct contact weapons or projectiles, usually during combat.

words.ex: The knight wore heavy armour in the battle.
words.ex_cn: 骑士在战斗中穿着沉重的盔甲。
words.en: Armour is a protective covering that is used to prevent damage from being inflicted to an object, individual, or vehicle by direct contact weapons or projectiles, usually during combat.

words.ex: The councilor spoke at the town meeting.
words.ex_cn: 这位议员在镇会上发言了。
words.en: A councilor is a member of a council, especially one who is elected to represent a particular area or group of people.

words.ex: The councillor spoke at the town meeting.
words.ex_cn: 这位议员在镇会上发表了讲话。
words.en: A councillor is an elected member of a local government council.

words.tr: n. 乐观；乐观主义；乐观精神；
words.ex: His optimism helps him stay happy even when things are hard.
words.ex_cn: 他的乐观让他即使在困难时也能保持快乐。
words.en: Optimism is a feeling of hopefulness and confidence about the future or the success of something.

chapters.name: 更高要求词汇 Word List 33

words.ex: He gave his mother a massage after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后给妈妈做了按摩。
words.en: The act of rubbing and pressing someone's body with the hands to reduce tension or pain in the muscles.

words.ex: He uses a fake name for anonymity.
words.ex_cn: 他用假名来保持匿名。
words.en: The condition of being anonymous; the state of not having one's name or identity known.

words.ex: He is an eminent scientist who won the Nobel Prize.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位获得诺贝尔奖的杰出科学家。
words.en: An eminent person is well-known and respected, especially because they are good at their profession.

words.tr: n. 飞机座舱；赛车座舱；
words.ex: The pilot checked the instruments in the cockpit.
words.ex_cn: 飞行员在飞机座舱里检查了仪表。
words.en: The compartment where the pilot sits in an aircraft, from which the aircraft is controlled.

words.ex: He has diabetes and must check his blood every day.
words.ex_cn: 他患有糖尿病，必须每天检查血糖。
words.en: A medical condition in which the body cannot produce enough insulin or cannot use insulin properly, leading to high levels of sugar in the blood.

words.ex: The herald announced the king's arrival.
words.ex_cn: 传令官宣布了国王的到来。
words.en: A herald is someone who carries or proclaims important news; a forerunner or harbinger.

words.ex: He picked up a spoon, a common utensil.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起了一把勺子，一种常见的餐具。
words.en: An utensil is a tool that you use in your home, especially in the kitchen, for example, a knife, fork, or spoon.

words.tr: adj. 即将发生的；临近的；
words.ex: An imminent storm is coming soon.
words.ex_cn: 一场即将发生的风暴很快就要来了。
words.en: If you say that something is imminent, especially something unpleasant, you mean it is almost certain to happen very soon.

words.ex: The aliens abduct the man at night.
words.ex_cn: 外星人在晚上绑架了那个男人。
words.en: To take someone away illegally by force or deception; kidnap.

words.tr:
adv. 在其中；在那里；在那种情况下
conj. 其中；在那里；在那种情况下
words.ex: The book wherein he wrote his thoughts is old.
words.ex_cn: 他写下自己想法的那本书很旧了。
words.en: in which; in what way or respect

words.tr: n. 伙伴关系；合作；合作关系；
words.ex: They formed a partnership to run a small shop.
words.ex_cn: 他们建立了一种伙伴关系来经营一家小店。
words.en: A partnership is a legal form of business operation between two or more individuals who share management and profits.

words.ex: He kept neutrality during the argument.
words.ex_cn: 他在争论中保持中立。
words.en: The state of not supporting or helping either side in a conflict, disagreement, etc.; impartiality.

words.ex: The book is overdue at the library.
words.ex_cn: 这本书在图书馆逾期了。
words.en: If you say that a change or an event is overdue, you mean that you think it should have happened before now.

words.ex: He wrote a draft of the letter before sending it.
words.ex_cn: 他在发送之前写了这封信的草稿。
words.en: A draft is a preliminary version of a piece of writing, or a current of air in a room or other confined space. It can also refer to the act of selecting someone for a particular purpose or task, especially in sports or the military.

words.ex: The treasury decided to lower taxes.
words.ex_cn: 财政部决定降低税收。
words.en: The treasury is the department within a government that manages its finances, including the collection of taxes and the allocation of funds.

words.ex: The farmer owns five hectares of land.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民拥有五公顷土地。
words.en: A hectare is a unit of measurement of area, equal to 10,000 square metres or approximately 2.471 acres.

words.ex: She added bleach to the white shirt to make it brighter.
words.ex_cn: 她往白衬衫里加了漂白剂，让它更亮。
words.en: To bleach something means to make it white or pale by using a chemical or by exposing it to sunlight.

words.tr: n. 洗发水；洗发精；洗发香波；
words.ex: She bought a new shampoo at the store.
words.ex_cn: 她在商店买了一瓶新的洗发水。
words.en: Shampoo is a liquid soap that is used for washing your hair, or the act of washing your hair with this liquid.

words.ex: The court acquitted him of all charges.
words.ex_cn: 法院宣告他无罪。
words.en: If someone is acquitted of a crime in a court of law, they are formally declared not to have committed the crime.

words.ex: He ate a sweet melon for dessert.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一块甜瓜当甜点。
words.en: A melon is a large, juicy fruit with a hard rind, belonging to the gourd family, typically eaten fresh.

words.ex: This experiment is a paradigm of scientific method.
words.ex_cn: 这个实验是科学方法的范例。
words.en: A paradigm is a model or pattern that is considered to be a typical example of something.

words.ex: He used an abbreviation for 'company' in his note.
words.ex_cn: 他在笔记中用了'company'的缩写。
words.en: An abbreviation is a shortened form of a word or phrase.

words.tr: n. 种族主义；种族歧视；
words.ex: Racism is wrong and hurts many people.
words.ex_cn: 种族主义是错误的，会伤害很多人。
words.en: Racism is the belief that people of some races are inferior to others, often resulting in unfair treatment of people based on their race.

words.tr: adj. 在职的；负有义务的；
words.ex: The incumbent mayor won the election again.
words.ex_cn: 现任市长再次赢得了选举。
words.en: An incumbent is someone who currently holds a particular office or position, especially in politics. It can also refer to something that is necessary as a duty or responsibility.

words.ex: The snail moves slowly across the garden.
words.ex_cn: 蜗牛慢慢地爬过花园。
words.en: A snail is a small creature with a soft, wet body and a spiral shell. It moves very slowly.

words.ex: He drank beer in a small tavern.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小酒馆里喝啤酒。
words.en: A tavern is a place where alcoholic drinks are served and people gather to drink and socialize.

words.ex: He ate grilled shrimp for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐吃了烤虾。
words.en: A shrimp is a small shellfish with a long tail and many legs, which can be eaten as food.

words.ex: The country seeks hegemony over its neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家试图对邻国实现霸权。
words.en: Hegemony refers to the dominance or leadership of one group or state over others, especially in a political or cultural context.

words.ex: The commissioner ordered the police to stop the protest.
words.ex_cn: 长官命令警察制止抗议活动。
words.en: A commissioner is an official in charge of a government department or a public organization, especially in the UK.

words.ex: Her motto is 'Never give up.'
words.ex_cn: 她的座右铭是‘永不放弃’。
words.en: A motto is a short sentence or phrase that expresses a rule for sensible behavior, especially a way of behaving in a particular situation.

words.ex: She adorned her room with flowers.
words.ex_cn: 她用鲜花装饰了房间。
words.en: To adorn something means to make it more beautiful by adding something to it.

words.ex: He yearns for a better life.
words.ex_cn: 他渴望更好的生活。
words.en: If you yearn for something, you want it very much.

words.ex: He earned his doctorate in biology.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了生物学博士学位。
words.en: A doctorate is the highest level of academic degree awarded by universities, following the completion of a course of study demonstrating the ability to conduct independent research.

words.ex: The children played near the creek after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在小河旁玩耍。
words.en: A creek is a small, narrow stream or river.

words.tr: v. 对…予以惩罚；使处于不利地位
words.ex: The teacher will penalize students who cheat.
words.ex_cn: 老师会惩罚作弊的学生。
words.en: To penalize someone means to punish them or make them suffer in some way because they have done something wrong.

words.ex: The room has good acoustic properties.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有良好的声音效果。
words.en: Relating to sound or the sense of hearing.

words.tr:
n. 跨栏；障碍；难关
v. 越过障碍；克服
words.ex: He jumped over the hurdle quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速跳过了跨栏。
words.en: A hurdle is a problem or difficulty that you must deal with before you can achieve something.

words.ex: He faltered when asked his name.
words.ex_cn: 当被问到名字时，他犹豫了。
words.en: If you falter, you lose your confidence and stop doing something or start making mistakes.

words.tr: adj. 宏伟的；壮丽的；威严的；
words.ex: The majestic mountain stood above the clouds.
words.ex_cn: 那座宏伟的山峰耸立在云层之上。
words.en: If you describe something as majestic, you mean that it has a quality of greatness and impressiveness that often inspires admiration or awe.

words.tr: n. 烟蒂；屁股；枪托；笑柄
words.ex: He picked up the butt from the ground and threw it in the bin.
words.ex_cn: 他从地上捡起烟蒂，扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: The end of a cigarette that is left after smoking; the part of the body that a person sits on; a person or thing that is a target for ridicule or criticism; to hit or push someone or something with the head or horns.

words.ex: He tried to counterfeit money.
words.ex_cn: 他试图伪造货币。
words.en: Made in exact imitation of something valuable with the intention to deceive or defraud.

words.ex: The occupancy of the hotel is high during summer.
words.ex_cn: 夏天酒店的占用率很高。
words.en: The act of occupying or the state of being occupied, especially the condition of being occupied by tenants or the period during which a property is occupied.

words.ex: The brewery uses fresh mash to make beer.
words.ex_cn: 酿酒厂使用新鲜的麦芽浆来酿造啤酒。
words.en: To crush or smash something into a soft, pulpy mass.

words.ex: Smoking is detrimental to your health.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟对你的健康有害。
words.en: Something that is detrimental has a harmful or damaging effect on something else.

words.ex: He started afresh after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后从头开始。
words.en: If you do something afresh, you do it again in a different way, often in a way that is better than before.

words.tr:
n. 女权主义者
adj. 女权主义的
words.ex: She is a feminist who believes in equal rights.
words.ex_cn: 她是一位相信平等权利的女权主义者。
words.en: A feminist is a person who believes in and supports the rights and equality of women.

words.ex: The city was covered in haze this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上这座城市被雾霾笼罩。
words.en: Haze is a light mist or fog, especially one caused by the heat of the sun or by pollution.

words.ex: He takes the metro to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天乘地铁去上班。
words.en: A metro is an underground railway system in a city.

words.ex: He shuns loud parties because he is shy.
words.ex_cn: 他因为害羞而避开热闹的派对。
words.en: If you shun someone or something, you deliberately avoid them or keep away from them.

words.ex: The forest has rich flora with many wild flowers.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林有丰富的植物，有许多野花。
words.en: The plants of a particular region, habitat, or geological period.

words.ex: The maple leaves turn red in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 枫树的叶子在秋天变红。
words.en: A maple is a tree or shrub with lobed leaves, winged fruits, and colorful autumn foliage, which is often cultivated for its sap, wood, or ornamental value.

words.ex: The farmer feeds his livestock every morning.
words.ex_cn: 农夫每天早上喂他的家畜。
words.en: Livestock are animals such as cattle and sheep which are kept on a farm.

words.tr: n. 板条箱；箱子；篓；破旧的飞机或汽车；
words.ex: The apples were packed in a wooden crate.
words.ex_cn: 苹果被装在一个木板条箱里。
words.en: A crate is a large box used for transporting or storing goods.

words.ex: The scavengers fed on the carcass of the dead deer.
words.ex_cn: 食腐动物以那只死鹿的尸体为食。
words.en: The dead body of an animal, especially one that is ready to be cut up as meat or eaten by animals.

words.ex: The occupant of the room is sleeping.
words.ex_cn: 房间里的住户正在睡觉。
words.en: An occupant is someone who lives in or uses a particular room, building, or area of land.

words.ex: The stain on the carpet is a mar.
words.ex_cn: 地毯上的污渍是一个污点。
words.en: To mar something means to spoil or damage it.

words.ex: Her mornings are hectic with work and kids.
words.ex_cn: 她的早晨因为工作和孩子而紧张忙碌。
words.en: If you describe a situation as hectic, you mean that it is very busy and involves a lot of rushed activity.

words.ex: The historian criticized the feudalists for ignoring the rights of peasants.
words.ex_cn: 这位历史学家批评封建主义者忽视了农民的权利。
words.en: A feudalist is someone who supports or advocates for feudalism, a social system that existed in medieval Europe where people worked and fought for nobles who gave them protection and the use of land in return.

words.ex: The monk meditates every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这位僧侣每天早上冥想。
words.en: A monk is a member of a religious community of men who live by certain vows and usually wear a habit.

words.ex: The file size is reduced by compression.
words.ex_cn: 通过压缩，文件大小被减小了。
words.en: Compression is the act or process of making something smaller or pressing it into a smaller space, or the state of being pressed or squeezed in this way.

words.ex: He sings gospel music every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日唱福音音乐。
words.en: The teachings of Jesus and the apostles, especially as contained in the first four books of the New Testament, known as the Gospels.

words.ex: His fidelity to his friend never changed.
words.ex_cn: 他对朋友的忠诚从未改变。
words.en: Fidelity is loyalty to a person, organization, or set of beliefs.

words.ex: The admiral gave orders to the navy.
words.ex_cn: 海军上将向海军下达了命令。
words.en: An admiral is a senior officer in the navy, in particular the commander of a fleet or a high-ranking officer.

words.ex: The rope is 100 footage long.
words.ex_cn: 这根绳子长100英尺。
words.en: Footage refers to a sequence of film or video that has been shot, especially when it is used in a news broadcast or a documentary.

words.ex: The clergy prayed in the church every morning.
words.ex_cn: 神职人员每天早上在教堂祈祷。
words.en: The clergy are the official leaders of religious activities in certain religions, especially in Christianity.

words.ex: The teacher used a loudspeaker to talk to the students.
words.ex_cn: 老师用扬声器对学生们讲话。
words.en: A loudspeaker is a piece of electronic equipment that makes sounds louder so that they can be heard at a greater distance.

words.tr:
adj. 甜熟的；醇香的；柔和的；成熟的；沉醉的
v. （使）成熟；（使颜色）柔和；（使酒）更加醇香
words.ex: The apple became mellow after a few days.
words.ex_cn: 几天后，苹果变软了。
words.en: If someone mellows or if something mellows them, they become kinder or less extreme in their behavior, often as a result of becoming older or more experienced.

words.tr: n. 路由；路径选择；（材料或产品的）加工路线安排
words.ex: The router uses routing to send data to the right place.
words.ex_cn: 路由器使用路由将数据发送到正确的地方。
words.en: Routing refers to the process of selecting paths in a network along which to send network traffic, or the act of directing or sending something along a particular path.

words.ex: The sign glows with bright neon light.
words.ex_cn: 这个标志发出明亮的霓虹光。
words.en: A colourless, odourless inert gaseous element occurring in minute amounts in the earth's atmosphere, used in fluorescent lights and illuminated advertising signs.

words.tr:
n. 退潮；衰退；减少
v. 退潮；衰退；减少
words.ex: The ebb of the tide left fish on the sand.
words.ex_cn: 退潮把鱼留在了沙滩上。
words.en: The movement of the tide out to sea.

words.ex: This drink is alcoholic and not for children.
words.ex_cn: 这种饮料含酒精，不适合儿童饮用。
words.en: An alcoholic is someone who cannot stop drinking large amounts of alcohol, even when it is causing them serious health or personal problems.

words.tr: n. 独白；独角戏；长篇大论
words.ex: He gave a monologue on stage.
words.ex_cn: 他在舞台上发表了一段独白。
words.en: A monologue is a long speech by one person, especially in a play or film, or a long speech by one person during a conversation.

words.tr: adj. 臭名远扬的；声名狼藉的；
words.ex: He is an infamous thief who stole from many banks.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个臭名远扬的窃贼，偷过许多银行。
words.en: If you say that someone is infamous, you mean that they are well known because they have done something bad.

words.tr: n. 派系；派系斗争；内讧
words.ex: The faction argued loudly about the new rule.
words.ex_cn: 这个派别就新规定激烈争论。
words.en: A faction is a group of people within a larger group who have different opinions and beliefs from the rest of the group.

words.ex: This movie is a horror genre film.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影是一部恐怖类型影片。
words.en: A genre is a particular type of literature, painting, music, film, or other art form which people consider as a class because it has special characteristics.

words.ex: He sits by the fireplace in winter.
words.ex_cn: 冬天他坐在壁炉旁。
words.en: A fireplace is a place built into a wall where you can have a fire, especially in a house.

words.tr: v. 报（某事）之仇；为（某人）报仇
words.ex: He wants to avenge his brother's death.
words.ex_cn: 他想为弟弟的死报仇。
words.en: To avenge someone means to harm or punish someone who has harmed them or someone they care about.

words.tr:
v. 调情；轻率地对待
n. 与多人调情的人
words.ex: He flirts with her at the coffee shop.
words.ex_cn: 他在咖啡店向她调情。
words.en: If you flirt with someone, you behave as if you are sexually attracted to them, in a playful or not very serious way.

words.ex: The congressman spoke to the people in his town.
words.ex_cn: 这位国会议员向他所在城镇的人们发表了讲话。
words.en: A congressman is a member of the United States Congress, especially of the House of Representatives.

words.ex: The trees showed bright foliage in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 秋天时，树木呈现出鲜艳的叶子。
words.en: The leaves of a plant or tree, or the leaves on trees and plants collectively.

words.ex: The statue is made of bronze.
words.ex_cn: 这座雕像由青铜制成。
words.en: Bronze is a yellowish-brown metal which is a mixture of copper and tin.

words.tr:
n. 没收物；罚金
v. 丧失；被没收
words.ex: He had to pay a forfeit for breaking the rule.
words.ex_cn: 他因违反规定不得不支付没收物。
words.en: If you forfeit something, you lose it or are forced to give it up because you have broken a rule or done something wrong.

words.tr: n. 壁炉地面；炉床；炉边
words.ex: She sat by the hearth to keep warm.
words.ex_cn: 她坐在壁炉旁取暖。
words.en: The floor of a fireplace, often extending into a room and paved with brick, stone, or cement, used as a place to build fires or for sitting in front of a fire.

words.tr:
adj. 弯曲的；扭曲的；欺诈的；不老实的
v. （使）弯曲；使成钩状；“crook”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The path was crooked and hard to walk on.
words.ex_cn: 这条路是弯曲的，很难走。
words.en: If you describe something as crooked, especially something that is usually straight, you mean that it is bent or twisted.

words.ex: The Tang dynasty was famous for its poetry and art.
words.ex_cn: 唐朝以诗歌和艺术而闻名。
words.en: A dynasty is a series of rulers of a country who all belong to the same family.

words.ex: He wrote, 'I love apples, bananas, and oranges.'
words.ex_cn: 他写道：'我喜欢苹果、香蕉和橙子。'
words.en: A comma is a punctuation mark (,) used to indicate a pause or to separate items in a list.

words.tr: n. 长颈瓶；烧瓶；携带用扁瓶；保温瓶
words.ex: He poured the liquid into a glass flask.
words.ex_cn: 他把液体倒进了一个玻璃长颈瓶里。
words.en: A flask is a bottle or other container which is used in science laboratories and industry for holding liquids.

words.tr:
adj. 常绿的；常青的；
n. 常绿树；常绿植物；
words.ex: The evergreen trees stay green all year.
words.ex_cn: 常绿树一年四季都是绿色的。
words.en: An evergreen is a plant, tree, or bush that has green leaves all the year round.

words.ex: He cannot comprehend the simple math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他无法理解这个简单的数学问题。
words.en: To comprehend something means to understand it fully.

words.ex: The book encompasses all basic math skills.
words.ex_cn: 这本书包含了所有基础数学技能。
words.en: If something encompasses particular things, it includes them.

words.ex: They parked the caravan by the lake for the weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他们把旅行拖车停在湖边过周末。
words.en: A caravan is a group of people, especially traders or pilgrims, traveling together across a desert in Asia or North Africa.

words.ex: She made an embroidery of a flower on the pillow.
words.ex_cn: 她在枕头上绣了一朵花。
words.en: Embroidery is the craft of decorating fabric or other materials using a needle to apply thread or yarn. It may also incorporate other materials such as pearls, beads, quills, and sequins.

words.ex: The accident disabled him for life.
words.ex_cn: 这场事故使他终身残废。
words.en: If an injury or illness disables someone, it affects them so badly that it restricts the way that they can live their life.

words.tr:
v. 飞翔；飞行；
n. 苍蝇；
words.ex: Birds fly in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在天空中飞翔。
words.en: To move through the air using wings; or a small insect with two wings.

words.ex: He bought equity in a tech company.
words.ex_cn: 他购买了一家科技公司的股票。
words.en: Equity is the quality of being fair and impartial.

words.ex: The defiant child refused to clean his room.
words.ex_cn: 这个不顺从的孩子拒绝打扫房间。
words.en: If you say that someone is defiant, you mean they show aggression or independence by refusing to obey someone.

words.ex: The farmer rides his ass to the market.
words.ex_cn: 农夫骑着他的驴去市场。
words.en: An ass is a donkey, a domesticated animal of the horse family, or a foolish or stupid person.

words.tr: n. 伪造；伪造罪；伪造物
words.ex: He was arrested for forgery.
words.ex_cn: 他因伪造被逮捕了。
words.en: Forgery is the crime of making or altering a document or signature with the intent to deceive or defraud.

words.tr: v. 使气馁；使胆怯；吓倒
words.ex: The loud noise did not daunt her.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音并没有吓倒她。
words.en: If something daunts you, it makes you feel slightly afraid or worried about dealing with it.

words.ex: The cavalry charged quickly across the field.
words.ex_cn: 骑兵迅速冲过田野。
words.en: The cavalry refers to the part of an army that originally fought on horseback, now typically used in modern armies to refer to units that are mobile and intended for rapid deployment.

words.ex: He tries to downplay his mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 他试图淡化自己的错误。
words.en: To downplay something means to make it seem less important or less bad than it really is.

words.tr:
n. 鱼饵；诱惑物
v. 下诱饵
words.ex: He used bread as bait to catch fish.
words.ex_cn: 他用面包当诱饵来钓鱼。
words.en: Bait is something which is used to attract fish or animals so that they can be caught. It can also refer to something that is offered to someone to persuade them to do something.

words.ex: The bomb will detonate at midnight.
words.ex_cn: 炸弹将在午夜爆炸。
words.en: To detonate something means to cause it to explode.

words.ex: Italian cuisine is famous for pasta and pizza.
words.ex_cn: 意大利烹调风格以意大利面和披萨闻名。
words.en: A style or method of cooking, especially as characteristic of a particular country, region, or establishment.

words.ex: The old bridge will disintegrate if no one fixes it.
words.ex_cn: 如果没人修理，这座旧桥会瓦解。
words.en: If something disintegrates, it breaks into many small pieces or parts and is destroyed.

words.tr: adj. 直截了当的；直率的；坦白的
words.ex: He is forthright about his mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 他坦率地承认自己的错误。
words.en: If you describe someone as forthright, you admire them because they show clearly and strongly what they think and feel.

words.ex: Farmers grow barley for animal feed.
words.ex_cn: 农民种植大麦作为动物饲料。
words.en: Barley is a cereal grain that is used as food and also in making beer and whiskey.

words.ex: Babies have an innate ability to cry.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿生来就有哭泣的能力。
words.en: An innate quality or ability is one that you were born with, not one you have learned.

words.tr: v. 驱散；消散；浪费；挥霍
words.ex: The fog will dissipate by noon.
words.ex_cn: 雾将在中午前消散。
words.en: If something dissipates or is dissipated, it becomes less or becomes less strong until it disappears or goes away completely.

words.tr:
n. 粪便；废话；质量差的东西
v. 排便
words.ex: The dog left crap on the grass.
words.ex_cn: 狗在草地上拉了粪便。
words.en: If you describe something as crap, you think that it is of very poor quality.

words.ex: The small country has a dependency on foreign aid.
words.ex_cn: 这个小国依赖外国援助。
words.en: A dependency is a situation in which someone or something relies on someone or something else for support or existence.

words.ex: The chef cooked a delicious dinner for the guests.
words.ex_cn: 主厨为客人做了一顿美味的晚餐。
words.en: A chef is a professional cook, typically the chief cook in a restaurant or hotel.

words.tr: adj. 不直接的；不正直的；迂回的；
words.ex: He gave a devious answer to avoid telling the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他给出了一个不直接的回答，以避免说出真相。
words.en: If you describe someone as devious, you mean that they are dishonest and unfair in the way that they behave, often by using indirect methods to achieve their aims.

words.ex: The clement teacher gave students extra time.
words.ex_cn: 这位仁慈的老师给了学生更多时间。
words.en: Mild or merciful in disposition or character; lenient; compassionate.

words.ex: She tries to juggle her job and caring for her kids.
words.ex_cn: 她努力兼顾工作和照顾孩子。
words.en: If you juggle, you keep several objects in motion in the air at the same time by repeatedly throwing and catching them. Juggle can also mean to deal with several things at the same time, often in a skillful way.

words.tr: n. 审计员；（大学课程的）旁听生；（一名）听众
words.ex: The auditor checked the company's money records.
words.ex_cn: 审计员检查了公司的财务记录。
words.en: An auditor is a person whose job is to carry out an official examination of the accounts of a business and to produce a report.

words.tr: n. 保龄球； v. “bowl”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves playing bowling on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末打保龄球。
words.en: Bowling is a game in which you roll a heavy ball down a long, narrow track towards a group of wooden objects called pins, trying to knock down as many of them as possible.

words.ex: He uses contraception to avoid having a baby.
words.ex_cn: 他使用避孕措施来避免怀孕。
words.en: Contraception is the use of methods or devices to prevent pregnancy.

words.ex: He bought a franchise to open a coffee shop.
words.ex_cn: 他购买了一个特许经营权来开一家咖啡店。
words.en: A franchise is an authorization granted by a government or company to an individual or group enabling them to carry out specified commercial activities, e.g., acting as an agent for a company's products.

words.ex: The bustle of the market filled the morning air.
words.ex_cn: 市场的喧哗充满了早晨的空气。
words.en: If someone bustles somewhere, they move there in a hurried way, often because they are very busy or excited.

words.ex: The budget is a constraint on our project.
words.ex_cn: 预算是我们项目的限制。
words.en: A constraint is something that limits or controls what you can do.

words.ex: He blurted out the secret by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心说出了秘密。
words.en: If someone blurts something, they say it suddenly, after trying hard to keep quiet or to keep it secret.

words.tr: v. 哄；用好话劝诱；哄骗
words.ex: He tried to coax the cat out from under the bed.
words.ex_cn: 他试图哄猫从床底下出来。
words.en: To coax someone means to persuade them to do something by gentle persuasion or flattery.

words.ex: The soup was too bland for me.
words.ex_cn: 这汤太淡了，我不喜欢。
